games.title: Kingdom Master
games.description:
Kingdom Master is a cozy build-and-defend game with a nightly twist. Every day you ride your royal horse around the kingdom: chop wood, mine stone and ore, dig up crystals and sell them at the market for gold. Spend that gold to unlock new hexes, raise your castle walls and place towers around your land.

Then the sun goes down.

Each night an invasion pours out of the portals and marches on your castle. Your towers fire, your cannons reload, and you charge into the fight yourself with sword and shield. Survive the night and a new day begins — bigger rewards, tougher enemies, and every fifth night a boss comes knocking.

How far you get is up to you: every night you survive earns Crowns, a permanent currency you keep even after the castle falls. Spend them in the Kingdom Legacy to start richer, build thicker walls, hit harder and ride faster — then go back and beat your record.

Features

One-handed, easy-to-learn build & defend gameplay — perfect for short sessions
A growing hex kingdom: sawmills, quarries, mines, crystal fields and a bustling market
Three tower types: fast Ballista, heavy Cannon and enemy-slowing Frost
Day/night loop with escalating invasions and boss nights every 5 days
Kingdom Legacy: permanent upgrades bought with Crowns you never lose
Daily quests, a 7-day login calendar, achievements and a world leaderboard
Treasure chests across the map and random day events (golden meteors, ambushes, royal taxes)
Bright hand-crafted low-poly world; plays in landscape and portrait, desktop and mobile
English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, German and Turkish

games.title: GeoVex - Daily Geography Challenge
games.description:
The daily map challenge for flag and geography nerds.

GeoVex is an engaging daily educational puzzle game that puts your world geography knowledge to the test.
In this map-based trivia challenge, you are presented with a series of national flags and must pinpoint their exact location on the globe. 

Play on Easy mode to see country names and map borders, or test your true expertise on Hard mode, with a completely borderless map!
Compete in the 10-round Daily Challenge to build your daily streak and share your score with friends!

games.title: Noob saves the village
games.description: The village has been attacked by merciless monsters! Become a real hero and defeat dangerous enemies with your fighting skills!

games.title: Annoying Cousins Punch Game
games.description:
👊😆 Annoying Cousins Punch Game – The Funniest Family Fight Arcade!

Get ready for the most hilarious family showdown ever! Your cousins are being annoying again, and it’s time to show them who’s boss in this fast-paced, over-the-top tap-and-punch arcade game. With goofy animations, silly reactions, and punchy comedy, you’re in for nonstop fun!

Perfect for quick play sessions, offline gameplay, and players who love quirky humor and simple controls.

🌟 Product Features:

😂 Funny Cousin-Punching Arcade Game
👉 Easy Tap & Punch Gameplay – Just tap at the right moment to knock annoying cousins away!
🤣 Hilarious Animations & Sound Effects
🔥 Increasingly Challenging Levels – The more you play, the crazier your cousins get!
📺 Optimized for Fire Tablets & Fire TV
🎮 Quick, Lighthearted Arcade Fun

🥊 Product Description:

Family time can be fun… until your cousins start being EXTRA annoying!
In Annoying Cousins Punch Game, you face off in hilarious punch battles against your mischievous, goofy cousins — all in a silly, cartoonish style.

Tap with perfect timing, dodge their tricks, and deliver the funniest punches in this wacky arcade challenge. As levels increase, your cousins become faster, louder, and even more chaotic — can you keep up?

With its simple controls, funny animations, and addictive gameplay loop, this game is perfect for players who want fast, entertaining, and totally ridiculous fun.



funny arcade game, punching game, tap punch game, family fight game, comedy arcade, reaction game, tap timing game, funny family game, casual punch game, silly fighting game, offline arcade game

😂 Ready to teach your cousins a lesson?

Download Annoying Cousins Punch Game now and jump into the funniest family brawl ever!

games.title: Finger Soccer Tournament
games.description: Finger Soccer Tournament is an engaging game where players pick teams to outscore opponents. Enjoy free online play with no downloads, featuring quality graphics. Compete solo or with friends on PC, Android, and iOS. Join the finger soccer realm and strive to be the top champion!

games.title: Money Maker
games.description: Money Maker is a merge game about running a banknote machine. Drop money, place power-up chips in the right spots, and let every bounce boost your income. Unlock upgrades and new chip slots to multiply profits and keep the cash flowing. How far can you scale your money machine?

games.title: Ball Bounce: Try It
games.description: Ball Bounce is a casual game that is very fun and challenging. Your task is to guide the ball which continues to bounce towards the portal while passing through obstacles

games.title: Blockadventure io
games.description:
🌍 Welcome to BlockAdventure!

Dive into the thrilling world of BlockAdventure, a Minecraft-inspired online multiplayer experience packed with parkour challenges, obby adventures, and endless fun! Explore blocky worlds, compete with other players, and push your skills to the limit. Whether you’re jumping across floating platforms or racing through tricky maps, there’s always something exciting to do.

Customize your style in the Skin Menu — choose your favorite look and stand out from the crowd as you conquer each obstacle!

And the best part? This is just the beginning.
New game modes and adventures are already on the way!

🚀 Coming Soon Features
	•	🎮 Mini-Games Hub – Unlock and play various mini-games with friends
	•	🧩 Puzzle-Based Maps – Solve environmental puzzles to progress
	•	👥 Custom Avatars & Skins – Personalize your character even more
	•	🏆 Leaderboard System – Climb the global ranks and show off your skills
	•	🛠️ Level Editor – Build and share your own parkour or obby maps
	•	🌎 New Game Worlds – Unique themes and environments to explore

⸻

🕹️ Controls

Desktop Controls:
	•	W / A / S / D or Arrow Keys: Move
	•	Spacebar: Jump
	•	C: Change camera view
	•	F: Step back (return to checkpoint or previous step)

Mobile Controls:
	•	On-Screen Joystick: Move freely
	•	Jump Button: Tap to jump
	•	Camera Button: Toggle camera view
	•	Back Button: Go back to previous checkpoint

games.title: Homo Evolution
games.description: Welcome to Homo Evolution, an enchanting journey where you can create your own little universe and unravel the mysteries of human evolution. This free online game lets you merge two individuals to birth a new, more modern life form, populating the planet with a wide array of creatures—from simple animals to diverse and unpredictable personalities. Whether you're on the phone or computer, this captivating gameplay invites you to shape the world in four unique ways, from the BEGINNING with animal evolution, to the BREAD civilization, witnessing the transformation from natural to modified products.

games.title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
games.description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

games.title: Runic Curse
games.description:
Runic Curse is an action-adventure game where you step into the boots of Adrian, a shipwreck survivor stranded on a mysterious island. 
As you explore ancient ruins and cursed lands, uncover the secrets behind the Rune Curse and search for your lost crew. 
Face danger, solve mysteries, and embrace your fate in a world shrouded in shadows. 
Features Dynamic combat system with endurance management and rolls that give invulnerability frames. 
RPG elements: Level system with selective improvement of characteristics, equipment, and abilities for previously inaccessible areas. 
Many options for combining cold weapons and magic runes.
10 vast locations with various enemies and bosses. 
Crafting consumable runes and improving runes for weapons. 
More than 55 types of spells. 
New Game + in unlimited quantities. Boss Rush mode. Customization of the button layout.

games.title: Connect Words 2026
games.description:
🧠 “Connect Words 2026” is not just a word game — it is a whole collection of engaging word mini-games in one app!
Connect letters, find hidden words, complete unique challenges, and unlock new trials across 1,500+ levels.

🌟 Why is this game worth trying?
• Different types of mini-games — more variety, less repetition
• 1500+ levels — long and engaging gameplay
• Brain training — improve your memory, attention, and vocabulary
• Smooth difficulty progression — comfortable for beginners and interesting for experienced players
• Relaxing gameplay — play at your own pace at home, on the go, or on vacation

💡 The unique advantage of “Connect Words 2026” is the combination of a classic word game and various mini-games, making every session interesting and never boring.

If you enjoy crosswords, word searches, puzzles, and brain games, this game will be a great everyday choice! 🎉

games.title: Ghost Guard
games.description: Shoot all ghosts before they reach you! Use arrow keys on PC, or tap on screen quadrants on mobile. Be careful, as some ghost will change directions!

games.title: Merge Builders
games.description:
Open. Merge. Build! Dive into a bright and cheerful merge arcade where your goal is simple: assemble the ultimate toolkit and construct beautiful houses step by step.
Buy mystery boxes, open them, and merge identical tools—like screwdrivers, paint rollers, and hammers—to upgrade their efficiency. Strategically hand the best tools to your four hardworking builders stationed around the foundation. They’ll work automatically while you focus on optimizing your board. Watch in satisfaction as the house realistically takes shape and grows right before your eyes!
Take on increasingly ambitious construction projects, from a Cozy Cottage to a Grand Mansion. Each new building brings escalating requirements that will push your merging tactics to the limit.
Grab limited-time gift events, boost your progress with Efficiency x2, and activate Auto-Open to speed up your workflow. Every decision matters as your building empire scales endlessly. Finish projects, earn rewards, and see how far your crew can go in an infinite challenge of fun and strategy.
Complete the tutorial, master the coin economy, and prove that your team can construct any dream home!

games.title: Shoes Outlet Game
games.description: In this idle game, simplicity is key! Tap your way to success as you build and expand your outlets from mini to mega. It's easy, it's fun, and it's all about the joy of watching your mall grow with minimal effort! Become a retail tycoon without breaking a sweat! Effortlessly manage your dream mall by hiring staff and making strategic decisions. Deal with displaying goods, cleaning fitting rooms, and helping customers check out. Fear not, for you can build your own dream team and manage them efficiently, turning challenges into opportunities and making every coin count!

games.title: Never by Color!
games.description:
The Japanese room has drowned in a mountain of colorful parts. Bring back its calm!

Scoop up a handful of parts onto your tray and sort them into boxes. There's one rule, and it's ironclad: sort by SHAPE — never by color! Cubes with cubes, plates with plates, and let the red trap box stay empty.

No timers, no losing. Just you, a mountain of parts, and the pursuit of perfect order. The most meditative tidying of your life.

games.title: PoppyTile
games.description:
Join travelling through PoppyTile village with challenges in both match-3 and mahjong genres!
Meet the charming girl Poppy who will be by your side during the throughout your journey!

Match 3 identical tiles to gradually clear the board. Progress further across the map with increasingly difficult levels.

Use boosters to complete levels as quickly and comfortably as possible.

Classic boosters:
- Add an extra slot, 
- Cancel the last action, 
- Mix tiles on the board
- Use an idea!

How far can you go?

See you in PoppyTile!

games.title: Spartan fruits
games.description: The Spartan fruits must overcome obstacles and find chests containing coins to unlock rewards and advance to the next stages. They must also collect gems to unlock new types of fruit.

games.title: Football: Robots vs Zombies, World Cup!
games.description:
⚽ Immerse yourself in the exciting world of football, where robots take on zombies!

🎮 Game features:
— 🏆 50 exciting levels
— ♾️ Endless mode
— 🤖 Robot customization
— 🗺️ A variety of locations
— ⚽ An immersive football atmosphere

And that’s not all! Compete with other players, prove your skills on the field, and rise through the rankings. Get ready for football action and adrenaline that will make your heart race!

games.title: Beach Defense: Merge Tower
games.description:
A Tiny Merge is a beach-themed tower defense game where every run is about building smarter, merging faster, and
surviving longer. Place towers on the board, combine matching towers to create stronger defenses, and discover new
tower types as you progress through the waves.

Enemies keep getting tougher, so you will need to upgrade your strategy, unlock active powers, spend your coins wisely,
and keep improving your setup between waves. Use quick-buy tools, open upgrades, choose powerful bonuses, and react to
the changing pressure on the battlefield.

Push through as many waves as possible, experiment with different tower combinations, and turn a simple beach defense
into a powerful wall of water, splash, and chaos.

games.title: Microgic 89
games.description:
MICROGIC 89 is a retro tile puzzle set inside a 1980s microchip. You play BYTE, a
courier who has to collect every data chip on the board, unlock the socket they open,
and reach the exit before the timer runs out.

22 hand-built levels, each one testing a different machine: sliding ice floors, force
belts, teleport pads, cloning machines, trap doors, live bombs and patrolling bugs.
Nothing on the board is decoration - if a gadget is there, you have to use it.

Every level you clear and every second left on the clock feeds your score, and the
global leaderboard remembers who runs the chip best. Play it flat in the classic
top-down view or flip to 3D at any time. A full level editor is built in, so you can
draw your own maps and play the ones other players have published.

Fully localized in 8 languages: English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish,
German, French and Japanese.

games.title: Orbit Shift
games.description:
You're locked in orbit around a dying star: two rings, two lanes, one chance. Tap to switch. Don't get hit. How long can you last?

Orbit Shift is a one-tap lane-switching endless space arcade game where reflexes are everything. Comets, shooting stars, and meteors spawn at the top of two concentric rings and spiral clockwise toward your ship. Your only move is shifting between the inner and outer ring — but timing that one move perfectly, over and over, faster and faster, is everything.

Each stage runs exactly one minute and escalates in speed and obstacle density, climaxing in a surge — a short, intense burst of rapid-fire obstacles that acts as a skill gate before the next stage unlocks. Difficulty pulses in waves: pressure builds to each surge, then briefly eases, before the next stage raises the floor. By Stage 5, gaps between hazards shrink to fractions of a second.

Survival time is your score, tracked against your personal best. No checkpoints. Every run starts from zero. You'll have to earn every second.

Cosmetics — trails, ships, and color schemes — unlock through achievements tied to real gameplay stats. All purely visual. No pay-to-win, no randomness. Play anywhere — no download required, instant play on desktop and mobile.

Orbit Shift is an original game handcrafted by cfc, a human game developer.

games.title: Block Puzzle: Prize Mania
games.description:
A classic block-drop puzzle that transforms into a true collector’s experience!

Drag pieces onto the grid, clear lines, and enjoy satisfying combos. But the real hook? 32 unique collectible items with awesome abilities.
Before each match, you build your loadout: pick up to three items that work together.

One boosts your score, another lets you blast blocks, and a third changes the board rules. Every combination delivers a fresh, highly engaging playstyle.

All items are pulled from the gacha machine. Use a ticket, pull the lever, and feel the thrill as a capsule rolls out and pops open to reveal your newest gear.

games.title: Up, Up, and Oops!
games.description: Climb an endless tower of floating tiles in this fast-paced 3D arcade action game. Read the path, choose the correct direction, and move before time runs out. Aim for a high score in Endless mode, race to step 200 in Score Sprint, or compete against up to six players in Online Race. Unlock new characters, tiles, and titles as you climb, and challenge the weekly leaderboards.

games.title: Ice Slide
games.description:
Ice Slide is a simple, casual, and addictive sliding puzzle game! 

Your goal is easy: slide the block to fill all empty tiles on the board.

🌟 FEATURES:
- 1000 fun and challenging levels.
- Simple one-finger swipe controls.
- Beautiful custom skins to unlock.
- Daily rewards and lucky spin.
- Play offline anytime!

Relax your brain and start sliding now!

games.title: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle
games.description:
Logic Farm: Animal Grid Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is to place cute animals on a grid following specific rules. With its soft pastel aesthetics and brain-teasing levels, it’s the perfect blend of cozy gaming and mental exercise. Can you find the perfect spot for every animal? Start sorting your farm today!
Key Features
•	Choose Your Pace with Two Modes:
o	Relax Mode: Enjoy a stress-free experience with no lives limit and no time pressure. Simply relax and solve puzzles at your own speed.
o	Challenge Mode: Put your logic to the test! This mode features limited lives (represented by the heart icon) and a time limit, challenging you to solve the farm layout before time runs out.
•	Interactive Tutorial: Easy-to-follow instructions guide you through your first placements, helping you learn to "cross out" cells where animals cannot be placed.
•	Helpful Tools: Use the "Find" or "Hint" features if you get stuck on a tricky arrangement.
•	Challenging Levels: Progress through increasingly difficult grids as you move from Level 1 onwards.
•	Cozy Visuals: Enjoy a clean UI and charming animal icons designed for a pleasant gaming experience.

games.title: Object 73: Survival Clicker
games.description:
A post-apocalyptic survival clicker with idle and RPG elements. You awaken inside the underground Jericho Complex as Object 73 — a clone who keeps returning to life after every death. Each new cycle is a chance to uncover the truth behind the Jericho Project.

Explore ruined laboratories, collect resources and fight dangerous enemies including mutants, rogue synthetics and combat drones. Defeated enemies drop materials that can be used to craft weapons, upgrade equipment and survive longer.

Discover multiple locations across the complex such as laboratories, armories, archives and contaminated sectors. Find memory fragments, hidden logs and secret files that slowly reveal the story of Colonel Dmitry Yankovsky.

Craft powerful weapons, upgrade armor and improve your character to defeat elite enemies and story bosses. Your decisions influence the humanity level of the protagonist and change how the story unfolds.

games.title: Draw One Line Bridge Puzzle
games.description: Play Draw One Line Bridge Puzzle, a free brain-teasing game where you build bridges to guide vehicles to safety. Solve challenging puzzles, enjoy ragdoll physics, addictive gameplay, and offline fun. Perfect for car and puzzle lovers—test your skills today!

games.title: Jelly Drop: Merge & Sell
games.description:
Jelly Drop: Merge & Sell is a bright and addictive merge game where every jelly earns you points!

Merge identical jellies, fill the jar to the brim, and sell the result to earn more and more. The higher the jelly level, the more points you get. Simple controls, satisfying physics, and a constant sense of progress make the game perfect for short sessions and relaxing gameplay.

Watch the jar fill up as jellies merge into more valuable forms and your score grows with every sale. Upgrade your stats, increase capacity, and turn ordinary jellies into a true record-breaking machine!

games.title: The Hustler
games.description:
The Hustler is a fun Simulator game where you start with nothing and work your way to the very top!

You start poor and build your wealth. 

As you get faster, you can start your own cool businesses. You will have to rush around to stack supplies, keep long lines of happy customers moving, and collect big piles of cash.

The more you work, the bigger your empire grows! You can use your money to move faster, carry more items, and unlock awesome new shops.

Manage your shops, lead your workers and make the most profit. 

It is a non-stop race to see how much you can build. Do you have what it takes to be the best hustler in town?

games.title: Cow Cow Run
games.description:
A cow was having a nice life, but all changed when the UFO nation came and wants to kidnap the cow. Help the cow avoid the UFOs while collecting coins to buy it’s freedom!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?
A: The game is similar to 3D Pacman where you need to escape from aliens while being a cow, to complete a level you need to collect all the coins on the level.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: There are few similar games, pleasant cozy voxel graphics.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Coins are spent on upgrades and bonuses.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You can increase the chances of bonuses appearing.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to come back?
A: Yes, there are achievements that players want to complete as they are related to mechanics.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties without sound?
A: You can play without sound, but the music and SFX are very pleasant.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)
A: 10 levels.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Yes, they are obtained as you progress and apply game mechanics.

games.title: Merge Fruit Monster Defense: Tower Defense
games.description:
A bizarre infection has brought huge changes to the world. Ferocious little monsters are getting ready to attack. But Tao is never scared, because all kinds of magical fruit warriors are holding the line firmly! Your goal is to protect Tao and stop monsters from eating her!
Game Features
Creative mixed gameplay of backpack merging, roguelike and tower defense, featuring funny fruit characters and weird zombie monsters.
Simple backpack merging mechanics. You can easily experience character development, inventory sorting, silver coin management and tactical troop arrangement.
Fruit crossbreeding. After upgrading fruits to Tier 4 via merging, cross them with other creatures to gain stronger combat power and funny unique looks.
Hybrid monster styles. Most in-game monsters are designed with diverse crossbred visual styles.
Exclusive endless challenge mode. Start with plenty of silver coins to finish quick backpack merging. Countless monsters keep spawning nonstop for you to take on extreme battles.

games.title: Build And Run
games.description: Build And Run is an exciting arcade game where you navigate, construct, and triumph! Play instantly on various devices without downloads or sign-ups. Race through levels while building ramps and defeating foes with diverse weapons. Customize your character with stylish gear and enjoy endless fun in both modes!

games.title: Towers 505
games.description:
Demonstrate your strategy of indestructible defense by erecting towers to stop the hordes of monsters trying to break through your line; not only strength is important here, but also intelligence, because each wave of monsters requires new tactics, improvements and the perfect location of towers.
This browser-based tower defense game features a classic 2D top-down perspective with stylized cartoon art. Players defend a winding orange path by strategically placing various defense turrets, such as wooden crossbow towers and stone fortifications, to stop waves of approaching monsters emerging from a dark purple abyss. The core gameplay loop involves spending earned gold coins to build and upgrade structures, periodically clicking to activate magical spells like fireballs and frost blasts to slow down or destroy enemies. Progression is level-based, with ten locked stages visible on the level selection screen. The visual style is bright and vibrant, dominated by a green grassy field, stone walls, and brown autumnal trees, all rendered with thick outlines and flat colors. The UI is comprehensive, displaying a gold coin counter, a kill tally with a skull icon, a health heart indicating ten lives, and an bottom bar with available building or spell buttons. Defensive gameplay is punctuated by varied enemy types including ground-based green slugs and fast-moving white flying monsters. The tone is casual and accessible for all ages, though strategic depth increases with environmental challenges like rain that buffs enemy strength. Losing all ten lives results in a failure screen, prompting the player to retry the stage or return to the main menu.

games.title: Bicycle Mountain Xtreme
games.description:
Bicycle Mountain Xtreme is a relaxing but challenging mountain biking game where you ride on epic trails, perform cool tricks, earn points, and unlock new trails as you get better. 
The game feels smooth and fun because it uses realistic physics, has procedurally generated trails, and includes a day/night cycle plus a dynamic weather system that changes while you ride.

games.title: Merge Rush Attack
games.description: Merge Rush Attack is a fast tap-and-merge runner: spawn a crowd, fuse units into stronger tiers, and smash through boss walls before overheating. A portrait clicker with escalating walls, paid merge chains, and risk–reward tap pressure that turns every sprint into a short, tense power race.

games.title: Hand Daily
games.description: A daily card roguelite. Every day, the same 52-card deck deals across the world. Build five-card hands, chain joker effects, climb 5 antes, build a daily streak. Five minutes per run, one chance per day. Same hand for every player. Free, no install, no microtransactions.

games.title: Bounce Heroes
games.description: Bounce Heroes is a thrilling blend of idle RPG, merge puzzle, and roguelite action where your hero battles fierce monsters, an evil empire, and ancient beasts, all in pursuit of treasure and victory. Armed with a trusty crossbow and magical bouncy balls dropped by fallen foes, you’ll crush enemies wave after wave.

games.title: Block Mine Fuse TNT
games.description: Block Mine Fuse TNT is an exhilarating adventure game where players take on the mission to liberate the world from the ominous presence of Herobrine and its eerie constructions. Step into this action-packed universe and unleash your full potential by upgrading and deploying TNT, rockets, and a myriad of explosive powers upon cubic settlements. Play online for free without the hassle of downloading, and dive into a world where destruction meets strategy, all within the comfort of your browser. With its seamless integration across platforms such as iOS, Android, and desktop, Block Mine Fuse TNT offers a dynamic experience for gamers on the go or at home.

games.title: Puzzle Parents: Baby's Path Home
Magic Kingdom: Hex Match
games.description:
You are the 3rd son of the great king of a magical land. Your parents send you to a faraway land to establish a new kingdom and prove that you are the most capable of their children!

In the game you collect resource hexes. There are 6 resources in total: food, water, stone, wood, diamonds and metal. When you collect enough resources, you can build a new building. Unlock all the buildings, create a beautiful magical kingdom!

games.title: Water Sort Master: Color Puzzle
games.description: Dive into a vibrant world of colorful liquids and brain-teasing puzzles! Pour, sort, and match colors across hundreds of challenging levels designed to test your logic and strategy. Every move counts as you untangle mixed liquids, unlock new challenges, and sharpen your problem-solving skills. Easy to learn but hard to master, Water Sort Master delivers a relaxing yet addictive puzzle experience for players of all ages. Can you sort every bottle and become the ultimate Water Sort Master?

games.title: Tile Harvest 3D
games.description: Tile Harvest 3D is a 3D tile-matching puzzle game with a satisfying merge twist. Clear a towering stack of colorful 3D tiles by collecting matching sets and chaining them into powerful merges. With unlimited levels, escalating challenge, and a set of special boosters to save you in a pinch, every puzzle is a fresh brain-teaser.

games.title: Lady Rescue
games.description:
Welcome to Lady Rescue!, the perfect game for those who love drawing and solving puzzles!
Join our brave girl, Lady, on an exciting journey filled with challenging puzzles, honey bees, and lots of surprises. 
In this game, you need to help Lady escape from dangerous things like bees, sharks, and crocodiles by drawing lines. You have to think and act fast to keep her safe. 
It's not just fun, it's also a brain teaser that makes you think. You will find yourself in different situations where you need to use your smartness to draw a line that will save Lady.

games.title: Nexusorbiter
games.description:
Single-finger orbital-defense arcade. Your drone orbits a fragile space station and auto-fires at incoming hazards — tap
to flip the orbit direction, that's your only control. Each stage layers in new threats: glue bombs you must shoot at
range, homing suicide drones you can't miss, EMP drones that silence your auto-fire on contact, healing orbiters that
protect bosses. Six upgrade tracks shape your build. 30+ stages, multi-boss waves, plus a fresh daily challenge for
bonus scrap every day.

games.title: Love Archer Hero
games.description:
Welcome to Love Archer Hero game - one of the games about inspiring love feelings! In this interesting project, you play as a cheerful tricky Cupid, using your archer skills, bow and magic arrows of love to connect everyone and create loving couples!
Play have fun, solve puzzles and throw the arrow to a creature of your choice. After your arrow hits the target, they will fall in a beautiful garden and a magic of love will take them over.

Are you ready, my tiny Cupid hero? Shot your love arrows right into funny creatures' hearts to make them love each other and born a baby. Even the different types of creatures can make a solid couple and become happy parents. Combine orc and human for example and see how love conquers all!

games.title: Good Knight Story
games.description:
What happened last night!? Join our unlikely hero as he awakens in a dungeon with a sore head and no memory of how he got there.


Solve puzzles, battle monsters and survive bad jokes as you piece together events from the night before.


FEATURES:


* Rich and entertaining story

* Over 100+ levels of puzzle solving action

* Dynamic character upgrade system

* Daily gifts to help with your quest

* Epic Boss battles

* Special Boosts to unlock

* Upgradeable weapons

* Custom themed soundtrack

* Over 1000+ handsome tavern owners

games.title: Dicey Chickens
games.description: A dice-vs-monsters castle defense game. Your chicken heroes stand at the bottom of the battlefield and roll six-sided dice automatically — whatever face lands fires that attack upward at monsters marching down from the top. Each hero’s die is built from two attack types (and sometimes shield, heal, or speed faces), so every roll matters. Kill enemies to gain XP, level up, and pick spells that upgrade die faces or add effects like bleed, poison, freeze, and knockback. Survive five waves per stage — recruiting up to three heroes along the way — with the final wave being a boss fight. Win by clearing all waves; lose if your castle HP hits zero. Between runs you earn coins, crystals, and weapon shards to permanently upgrade heroes, rank up spells, and push through 100 stages across ten worlds in the Chicken Coop Run campaign.

games.title: Tile Pop : Block Blast
games.description:
Tile Pop is a relaxing yet strategic block puzzle game that challenges your thinking with satisfying gameplay, colorful themes, and endless replayability.

Drag and place beautifully designed block pieces onto the board to complete rows and columns, clear space, and achieve your highest score. Every move matters, so plan carefully and build massive combos to keep the board alive.

games.title: The Goopies: Slime Puzzle
games.description: Casual 2D puzzle game where you guide slimes safely to the exit. Instead of controlling them directly, you place simple instructions on a grid to change how they move.

games.title: Cube Quiz
games.description: CubeQuiz is a relaxing 3D spatial-reasoning puzzle. Two sandy voxel blocks fit together when one slides down and the other slides up to form a solid box. Rotate the pieces, read their shapes, and decide which ones lock perfectly together. Progress through four puzzle packs of increasing difficulty, then test yourself in endless Challenge mode. No timers, no pressure — just you and your mental rotation skills.

games.title: Magic Castle Invasion: Idle RPG
games.description:
In this exciting fantasy RPG, you play as a mighty wizard tasked with defending your magic castle from terrifying monsters. The world is full of mystical creatures, dangerous dungeons, and hidden treasures, and only the strongest will survive. Unleash your full magical potential and gather your team of magical helpers to assist you in the battle for survival.

Game Features:
* Epic Wizard Battles
* Monster Hunting and Slaying
* Magical Upgrades and Progression
* Exploration and Quests
* Build and Defend Your Magic Castle
* Boss Fights and Challenges

games.title: Stick Master Teleport
games.description:
Jump onto walls, throw knives, and teleport to your enemies ⚔️ to defeat them with a single strike 💥.
Prove your ninja reputation by eliminating bad guys before they even notice 😈.
Walk the tough path of a ninja to become a true ninja assassin!

💪 🎮 “Stick Master Teleport” is one of the most exciting ninja games featuring stealth puzzles 🧩 and teleportation gameplay! ⚡ ⚔️

💠 USE DEADLY WEAPONS
There are many types of deadly gear 💣 to defeat your enemies.
In this thrilling ninja game, you can choose traditional ninja weapons such as:
🔪 knife, 🗡️ sword, 🌀 boomerang, and 🪓 club. Adapt your arsenal for every mission! 🎯

💠 Why you’ll love this ninja game:
⚡ Exciting gameplay
🧩 Challenging ninja puzzles
🗺️ Many tricky levels
🌀 Unique combat mechanics
Play “Stick Master Teleport” now ⚡ and strike down cunning enemies in a flash! 💥🔥

games.title: Bonkhalla
games.description:
Choose one of 6 heroes and battle endless waves of monsters across three unique biomes: Forest, Desert, and Graveyard.

Collect experience, level up, and combine 12 weapon types with upgrade tomes to unlock powerful evolutions: the Sword transforms into a Holy Blade, the Fireball into Inferno, and Lightning into the Thunder God!

Over 30 items, 30 quests, 10 challenges with unique rules (one-on-one with bosses, no healing, glass cannon) and a shop with permanent upgrades — every run will feel unique.

Survive 10 minutes, defeat the final boss, and try to endure the Final Storm!

games.title: Knight Crown Idle
games.description:
Game Details

What is Knight Crown Idle about?
Knight Crown Idle is a pixel-style idle RPG where you battle monsters, earn gold and experience, and grow stronger with every fight. Upgrade your hero’s abilities and explore new areas filled with challenges.

What’s the main goal in Knight Crown Idle?
The main goal is to defeat monsters, earn gold and experience, and continuously upgrade your hero to become stronger. As you progress, you unlock new areas, rescue trapped animals, and complete achievements while building a more powerful character.

Is Knight Crown Idle easy to control?
Yes. Knight Crown Idle features simple and intuitive controls, making it easy to pick up while focusing on progression and upgrades.

Can we play Knight Crown Idle on mobile?
Yes. Knight Crown Idle can be played on both mobile devices and desktop computers. It runs directly in the browser and does not require any downloads.

Is Knight Crown Idle free to play?
Yes. Knight Crown Idle is free to play and runs directly in your browser.

Can we play Knight Crown Idle in full screen mode?
Yes. The game supports full screen mode for a more immersive experience.

games.title: Rotcalypse Idle
games.description:
Rotcalypse is a satirical idle tycoon where you monetize digital decay. Transform questionable content into pure profit, scaling from primitive RotToks to a global Brainrot VR-machine.
No thinking required—only expansion. Your goal is the total degradation of the internet for the sake of infinite numbers. Experience a dark reflection of social media addiction, perfect for "killing" time.

games.title: Ten Link: Number Games
games.description:
Ten Link is a relaxing yet brain-teasing number puzzle. Clear the board by
linking pairs of numbers that are either the same or add up to 10 — connect
them across rows, columns, diagonals, or even from the end of one line to the
start of the next.

Colors do the thinking with you: every matching group shares one color, so you
can spot valid pairs at a glance. Out of moves? Add a new wave of numbers and
keep the chain going. Four difficulty modes, a fresh Daily Challenge every day
with monthly trophies, and a level system that grows your Calculation,
Observation and Focus as you play.

games.title: Cube Trap
games.description:
The room looks simple. Five steps to the door you want, level floor, no enemies. You start walking — and the floor drops out from under you.

A 3D platformer that lies to your face. The platform slides away at the exact instant you jump. The ceiling comes down the moment you stand still. The controls flip to mirror mode halfway down a corridor. Gravity turns over, and the sky becomes the floor. And the door you were heading for sidesteps two paces and slams shut.

Nothing here is random: every dirty trick fires the same way every single time. The first time it kills you; the second time it doesn't. Death is instant and costs you nothing — the little cube guy bursts into parts and half a second later he's standing at the start again. Losing is impossible. The only thing you can do is fail to catch on.

games.title: Extreme Balancer
games.description: Extreme Balancer is an exciting and challenging game where you have to balance a ball on narrow wooden bridges and guide it safely to the end of each level. Be careful, if the ball falls off, you will have to start over! The game has beautiful 3D graphics and realistic physics that make it feel like you are really balancing the ball.

games.title: Transport Run
games.description: Navigate the roads in Transport Run, a thrilling 3D traffic avoidance arcade runner! Drive your colorful vehicle along winding highways lined with pink trees and multi-lane traffic, dodging oncoming cars and buses to reach the goal without any crashes. The core idea is careful timing and precision driving in dense traffic—unique for its relaxing yet tense endless run style, isometric cartoon visuals with vibrant environments, and easy upgrades earned through skillful play that make each run feel progressively smoother and more rewarding!

games.title: Tiny Arena
games.description: Tiny Arena is a fast, one-thumb dungeon crawler. Battle through monster-filled rooms, grab a fresh upgrade at every door, and push as deep as you can. Fight across five themed worlds, spend coins on permanent upgrades in the meta-shop, and take on an Endless mode with a global leaderboard. Move to dodge, stand still to auto-fire — easy to pick up, tough to master

games.title: Sway - Tower Builder
games.description:
Sway is a relaxing one-tap tower builder. It's simple, no need to remember thousands of rules and combinations.

Simply stack blocks high, keep them steady and comete with other players!

games.title: Domino Camp
games.description:
🀄 Domino Camp is a fun and addictive puzzle game where strategy meets quick thinking! Match domino tiles, clear the board, and complete exciting challenges across a variety of levels. With simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying matches, Domino Camp offers endless entertainment for players of all ages.

🎯 Test your logic, improve your matching skills, and discover new ways to solve each puzzle. Whether you're looking for a relaxing experience or a brain-teasing challenge, Domino Camp is the perfect place to start your domino adventure! ✨

Features:
🀄 Easy-to-learn gameplay
🎮 Challenging puzzle levels
✨ Smooth animations and satisfying effects
🏆 Fun challenges and rewarding progression
🌟 Suitable for all ages

Join the camp and become a domino master in Domino Camp! 🚀🀄

games.title: Stairs Trivia
games.description: Stairs Trivia is an exciting online quiz game that lets players elevate their knowledge by correctly answering questions. Compete to reach the peak and be the last player standing. Accessible for free on various platforms, it offers a unique 3D experience with engaging challenges without any download or registration.

games.title: Sheep commotion
games.description: Sheep Commotion is a cheerful path-drawing puzzle game about guiding every sheep to the right pen. Draw safe routes, collect stars, avoid wolves, rocks and puddles, and solve increasingly tricky levels with different sheep behaviors.

games.title: Stonks!
games.description:
An arcade game about an amoeba with huge evolutionary ambitions and a very questionable plan: keep jumping higher until nature admits it has a point. The goal is simple: cling to platforms, gain height, and avoid finding out exactly how deep the abyss goes. The higher the run, the trickier the stages become: platforms change shape, routes get tighter, and every sloppy jump turns into a scientific experiment with a sad ending.

Collect biomass to boost your jump, unlock new stages of evolution, and use a mid-air jump when ordinary amoeba determination is no longer enough. Every run is a chance to beat your personal record for height, time, and collected biomass.

Stonks! starts fast, pulls you in easily, and keeps reminding you: evolution loves persistence, but gravity is still stronger.

games.title: Water Flow Happy Glass
games.description:
"Water Flow: Happy Glass" is a captivating puzzle game based on the laws of physics. Each level is a new riddle where you need to show wit and imagination.

Game Features:
 Draw to Win: Your main power is the pencil. Draw any shapes to direct the water.
 5 Unique Worlds: Complete levels in various themes — from a classic lab to fiery lava and magical realms.
 Challenging Obstacles: Encounter teleports, ice blocks, bouncy platforms, and much more on your journey.
 Star System: Use minimal ink to achieve the maximum 3-star rating.
 Daily Challenges: New levels every day for the most dedicated players!

games.title: Hook Arena 3D
games.description:
Hook Arena is an action-packed game where you battle the opponents on opposite sides of a river using unique hook weapons. Your objective is to hook enemies to eliminate them one by one, pull in beneficial rune bottles, or escape by hooking yourself to a physical support like a pole.

Before the match, you can choose your team's color, upgrade your character, and change their skin and weapon. In the treasure menu, you can hack and open chests with both a chest and a key. Who knows what secrets they hold, but all items will be placed in your inventory. Fight in matches, earn trophies, and climb the leaderboard rankings. Good luck in the battle!

games.title: Spin&Mow
games.description: You pilot a saw-chain robot — two spinning gears tethered by a serrated chain — across scalloped grass islands floating over deep water. Anchor one gear, watch the other orbit at chain length, then tap-swap to fling yourself across treacherous gaps. Cut grass to meet each stage's quota, dodge stumps, boulders and crystals, time landings on moving platforms, then touch the flag to escape. Upgrade Sharper Saws, Longer Chain, Reinforced Frame, Coin Magnet and Tuned Gearbox. Finish 20 stages to enter the Hall of Fame as a MOW-A-HERO.

games.title: Farm Business Saga
games.description:
Farm Business Saga is a captivating farming simulation game where players build and manage their dream farm. Perfect for nature lovers and strategy enthusiasts, this game lets you cultivate crops, raise livestock, produce goods, and expand your agricultural empire.
What makes Farm Business Saga unique?
✅ Addictive gameplay – Manage resources, trade, and grow into a farming tycoon.
✅ Stunning graphics & intuitive controls – A visually pleasing experience for all ages.
✅ Endless customization – Design your farm, village, and factory your way!
Whether you're a casual player or a strategic mastermind, Farm Business Saga offers a relaxing yet challenging farming adventure!

games.title: Crazy Emoji Blast
games.description: Match colorful emojis, chain explosive combos, and blast your way through 10 increasingly challenging levels! Swap adjacent emojis to create matches of 3 or more — trigger row blasts, column blasts, cross explosions, and total nukes. Watch out for bombs hidden on the board — match near them to unleash devastating chain reactions

games.title: Help Me: Tricky Puzzle Games
games.description: A quirky and funny brain-teasing puzzle game. Solve bizarre, comical scenarios by interacting directly with the characters and objects to find unexpected solutions and rescue them from trouble.

games.title: Arrows Idle
games.description: Clear the grid, trigger massive chain reactions, and upgrade your way to a perfect flow in this satisfying arrow-merging idle clicker!

games.title: Tick-Tack-What?
games.description:
Think you have mastered Tic-Tac-Toe? Think again! In this mind-bending twist on the classic game, you are playing against an AI opponent that absolutely refuses to play by the rules.
As you progress through increasingly complex and irregular board shapes, the bot will use an arsenal of dirty tricks to stop you from winning. From erasing your precious X's and locking cells, to literally dropping bombs on the board and faking its own victories! You'll need to stay one step ahead of its gravity-shifting, glitching, and rule-breaking mechanics.
Can you outsmart a machine that constantly cheats? Test your logic, adapt to unpredictable board mutations, and prove that human ingenuity can beat an unfair AI!

games.title: Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D
games.description: Dive into the exciting realm of Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D, where strategy combines with intense action. Control various powerful tanks, enhance your weapons and defenses, and prepare to confront formidable bosses that challenge your skills in this engaging online game. Play on both mobile and computer!

games.title: Brainrot Express
games.description:
**Brainrot Jump** is a dynamic platform adventure in which your task is to collect the most legendary Brainrots! Jump over dangerous chasms, overcome challenging platforms and hurry to get to rare characters before anyone else. Each successful jump brings you closer to adding the funniest, strangest and most iconic Brainrots to your collection.

Test your reaction and jump accuracy, and unlock more and more rare Brainrots as you progress. Regardless of whether you are hunting for your favorite characters or trying to collect a complete collection, each race will bring a lot of emotions and pleasant discoveries.

**Features**

* Addictive and addictive platform gameplay
* Collect dozens of unique and fun Brainrots
* Test your skills in challenging jumps over chasms and obstacles
* Unlock rare and legendary Brainrots
* Easy to start playing, difficult to become a master
* Create the most complete Brainroot collection
* Fast gaming sessions, ideal for short breaks
* Suitable for players of all ages

games.title: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color
games.description: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color is a vibrant brain teaser that blends block placement, color matching, and a playful water park vibe. You guide falling cubes to help cheerful bears enjoy their splash time. You solve increasingly clever puzzles, plan every drop carefully, and enjoy lively water visuals that make each challenge feel refreshing and satisfying.

games.title: Obby Space Challenge: Starships
games.description:
Obby Space Challenge: Starships is an exciting game where you get to fly starships. Collect energy capsules, earn trophies for your flights, and unlock new starships. Build a collection of the best companions, acquire the ultimate ship, and set out to explore all the locations in this cosmic world!

• Collect energy capsules!
• Earn trophies for your flights!
• Acquire companions!
• Switch starships!
• Unlock new locations!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: The game is about collecting capsules and flying a spaceship to earn trophy points.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: The game offers a variety of pet and spaceship skins, great graphics, an achievement system, and tasks to engage players.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: The more energy the character collects, the more trophies they will receive after the flight.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game features energy and trophies as currencies. Trophies can be used to purchase pets and spaceships to speed up energy acquisition.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers many pet and spaceship skins that come with enhancements.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to return?

A: Yes, the game offers rewards that players receive based on their time spent in the game. Rewards are refreshed daily.

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?

A: Music complements the game, but it is not necessary for gameplay.

games.title: Epicrolla
games.description: Epicrolla is a one-tap isometric roller. Your ball climbs a diamond grid hopping corner to corner — every tap flips its heading left or right, and it bounces off the edges. Survive the gaps, lava, boxes and spinning portals long enough to hit each stage's tile goal. Snatch item boxes for Invincibility, Coin Magnet, Slow-Mo, Dodge and Push power-ups, bank coins, and spend them on permanent upgrades, ball skins and a repeatable Second Chance. Easy to pick up, hard to master.

games.title: Magic Aim
games.description: Magic Aim is a real-time arcade artillery game starring a chibi magician. Read the shifting wind, charge your wand, and fire arcing elemental blasts that split in mid-air to clear waves of monsters across hilly terrain. Dash for a better angle, raise an energy shield to block incoming fire, grab item drops that supercharge your next shots, then warp to a fresh layout. Unlike classic turn-based artillery games, every shot is live and fast — mastery is reading arcs and wind on the fly. Four elements (Fire, Water, Thunder, Earth) each fly differently, so swapping changes how you read the same shot. Pixel-art, juicy, and easy to pick up for a quick run.

games.title: Laser Slasher
games.description: Laser Slasher is a vibrant casual puzzle-arcade game where you command laser turrets to smash blocks with satisfying ASMR effects. Designed for stress-free relaxation, it combines intuitive one-tap controls, progressive upgrades, turret customization. Perfect for quick breaks or extended play.

games.title: Tap, Think, Save the Kitten!
games.description:
Danger slithers closer! 

A colorful snake is stalking a helpless kitten, and only YOU can stop it! Tap away at the directional arrow-boxes in the right sequence to solve the puzzle and reload your colored gun. Match the colors, fire the bullets, and watch the beast shrink! Every second counts in this thrilling idle tap challenge. 

Can you outsmart the serpent and save the kitten? 
Download now and test your skills in the most addictive puzzle arcade game!

games.title: Color Match Rush
games.description:
Color Match Rush is a lightning-fast, one-thumb reflex arcade game built for quick sessions
and high-score obsession. A glowing ring of colored segments spins at the center of the
screen while colored dots rush inward toward a fixed gate at the top. Your only job sounds
simple: rotate the ring so the segment under the gate matches the color of the incoming dot.
Nail it and your score climbs; pick the wrong color even once and the run is over. There are
no second chances — just you, your reflexes, and the next dot closing in.
What makes Color Match Rush so addictive is how the pressure ramps up. You start with four
colors and a calm pace, but

games.title: Mem Brawl: Merge Simulator
games.description: Merge Brainrot memes! Combine Skibidi Toilet, Gugugaga, Granny and legendary brainrot characters. Clicker + Arena battles. Build the strongest meme squad!

games.title: Kitty Kitty
games.description: Kitty Kitty is a charming casual idle simulation game where players nurture and level up adorable kawaii cats in a festive snowy winter wonderland, collecting cat food as the core idle resource (with passive production like +50/s) to raise stats such as Sweetness and unlock new features via daily check-ins and challenges. Its unique appeal lies in the heartwarming blend of cozy cat-collection mechanics, customizable habitats (Toy Room, food bowls, Kitty Wiki, and recycling), and seasonal Christmas charm with Santa-hatted felines, decorated trees, and snowmen—all presented in vibrant, playful 2D art that emphasizes relaxed, feel-good feline care over competitive gameplay.

games.title: Buttons
games.description:
Experience a tactile plinko adventure in a hand-drawn scrapbook world with satisfying physics.

Battle grumpy felt monsters and enjoy a uniquely crafted visual style as you progress through the game.

games.title: Rat's House - Nonogram
games.description:
Build a home full of stories and coziness! 🐭✨

Amazing tenants are moving into your tower. From a shy book lover to a bold rocker or even an alien guest — they all need their perfect corner.

Don't just arrange furniture — befriend them! The residents give tasks, request specific items, and share thoughts in funny dialogues. 

Fulfill their requests to unfold the plot and open new floors. 💬🏠

Earn Cheese 🧀 for shopping by solving Japanese crosswords (nonograms). It’s a great brain workout!

What awaits you:
🎨 Turn empty rooms into design masterpieces.
🧩 Over 500 levels of varying difficulty.
❤️ 14 unique heroes with touching stories.
🌸 Bright seasonal events.

You will love this game if you enjoy:
🧠 Logic: Sudoku, crosswords, pen-and-paper puzzles;
🔨 Creativity: Home design and renovation games;
☕ Comfort: Kind stories, cute pets, and relaxing gameplay without rushing.

Move in all the fluffy friends and discover their secrets!

games.title: Spaceball Jump
games.description:
Spaceball Jump is a thrilling, physics-based arcade game where you must navigate a glowing astronaut ball through a treacherous and beautiful galaxy. Your goal is simple: hop from planet to planet, collect all the golden stars, and unlock the portal to warp to the next sector!

But space is full of dangers. You'll need to time your leaps perfectly to utilize the rotational momentum of the planets while avoiding deadly orbital spikes, giant death stars, and the endless void of space. With 25 levels of increasing difficulty—featuring moving platforms, chaotic planetary clusters, and tight precision jumps—do you have what it takes to conquer the galaxy?


Features

Orbital Physics: Use the spin of the planets to slingshot yourself across space.

Hazards & Collectibles: Dodge spinning spike walls and collect 3 stars in every level to open the escape portal!

games.title: SHADOW FORGE
games.description: Shadow Forge is a dark-fantasy Tower Defense × Action-RPG hybrid. Build and upgrade 10 unique towers while you command the Forge Master hero — dodge, cast 4 skills, and crush endless waves of shadow creatures across 8 maps and 20 waves with epic bosses. Level up to unlock powerful boons.

games.title: Tank Craft 2
games.description: Tank Craft 2 (also known as TankCraft 2: Hell Bosses War) is an exciting 2D action tank battle game with a unique crafting twist. Players build and customize their own tanks by assembling thousands of parts combinations, then engage in fast-paced side-scrolling combat to repel an infernal invasion from hellish bosses emerging from a raging volcano. The core idea revolves around experimentation: craft powerful, personalized war machines through upgrades and part tweaks, then battle waves of corrupted enemy tanks and towering demonic bosses in dynamic arenas filled with lava, rocks, and explosive action. Its standout features include endless build creativity, satisfying progression through levels, cartoonish yet intense visuals with cute tank characters, and the thrill of engineering your way to victory against apocalyptic threats.

games.title: Boba Blast
games.description:
Fast, head-to-head pearl-duel game. You and a rival each face a spinning mega-ball of colorful boba pearls. Shoot matching pearls to pop them in satisfying chain reactions, chip away at the cluster, and be the first to clear your ball.

Matches feel like a competitive arcade duel: aim carefully, manage limited shots, and race the clock while your opponent does the same. Wrong-color hits ricochet instead of popping, so every throw matters.

games.title: Hunting Master
games.description: Become the ultimate hunter in Hunting Master, a fun and strategic archery shooting game set in a beautiful desert world! Jump between floating islands and use your bow to hunt wild animals like boars and wolves with precise shots. The core idea is aim, power, and chain reactions — shoot arrows to defeat animals and collect points while upgrading your bow with powerful abilities. What makes it unique? Stunning floating island visuals, satisfying bow-shooting mechanics with glowing effects, multiple power-ups (Meteorite, Thunder, etc.), and addictive progression as you become a stronger hunter in this desert hunting adventure!

games.title: CraftMart
games.description:
Noob decided to go into business and open his own shop. And what do all the people of Minecraft want? That's right - to eat!

In Noob's shop you can always buy beet soup and bread! And also a lot of other food.

And now all the residents of CubeWorld rushed to the best store! Help Noob to serve all the customers! No one should go hungry! :)

Build new fields for wheat and beets, get a cow and a chicken and expand the shop to the maximum assortment!

Simulate a grocery shop in the world of Minecraft:

- plant turnips and wheat, raise chickens and a cow

- make turnip soup as well as warm bread

- serve your customers

- improve your means of production and your abilities

- hire workers to help you

Show your business skill!

games.title: Mole Kingdom Defense
games.description:
Mole Kingdom Defense is a charming tower defense adventure filled with brave little moles and endless battles!

Build your ultimate mole army, recruit powerful heroes, and defend your kingdom against waves of dangerous enemies. Each mole warrior has unique abilities—from fearless fighters and sharp archers to powerful mages with devastating magic.

Upgrade your heroes, unlock stronger weapons, and create the perfect strategy to defeat bosses and conquer challenging stages. With colorful graphics, adorable characters, and addictive idle progression, Mole Kingdom Defense offers endless fun for players of all ages.

Game Features:

• Cute and funny mole heroes
• Strategic tower defense gameplay
• Multiple hero classes and upgrades
• Fight epic bosses and enemy waves
• Idle rewards and easy progression
• Beautiful cartoon graphics and animations

Defend your kingdom and lead the Mole Army to victory!

games.title: Potion Kitchen
games.description: Potion Kitchen is a cosy crafting puzzle about running a potion shop at the edge of the market. Guests arrive with orders — one needs a potion of warmth, another a good night's sleep, and some speak in riddles and expect you to work it out. Mix ingredients in the cauldron, brew, and serve before your guest gives up. The recipe book starts empty: all 19 recipes are unlocked by brewing alone, and every one of them can be reasoned out rather than guessed, because the ingredients of a potion share one element.

games.title: Robot Unicorn Dash
games.description:
Enter a dreamy, neon world full of sparkles, stars, and rainbow roads. 
In Robot Unicorn Dash, your Robot Unicorn runs nonstop through magical landscapes where every second gets faster and harder. 
Jump over gaps, dodge dangerous obstacles (like dark crystals), and keep the run alive as long as you can while chasing a new high score.

games.title: Close Ads
games.description:
A fast chaos arcade game where your only goal is simple: close ads.
But every few levels, the ads become more annoying.

games.title: skyfall siege
games.description: In this fast paced aerial battleground, I wanted to create a pure, adrenaline-driven experience where every second counts. You’ll face relentless waves of enemies descending from the skies, and survival depends on your reflexes, precision, and smart movement.

games.title: Cartoon Traffic Racing Paper Derby
games.description:
Race through paper cartoon chaos!

Immerse yourself in dynamic traffic racing in a unique world of paper and cardboard, where tiny cardboard cars compete on busy roads. Maneuver between cars, avoid collisions, overcome obstacles, and utilize the environment!
Every race is a battle for first place. Huge stationery items, ramps, obstacles, cars, and other interactive elements transform each map into a veritable playground where you can find new ways to overtake, collide, and defeat opponents.
Unlock new cars with unique designs and powerful performance, customize them to suit your playstyle, and navigate increasingly challenging maps with intense traffic. Race through colorful arenas, weave through dense traffic, cause massive collisions, and prove that your cardboard car is the fastest on the road!

Key Features
Dynamic traffic racing – maneuver between cars, avoid collisions, and find the fastest way to victory.
Unique paper and cardboard world – a vibrant universe with oversized stationery and unusual locations.
Interactive environment – ​​use ramps, obstacles, and various objects to gain an advantage.
Modern, colorful graphics – stylish visual design with a unique papercraft atmosphere.

New cars and bonuses – win races, earn rewards, and unlock new content.
Destruction and chaos – crash into obstacles, cause accidents, and turn every race into a true road rage.

games.title: Sledding Hills
games.description:
Sledding Hill is a whole world of sliding games. Explore different worlds: deserts, snowy mountains, and wild forests. Grab your sled and slide down the hill!

* 🌎 Explore Worlds — Unlock new levels, sandy deserts, snowy mountains, and more.
* 🎁 Unlock Characters & Upgrade Gear — Collect coins to upgrade your ride and personalize your adventure.
* 🎳 Mini Games — Test your skills in different mini-games and place your best score on the leaderboard.
* 👀 Secret Skins — Unlock secret characters and more.

Stay with us, and we will bring more maps, mini-games, and more content.
Subscribe to our Discord and share your thoughts and ideas.

games.title: Constella - single line puzzle
games.description:
Starlight - Single Line Drawing Puzzles
Relax and unwind as you connect the stars to reveal beautiful constellations in this calming, line-complete puzzle experience. Journey through a serene celestial atmosphere where every single-line puzzle you solve brings a new shape to life. Draw your continuous path through the cosmos to discover hidden figures—from a peaceful desert cactus and a crisp apple, to a majestic celestial turtle and a starry crab. Enjoy a tranquil game that gently challenges your mind while soothing your soul.

games.title: Cube Smash
games.description: Enter the exciting realm of Cube Smash, a free online game where you break colorful cubes. Use strategy to choose projectiles, earn currency for upgrades, and unlock various ammo. Prepare for greater challenges, whether you're playing on mobile or desktop!

games.title: Snake Wiggle Master!
games.description:
Looking for a fun snake maze game that’s easy to start but keeps you thinking?

In Snake Wiggle Master!, you guide a snake through clever mazes where one smart move can open the whole path.

Move your snake through tight corridors, plan the right order, and race against the clock. ⏰ The challenge comes from thinking fast but smart. Some paths look safe at first, but one wrong move can block the maze completely. Choose carefully, move efficiently, and clear the level before time runs out. ✨

With simple controls and clean visuals, Snake Wiggle Master! is easy to play and exciting to master.

games.title: Number Shooter: Ball Blast
games.description:
Number Shooter is an endless arcade shooter built around one idea: the number on the ball IS your score.

Numbered balls slide in from the walls and bounce around while your cannon fires nonstop. Every hit chips
their number down, and when it reaches zero the ball bursts into two smaller ones — so a single big ball
cascades into a screen full of targets. You never clear a level; the waves just keep coming and getting harder.

Between shots you grab drops that raise your fire rate and damage mid-run, and the coins you collect buy
permanent upgrades, 15 ball themes and 10 cannons that carry over to your next run.

games.title: King Rugni Tower Defense
games.description:
A classic Tower Defense game with lots of enemies and territories to conquer. Join King Rügni on his epic adventure against hordes of elementals.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's a tower defense game where you need to place and upgrade towers that shoot at enemies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game features a cool character - King Rugni, several maps with different themes like forests and winter settings, great design, music, and effects. There are different types of enemies with various attack styles - some walk directly on the path while others fly straight to the target.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what are they used for (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Every defeated enemy rewards us with gems used for building new towers. There is also gold earned by winning levels, which is spent on upgrading existing towers and purchasing new ones.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: To level up faster, you need to win levels by defeating enemies and completing all waves. This earns you gold that can be spent on tower upgrades and new purchases.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what is the impact? Does paying accelerate game progress?
A: No.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are available (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: No.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game stands out with its excellent design and music.

Q: Is there any customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: No.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to encourage players to return?
A: No.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: It is preferable to play with sound because it enhances the experience.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, "match-three" puzzles within a strategy game.
A: No.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)
A: 30

games.title: Tap tap Swing
games.description: A simple casual game Touch to fly, hold to hover, and release to fall. In this game, your agility will be tested. Pass through obstacles and avoid crashing. Avoid all obstacles and don't fall to stay alive. Enjoy the beautiful music and complete the levels that challenge your adrenaline.

games.title: Zombie Terminator
games.description: Zombie Terminator is an intense zombie shooting survival game set in a post-apocalyptic city overrun by the undead. You play as one of the last survivors, armed with powerful weapons to fight endless waves of zombies. Combining action shooting, survival gameplay, and strategic movement, the game delivers thrilling combat and nonstop excitement. Defeat enemies, collect rewards, upgrade your weapons, and survive against increasingly dangerous zombie hordes. With immersive environments, challenging missions, and fast-paced gameplay, every battle feels epic and rewarding!

games.title: Baby Sitter: Merge 2
games.description:
Help a young mother take care of her restless baby.
Relax in this colorful game! Connect tiles and decorate the nursery.

games.title: Safari Match
games.description: Safari Match is an exciting, jungle-themed memory puzzle game where players test their focus and speed by finding matching animal cards. Navigate through beautifully illustrated exotic wildlife cards against a ticking clock. As you progress, the grid expands, offering greater challenges and higher rewards. Unlock special power-ups like 'Reveal All' or 'Row Reveal' to help you conquer the hardest levels. Featuring vibrant artwork, dynamic animations, global leaderboards, and an immersive safari atmosphere, it's a premium brain-teasing adventure suitable for all ages!

games.title: My SweetStreet Shop
games.description: Sweet Street Shop is a charming shop management simulation where you run your own candy and pastry store. Serve customers, collect money, unlock new products, upgrade your character, hire helpers, and expand the shop into a successful sweet business

games.title: Sleepwalkers
games.description: Discover a magical world with Sleepwalkers, where colorful characters need your help to find their beds. Navigate challenges and avoid dangers in this free online adventure. Play on any device and unveil the secrets of this captivating fairytale realm.

games.title: Time Travel: Tower Rush - TD
games.description:
TRAVEL THROUGH TIME & DESTROY ENEMY BASES!  Step into a thrilling time-hopping journey in this dynamic idle tower defense game! Build and evolve your ultimate tower armed with deadly weapons, powerful abilities, and epic upgrades. Battle your way through the ages — from ancient kingdoms to futuristic warzones and magical lands. Can you stand against the relentless waves of demons, skeletons, and mythical beasts?
 BUILD & UPGRADE YOUR FORTRESS
 Expand your stronghold floor by floor into a towering war machine
 Equip it with lasers, traps, and a variety of unique firearms
 Strengthen your power with upgrades and special synergy effects
 Personalize your tower with exclusive styles and boosts

games.title: Canyon Drifter
games.description: 2D moto-trial built around tough tracks and dialing in your bike. Pick a build for the dirt and the terrain, clear steep climbs and jumps by leaning for balance, and fight for the best time on the leaderboard. Stuck on a track you just can't clear? Head to the garage, retune your bike, and suddenly it's rideable.

games.title: Puzzle Candle
games.description:
Your goal is simple: Reach the end of each level -- but getting there won't be easy.
Solve tricky puzzles and master precise platforming to clear the stages. Use a variety of helpful items to turn the challenge in your favor and find clever ways to progress.
Explore a total of 50 levels set in different environments, each offering new obstacles and surprises.

games.title: Squid Game Evolution: All Characters!
games.description:
Squid Game Evolution: All Characters! is a crazy clicker with strategy elements where you meet all the heroes of the legendary series and upgrade them into incredible forms!

👆 Tap on the characters from Squid Game to earn coins.
💰 Buy new heroes and unlock more and more familiar faces.
⚡ Merge identical characters and watch them evolve into even rarer versions.
📈 Every tap becomes stronger, and your income grows many times over!

But that’s not all:
Between tapping sessions, soldiers will attack you.
⚔️ Build your squad of characters and fight them, showing the true power of the team you’ve managed to gather and upgrade.
🏆 Defeat enemies, earn rewards, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

This is not just a clicker — it’s a full evolution of your favorite heroes and intense battles where every step brings you closer to victory!

games.title: Bloxorz: Color Block Roll
games.description:
A rolling-cube puzzle where color is everything. Roll a painted cube to the exit, landing only on tiles that match the face touching the ground. Solve 60 levels of color-matching paths — with platforms that rotate, move, and teleport — in a satisfying test of spatial thinking.
Fans of classics like Bloxorz will feel right at home.

games.title: Noobik Arena - 99 nights
games.description: Noobik Arena - 99 nights is a fast 3D survival arena where the hero fights waves of monsters, collects coins and experience, unlocks upgrades, and improves weapons. Between waves, you can build defenses: place turrets, fences, and barracks, select buildings with a click, and upgrade their stats. Survive as long as possible by combining weapons, grenades, dashes, perks, and defensive structures against increasingly dangerous enemies.

games.title: Capybara Let's Go: Zombie Rush
games.description:
Welcome to a relaxing casual game that combines merge gameplay and strategic auto battles!
Start your journey with a group of adorable pets. Drag and place them on the battlefield, and merge two pets of the same level to get stronger upgraded ones. You can refresh the pet pool to get new companions and plan your layout carefully to make the most of limited space.
Once your team is ready, start the battle! All pets will attack enemies automatically. As you clear foes, your team will level up and unlock random powerful skills, including damage boost, critical strike, healing and area attacks. Choose skills wisely to build your unique team.
Advance through dozens of regular stages, challenge tough Boss levels and explore surprise bonus stages for rich rewards. Collect more styles of cute pets, raise and star them up to unlock greater power.
Easy to pick up, fun to master! Experience endless joy with pet merging, strategic layout and exciting battles right now!

games.title: Flag Learn
games.description:
Flag Learn is a geography quiz game that helps you truly memorize every flag,
capital, and US state — not just guess them. A smart spaced-repetition system
tracks each flag you've seen and brings back the ones you struggle with until
you master them all. Beyond the learning mode, you'll find a whole collection
of challenges: Daily Flagle, Paint the Flag, Border Guess, timed Highscore speedruns with a global leaderboard,
and real-time PvP battles against friends. Clean night-sky design, satisfying
progress tracking, and quick rounds make it perfect for both short sessions
and serious learning.

games.title: Mahjong Magic Islands
games.description:
Mahjong with history. Puzzle and adventure. Play and win! Connect tiles and collect prizes.

The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong Magic Islands features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format. Collecting components for magic spells adds a fun layer to the gameplay, and meeting cute magical creatures to help out gives the varied levels of the game more significant depth.

* The mysterious worlds of the Magic Islands await discovery.
* Journey through the Mahjong Magic Islands solving fun brain teasers.
* Meet mysterious and mythical creatures, and help them on their way!
* Hunt down magic ingredients and make magic spells.
* Search and connect tiles.
* Mahjong Solitaire

games.title: Draw To Smash!
games.description: Test your brainpower with the captivating logic game, Draw To Smash! The goal is simple: sketch shapes to eliminate troublesome bad eggs. This engaging free online game mixes creativity and strategy, offering fun on both phones and computers, with evolving challenges as you progress.

games.title: Brain Coloring Puzzle
games.description:
Discover Italian Brainrot Meme Coloring Puzzle Game
Step into the viral world of Italian Brainrot Meme Characters, where over thirty absurd creatures await your palette. No numbers, no hints—only your eye for color and a playful spirit.

Meet the Stars

Bombardiro Crocodilo: Our most fiendish color‑match boss.

Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur: A viral sensation inspired by Italian Brainrot.

Shimpanzinni Bananinni, Boneca Ambalabu, Tralalero Tralala and many more bring humor and challenge.

Why You’ll Love It

Brain‑Boosting Fun: Sharpens visual memory and logic.

Creative Freedom: No right answer—trust your instincts.

Offline Play: Dive in anytime, anywhere.

Designed for Ages 12+: Simple enough for kids, intriguing for teens and adults.

Ready to color outside the lines? Tap Install and unleash your inner artist on the most delightfully absurd paint‑puzzle around!
