games.title: Eternal Dance
games.description: Eternal Dance is a calm, meditative arcade game about keeping balance. Two koi — one black, one white — endlessly circle a glowing orb in a hand-painted zen pond. Drifting ink threatens the orb from the dark, and only the koi of the matching color can dissolve it. Guide their dance, protect the orb, and lose yourself in the flow. Easy to learn, hard to master — a one-touch game that trades frantic reflexes for focus and serenity.

games.title: Ragdoll Playground: Break Him
games.description:
Welcome to Ragdoll Playground: Break Him! Control a ragdoll, smash it into dangerous traps, and score points. Crash into walls, jump into spikes, and fly across the arena!
Place traps with your mouse to cause maximum damage. The more damage your ragdoll takes, the more traps you unlock!

games.title: Team Loyalty
games.description: Dive into the thrilling world of Team Loyalty, where you command a growing army. Start with one unit and strategically pass through gates to boost your numbers. Overcome challenges and dominate your foes with strength in numbers. Are you ready to build the ultimate team to triumph?

games.title: Mars Colony
games.description:
Rob the Robot, you have been given a crucial mission: to prepare Mars for human settlement! Mine resources. Build factories. Recycle resources. Prepare Mars for human settlement!
"Mars Colony" is an idle game. The game is similar to "My Little Universe."

games.title: Cut In Half
games.description: Cut In Half is a casual mobile slicing action game where the core concept revolves around precisely cutting objects, obstacles, and elements in half using a knife or sword to clear paths and advance. In its vibrant low-poly 3D cartoon world of grassy campsites and nature scenery, players simply tap to start each stage, collect coins for upgrades, and boost attack power (shown at 100% Lv. 1 in the screenshot) while navigating cute characters like the smiling yellow emoji ball. What makes it unique is the satisfying physics-based cutting mechanic combined with effortless one-tap controls, an intuitive upgrade system, and rewarding progression that turns simple slices into addictive, visually charming challenges.

games.title: Red-Blue Forge
games.description:
Red-Blue Forge is a fast reaction arcade game where you rotate core orbs to match incoming embers and survive as long as possible. Start in classic 2-core mode (Red/Blue), then unlock 4-core mode (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow) for higher intensity and a x3 score multiplier. The game features smooth touch/mouse controls, quick sessions, and a “Ready” start gate so each run begins on your command.

Between runs, collected materials feed a persistent Forge Tree progression system. Temper upgrades to improve control, stability, scoring bonuses, and long-run mastery. Every match rewards precision and timing, while long-term progression gives players clear goals and replay value. Ideal for mobile and desktop, Red-Blue Forge combines skill-based gameplay, readable visuals, and satisfying build progression in short, addictive runs.

games.title: Jelly Merge: Dooper
games.description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Jelly Merge. Slide colorful jellies across the board, merge all jelly elements into one, and solve each level with smart moves. Plan carefully, avoid obstacles, and try to finish each puzzle in the fewest steps possible.

games.title: Obby Parkour: Crazy Descent
games.description:
👋 Welcome to "Obby Parkour: Crazy Descent" — a fast-paced 3D parkour testing your speed and reactions!

Your main goal is to descend through generated platforms as low as possible while dodging moving obstacles. One wrong move and you fall straight into the abyss! The lower you fall, the faster you go: with every platform passed, your speed constantly increases, turning the parkour into a wild rush.

✨ Game Features:
🗺️ New levels: cover the distance and unlock new exciting stages!
🚀 Dynamic acceleration: reach crazy speeds and test your reflexes.
🤑 Coin collection: pick up gold coins right on the platforms as you drop.
🛍️ Cool shop: buy pets, viral memes (Six-Seven, Ballerina Capuchina, Tralalero, and more), and stylish accessories — from glasses and capes to the legendary Dominus!

🏆 Ready to become the ultimate fall champion? Jump in and show what you've got!

games.title: Catoom! - Bomb Barrel
games.description:
Imagine a game where, instead of the usual movement on your feet (or paws), you roll... a barrel! But simply rolling isn't enough — to gain truly incredible speed, you need to throw bombs and use their explosions for momentum. Every correct move is a combination of timing and tactics.

You'll experience:

Unusual movement mechanics — roll on a barrel and learn to control the chaos of explosions.

Lots of enemies — for classic use of explosions.

Destructible environments — explode tiles and carve your way through.

This isn't just an arcade game; it's a test of reaction, ingenuity, and the ability to find solutions, where physics itself becomes your ally.

games.title: Luna And The Magic Maze
games.description: Join Luna in her enchanting quest through a mystical autumn forest in "Luna And The Magic Maze." Solve mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets. Each stage presents fresh challenges, proving that willpower can be as powerful as magic, whether you play on your phone or computer.

games.title: Solitaire Stars
games.description: Do you love playing Solitaire? Get ready for Solitaire: Yukon Play Cards, a fun and free card game! This is a special type of Solitaire game called Yukon Solitaire. It’s super relaxing, easy to learn, and fun to play. Play this Solitaire game anytime and anywhere for free.

games.title: Emoji Memory: Find a Pair
games.description:
You need to turn over the cards, trying to find pairs of identical ones.

If two different cards are turned over, they are automatically turned back over, giving the player a little time to memorize them.

The level will be completed when the player opens all pairs of cards in the playing field.

There are two additional game modes in which you can set records by competing with other players: for time and for the minimum number of moves.

games.title: Rough Ball
games.description: Rough Ball is an addictive and challenging physics-based platformer where you control a cheeky smiley ball on a dangerous journey through rocky caves. Your goal is simple but tricky: roll, bounce, and slide carefully to reach the red flag without falling into the deadly pits. With slippery slopes, tricky jumps, and cute skull warnings, every level tests your precision and timing in this fun "do not fall" adventure!

games.title: Emoji Guess Master
games.description: Emoji Guess Master! is a fun-filled adventure that tests your creativity and quick thinking. Match two emojis to a given word, challenging your knowledge and intuition. With engaging gameplay, a variety of difficulty levels, and vibrant visuals, you’ll improve your cognitive skills while having a blast. Perfect for quick play sessions or longer challenges.

games.title: Draw and Guess Online
games.description: Draw and Guess is a fun and fast-paced online multiplayer game where creativity meets quick thinking! Players take turns drawing a given word while others try to guess what it is in real-time. The faster you guess correctly, the more points you earn. Compete with friends or players from around the world and show off your drawing skills!

games.title: Match The Brainrot
games.description: Match the Brain Rot is a fast, colorful match-3 puzzle game built around viral meme characters. Players swap tiles, trigger cascades, earn XP, and climb endless levels with increasing goals. Its unique mix of chaotic humor, collectible character skins, highscore sharing, rewarded ads, and coin-powered purchases keeps every session fresh.

games.title: Cats Go!
games.description: Cats Go! - is a game from the genre of obstacle course passage. In this game you need to play as a cat to pass the map and get to the fish. Hardcore platformer challenges you, can you beat the game? The cats are waiting for you to go only forward!

games.title: shrinkzone.io
games.description: Welcome to Shrinkzone, a lightning-fast, doodle-style battle royale where survival depends on your appetite! Start off as a tiny blob and devour food scattered across the map to grow larger and stronger. But beware — other players are doing the same. Use quick reflexes and clever movement to avoid the giants and hunt down the weak. As the shrinking safe zone forces players closer together, only the smartest and hungriest will survive. Are you ready to dominate the arena and claim the top spot?

games.title: Roll to Riches
games.description: Roll to Riches is a colorful 3D arcade simulator where you train your rolling wheel, race as far as possible, earn Cash and Trophies, collect pets, unlock new wheels and trails, claim rewards, rebirth for stronger progression, and work toward new worlds.

games.title: Fit Master 3D
games.description: Fit Master 3D is a fun online puzzle game focused on arranging food items into matching boxes. No downloads or sign-ups are required. Enjoy the challenge with burgers, fries, and more across various devices. Each level offers tasty twists and a unique sorting experience.

games.title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
games.description: Tap into your creativity with Paint Sponges Puzzle, a captivating online game that requires strategic skills and maze-solving ability. Navigate your colorful sponge across the grid, leaving a vibrant trail. Challenges increase as you advance, providing a fun blend of logic and artistry on both mobile and computer platforms.

games.title: Capyballra - Capybara Ball Collector!
games.description:
Rotate the maze, roll to collect, unlock cute skins!

Twist the maze with your mouse or your finger, send your capyballas rolling into the pipe. Simple one-touch controls, snappy physics, and clever level design make every run satisfying. Use coins to unlock new Capyballra skins—classic, seasonal, and rare animated variants—to show off your favorites.

Perfect for quick runs or chasing full-collection completion: rotate, collect, unlock.

games.title: Steve Evolution Mega Clicker
games.description: Experience an exhilarating adventure with Steve Evolution Mega Clicker, a captivating game filled with excitement. Upgrade your skills, earn coins, and discover unique abilities with every click, all while enjoying stunning visuals. Play on any device for endless entertainment and an engaging clicking experience!

games.title: Noob: Big Item Sorting
games.description:
Do you enjoy keeping things tidy? Do you enjoy sorting things?

Then this game is for you! Introducing a fun new game all about sorting and cleaning!

😻In this exciting puzzle, you'll find identical objects and match them together. Arrange the objects so that two identical ones end up next to each other and form a double.

🎁Match items in pairs to advance through the levels!
Cleaning has never been so enjoyable and exciting!

🎮"Noob: The Big Object Sorting Game" is a light and calming game suitable for anyone who loves order, regardless of age or gender!

games.title: Village of Colors
games.description: Dive into the lively realm of Village of Colors, where your imagination is key. In this free online game, defend the village by sketching protective barriers. With unique villagers and challenging foes, you can pause time and boost your skills to keep your vibrant home safe.

games.title: Pinata Color Smash
games.description:
Smash Color Pinatas by Selecting the matching color bat. You can Select Bats on top and then the bottom bats are revealed.
You can Place Extra Bats on 5 Tile Slots and use them when needed.
Pinatas Color Smash is a colorful and engaging puzzle game where players aim to break Pinatas by selecting matching colored bats. The game offers a fun and casual experience suitable for all ages.

games.title: Stackitaire
games.description:
Stackitaire is an addictive solitaire card-sorting puzzle. Shuffle through stacks of mixed cards and sort them into complete suits — one suit per stack. Every level deals a new layout that gets trickier as locked cards, hidden decks, and tighter stacks are introduced. With hundreds of levels, daily bonuses, and handy boosters to rescue a tough hand, Stackitaire is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and satisfying puzzle play.

Tips:
Keep at least one stack empty as a holding spot — it gives you room to reorganize.
Think a few moves ahead before placing a card; getting blocked is how levels get tough.
Use Undo before spending a Hint.

games.title: Furry Kung Fu
games.description:
Furry Kung Fu is a fun fighting game with cute cartoon graphics. You play as Catsei or his student Kung Fu Cat. You need to hit the opponent with a lot of punches, while dodging all kinds of objects flying at you, such as balls, comets, fire and pots. It's so much fun!

Engage in an epic Kung Fu battle with your opponent. Get coins, unlock player skins and new weapons!

Bright and memorable characters will keep you entertained, and simple game controls allow you to focus on battling countless hordes of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other animals. Can you collect weapons in battle and unlock all available maps? Two playable characters to choose from.

games.title: Bottle Bottle
games.description:
Bottle Bottle is a casual jumping game that is easy to play but challenging to master.

In the game, you control a bottle and help it jump from one platform to another. With simple tap controls, the bottle flips and jumps forward. Perfect timing and rhythm are the key to landing safely and going further.

Clean visuals and smooth animations make the gameplay relaxing and fun. Try again and again to beat your best distance!

games.title: Crocodile Online - Draw and Guess
games.description: "Crocodile Online - Draw and Guess" is a cozy online party game where one player draws a word, and the others try to guess it as quickly as possible. You can play with friends in a private room or jump straight into a quick game with other players. The built-in chat helps you discuss your guesses and have fun, and the leaderboard system keeps track of your progress and shows you the best guessers. The game works directly in your browser, without downloading, supports keyboard and mouse, and is perfect for short sessions after school or work.

games.title: Zombie Wave Arena
games.description: Zombie Wave Arena is a fast top-down arcade survival shooter. Blast endless zombie hordes, earn coins, and upgrade six guns from pistol to legendary Ray Gun. Face nine unique zombie mutations, ten escalating bosses, and five rotating arenas. Grab pickups, hurl grenades, and survive  on desktop or one thumb mobile controls.

games.title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
games.description:
Tap on the screen, that will make the ball bounce higher and higher. The ball has one color, and can pass through obstacle with the same color, or sneak in between obstacles with different colors.

Easy-to-play and addictive !

games.title: SMod: Sandbox in Backrooms
games.description: SMod: Sandbox in Backrooms is a mod-style game based on the sandbox and the Backrooms. It is a real-time simulator with enemies spawning and levels to complete. In this game, you can spawn enemies using a portal gun, complete quests, and search for weapons.

games.title: Epic Mine Idle
games.description:
⛏️ Dig at full speed! Break rocks and extract rare resources. But don't let your guard down: keep an eye on your health (HP) to avoid being caught off guard by a cave-in.

🔥 Hot work! Use powerful drills for fast mining. But beware—the equipment can overheat! Optimize your timing and let your tools cool down to keep digging without stopping.

💎 Real treasures. From sparkling sapphires to pure gold—collect a collection of the rarest minerals. The deeper you mine, the more valuable your loot!

👷 Stylish hero. Your miner is a true professional in a fashionable blue suit. Who said mining can't be stylish?

⚡ Leveling and upgrades. Improve your equipment, increase your health, and reduce your drill's cooldown time. Become the most efficient miner in history!

games.title: Yeti Run
games.description: Yeti Run is an endless skiing game where the mountain never runs out but your luck does. You carve down the slope with one finger, ski between gates to build combos, and dodge trees, rocks, and lift pylons at increasingly stupid speeds. There is also a yeti. He will not end your run, but if he catches you he shoves you into the deep snow and wrecks your combo, which honestly feels worse. Collect snowmen as you go and spend them on skins in the shop. Every run ends the same way, but the flag marking your best distance is always sitting there, daring you to pass it.

games.title: Unravel Eggs Puzzle
games.description: Celebrate Easter weekend in style this year with the sweet new puzzle game, Unravel Eggs Puzzle! Complete each level by untangling eggs such that each line connecting eggs is not intersected by any other line connecting eggs. Warm up with some light puzzles and work your way up to an egg-tangling like you've never seen! Happy Easter!

games.title: Mole In The Hole
games.description:
Gameplay Overview

Dual Terrain Challenge: Navigate through layers of stone and sand, each requiring a specific tool for efficient digging.
Stone Blocks: Use the pickaxe to break through solid stone barriers.
Sand Blocks: Switch to the shovel to swiftly move through loose sand.
Treasure Troves: Keep an eye out for special blocks embedded with gold. Breaking these not only clears your path but also boosts your score.

games.title: Mine Mining Islands 2: Skyblock City!
games.description:
Dive into a world of mining adventures and build your own city!

— Become the mayor: upgrade buildings, trade with villagers, and grow your city
— Explore islands: discover new lands and mine valuable resources
— Upgrade your character: improve speed, strength, and luck
— Fight and defend: protect the city from monster raids and battle in the arena
— Earn wealth: sell resources and become the most successful player

Are you ready to become the best mayor and hero of this world?

games.title: Build levels – earn money!
games.description: Get ready for an addictive challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and aim for the holes in each round. After every round, hit the store to grab powerful upgrades and cool items to boost your progress. Complete levels, collect diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to level up faster. How far can you push your skills? The further you go, the bigger the rewards!

games.title: Cube Crushers
games.description:
Welcome to Cube Crushers, a fun and satisfying sorting puzzle game filled with colorful cake slices, cute cube characters, and smart puzzle challenges.

Tap the cake slices on the grid, send them to the conveyor, and unlock hidden cube crushers behind them. Each crusher has its own color and eats only the matching cake slices. Choose your moves carefully because every tap can change the puzzle result.

Cube Crushers is easy to play but becomes more challenging as you progress. With cute characters, smooth effects, colorful visuals, and handcrafted levels, this game gives you a relaxing yet strategic puzzle experience.

games.title: Bubble Foxy
games.description:
Welcome to a colorful Bubble Shooter adventure! Join the adorable fox on a journey through magical worlds filled with cute animal bubbles, exciting puzzles, and fun challenges.

Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear the board, create powerful combos, and overcome tricky obstacles. Explore beautiful locations, unlock new stages, and enjoy relaxing gameplay suitable for players of all ages.

Game Features:
• Hundreds of exciting levels.
• Easy one-touch controls.
• Bright 3D graphics and adorable characters.
• Smooth animations and satisfying effects.
• Daily rewards and fun challenges.
• Play offline anytime.

Whether you're looking to relax or test your puzzle-solving skills, Bubble Shooter offers endless fun for everyone!

games.title: Mech Frontline: Last Stand
games.description: This is a roguelike turret game featuring gacha mechanics and base building. It contains abundant game content, along with a huge variety of turrets and sets with unique effects.

games.title: Car And Truck Parking Game
games.description: Welcome to the world of car and truck parking games. Get ready to experience the best of both worlds with a car and truck parking game. Realistic and addictive parking simulator where you can test your skills driving both cars and massive trucks. This game brings you a full driving experience in one powerful package. Precision, patience, and control are the keys to success. Park your vehicle perfectly, avoid obstacles, and complete dozens of increasingly difficult levels.

games.title: Ragdoll Fury
games.description:
You don't play a hero — you ARE the WEAPON! Grip the hilt, swing fast and tear through hordes of dummies. Every hit is driven by real ragdoll physics, sending enemies flying across the arena. Wield an arsenal of 15 blades and guns across five classes — from Knife and Katana to Sawn-off, Machine Gun and Grenade Launcher — with a premium Laser Blade and Minigun to unlock with gems. Many pack their own special move: ground slam, spin, dash, blade throw.

Each wave hits harder: armored robots, kamikaze bombers, shield bots
and towering bosses, while special waves throw hordes and gold rushes
at you. After every wave pick one of three roguelite upgrades — damage, crit, burn, freeze, chain explosions, knockback and dozens more. Chain the elements into combos (shatter, wildfire, detonation), and at wave 10 trigger your weapon's EVOLUTION. Ring out enemies, keep your combo alive and climb the leaderboard.

games.title: Pow
games.description: Have you ever taken care your pet!? Feed it, clean it, play with it and watch it grow up while leveling up? This is all possible is this brand new Pow game for web and mobile. Feed, nurture and take care of your Pow. Play different games in games room and collect coins to buy food to feed your pow and buy decoration to customize your room! Also challenge your friends in 3 fun minigames!

games.title: Get Off My Farm!
games.description:
Protect your farm from relentless waves of mutant pests in this action-packed defense shooter!
Your quiet farmland is swarmed by strange and dangerous creatures, and only your guns and quick reflexes can keep them away from your crops. Blast through incoming enemies and pick up temporary power-ups along the way — rapid-fire shots, explosive ammo, health refills, or extra energy for your electric fence.

Survive enough waves and the stage ends, giving you a choice of random upgrades: unlock new weapons, call in a crop duster airstrike, slow down enemy hordes, attract power-ups with a magnet, and more. As you advance, new heroes with unique styles and abilities become available.

Every run feels fresh thanks to randomized upgrades and ever-growing chaos. Can you hold the line and prove yourself as the ultimate defender of the farm?

games.title: HoleMart
games.description:
HoleMart is a fun and addictive casual game where you control a growing hole inside a busy market.
Move around the area, swallow objects, and expand your size as you consume more items.

Start small by absorbing tiny goods, shelves, and carts. As your hole grows bigger, you’ll be able to swallow larger objects and clear the market faster. The more you consume, the stronger and bigger your hole becomes.

Simple controls, satisfying growth, and smooth gameplay make HoleMart perfect for quick play sessions and endless fun.

games.title: Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training
games.description:
Challenge your memory, speed and attention in "Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training". Watch boxes appear, remember the count, then submit your guess faster and more accurate each round wins.

Enjoy single-player focus mode or competitive rounds vs local friend or multiplayer. Simple tap controls, short rounds, addictive replayability perfect for quick brain workouts on desktop and mobile.

Train memory, logic, agility and reaction time now!

games.title: Traffic Craft Rider
games.description: Ride through craft-style traffic, dodge cars and bikes, collect coins, upgrade your motorcycle, and beat your best distance.

games.title: Heroic knight
games.description: Heroic Knight is an engaging puzzle adventure game where you guide a valiant knight through treacherous terrains to achieve glory and seize hidden treasures. This free-to-play, browser-based game requires no download or registration, allowing you to dive directly into an epic medieval quest. Strategically maneuver through obstacles, outsmart cunning traps, and vanquish formidable foes on your journey. The game's captivating 2D world is perfect for fans of mind-bending puzzles and adventurous escapades, offering a seamless experience on both desktop and mobile platforms.

games.title: Easter Rabbit Style
games.description: Celebrate the Easter season with style! Join adorable girls in a fun-filled egg hunt and dress-up adventure. Find hidden eggs, style cute spring outfits, and top off the look with playful accessories like bunny ears. Dive into the festive spirit with Easter Rabbit Style!

games.title: Head Jump
games.description: Speed Run Maze Maps is a thrilling runner game with fast action and vibrant mazes. The hero runs automatically and must dodge traps. In this game, one must jump, slide, and climb to avoid hidden obstacles. Moreover, the player should respond quickly to each twist and turn. In addition, the maze layout is tricky and full of surprises.

games.title: JigRot
games.description: JigRot is a chill puzzler: drag scattered pieces, snap them together, and merge clusters until the full crazy brainrot picture locks in. Easy to learn, smooth to play, and built for a relaxing flow — one oddball pack after another when you want to unwind without pressure.

games.title: Maskinery Idle
games.description: Maskinery Idle is an incremental clicker game where you explore mysterious islands, fight enemies, and collect powerful masks that grant unique abilities. Clear all tiles on each location's grid to progress through 5 stages. Defeat the Boss on the final stage to complete the zone and unlock the next one. Collect gold to buy upgrades, earn energy to level up your masks, and use the Rebirth system

games.title: 3D Pyramid Maze
games.description:
A 3D maze that IS a mountain. Roll a glowing ball up a stepped square
pyramid, climbing terrace by terrace from the base edge to the golden
summit — the maze wraps all four faces, so solving it and climbing it
are the same act.

A red chaser hunts you through the same open corridors you use. It
paths as freely as you do, and catching you sends you back down the
mountain. Gold coins are scattered across all four sides, most of them
off the safe route, so every detour is a gamble.

25 hand-tuned pyramids, an overview map, a daily challenge, and four
hand-lit looks that run from desert sunrise to starlit night — three
of them unlocked by exploring, alongside ten cosmetic rewards that
never expire. Pull the camera back at any moment and the whole pyramid
frames itself.

Not in the mood for a chase? The comfort settings are free and always
available: slow the chaser, keep your progress when caught, or switch
the chase off entirely and just climb.

games.title: Stick Roll Arena
games.description:
Challenge your skills in Stick Roll Arena !



Roll the dice to summon your stickman army and push the enemy team off the platform.

Use strategy and timing to defeat your opponents in exciting 1v1 battles.



Features:

- Unique colorful stickmans

- Satisfying push mechanics and physics

- Simple one-touch controls

- Addictive gameplay with increasing difficulty

- Beatiful vibrant graphics



Can you become the ultimate arena champion? Roll the dice and find out !

games.title: Smash & Merge Balls
games.description:
Short Description: A skill-based arcade game with colorful physics.

Full Description: In this game, you control a character that starts a fusion chain reaction! 
Strike the colorful balls to get them moving. 
The key rule: when two balls of the same color collide, they merge, and you earn points. 
Create massive chains of mergers to maximize your high score!


(lore)
(from the Showman):
Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! Welcome to the greatest show in the cosmos — the Arena of Fusion!

Here is your instrument of chaos — the mighty merger mallet! Don't be shy, give it a swing! 
Your mission is brilliantly simple: step onto the arena floor and prepare for a rainbow deluge! 
Smash those colorful spheres, make them crash, and when two of the same color meet — 
BOOM! — they fuse into a glorious explosion of points!

games.title: Rolling In Gears
games.description: Rolling In Gears is an engaging puzzle physics platformer game where you control a ball navigating through a series of mechanical challenges. The game’s main mechanic revolves around rotating gears and moving platforms to guide the ball towards its target destination. Players need to carefully maneuver through the levels, using precision and timing to overcome obstacles and reach the end of each stage.

games.title: Soldiers Runner
games.description: Gather troops, defeat enemies, collect rewards, upgrades, and destroy the great wall to rescue the grand prize that increases with each level!

games.title: Guess the Craft: Blocky Recipes
games.description:
A crafting table and an item you have built a hundred times. Now do it from memory.

A crafting puzzle: you lay out the ingredients, and after every attempt the game hints how close you are. The rest is on you.

In Classic Mode the target is shown and you only have to recall its recipe. Guess the Recipe hides it, so you build blind. Daily Craft gives one puzzle a day, the same for everyone. Recipe Quiz flips it around: the recipe is right there, and you name what it makes. One mistake ends the streak.

Crafts you open are collected in the Craft-o-pedia, records go to the leaderboards.

games.title: Mega Car Stunts
games.description:
A high-intensity driving game where every track becomes a test of skill, speed, and control. Perform daring jumps, fly off massive ramps, survive dangerous obstacles, and push your car to the limit in extreme stunt challenges. It is not just about racing fast — every course demands precision, timing, and the ability to stay in control under pressure.

Earn money by completing events, unlock new vehicles, and expand your collection with even more powerful cars. With varied modes, challenging tracks, and physics-based crashes, each run offers a new adrenaline-filled experience.

games.title: Bomber Quest
games.description: Join the excitement of Bomber Quest! Engage in a strategic 3D puzzle game where you navigate challenging levels, defeat monsters with bombs, and face risks with explosive power. Can you rise to the challenges? Enjoy this free game on your phone or computer!

games.title: Mine Obby 3D: Minigame World
games.description:
Dive into the exciting world of minigames! 🎮✨

🏆 Compete and win
For every victory, you earn golden apples and coins that can be spent on new rewards and upgrades. Prove that you deserve to be at the top!

👕 Unlock new skins
Choose the looks you like and make your character truly unique. Play the way you want!

🎲 Try different modes
A variety of minigames awaits you, where agility, attention, luck, and quick thinking will help you succeed. Every match brings new impressions and exciting challenges!

🌟 Can you overcome every challenge, outplay your rivals, and become a true champion?

games.title: Cat Escape: Hide and Seek
Hungry Cars
games.description: You are a car that gets stronger by eating other cars! Get stronger and unlock customization options every run!

games.title: Cars
games.description: Become a car driver in this thrilling online racing game! Overtake vehicles, avoid crashes, and race to beat your high score. Tap gas or brake to master the road and show your best result. Play now for fast-paced driving fun!

games.title: Fruits into Baskets
games.description:
Just tap on the fruits, watch them fall into place, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything going where it belongs.
Your goal is to clear the whole field and sort all the fruits into the right baskets. No timer, no pressure — just you, the fruits, and that satisfying feeling of order after each level.
Perfect for short breaks when you need to unwind and breathe. Grab your phone, get comfortable, and sort fruits to your heart's content! 🍊🍋🍇

games.title: 248 Scribble
games.description: 248 Scribble is a casual mobile merge puzzle game inspired by 2048, where players connect adjacent dots with matching numbers (like 2s, 4s, or 8s) horizontally or vertically on a colorful grid to merge them into higher values, aiming to achieve 248 while managing space and earning coins—its unique "scribble" art style with hand-drawn, vibrant, doodle-like tiles and intuitive touch controls sets it apart as an addictive, relaxing brain teaser.

games.title: Sea Legends - Match 3
games.description: Dive into the captivating world of Sea Legends - Match 3, a thrilling puzzle game where you explore ocean mysteries and uncover shipwreck secrets. Featuring beautiful graphics and captivating gameplay, it guarantees endless fun, whether on mobile or desktop.

games.title: Knife Slice 3D
games.description:
Flip, slice, and conquer your way through exciting obstacle-filled levels in Knife Slice 3D! Master realistic knife physics as you jump between platforms, slice through stacks of objects, collect apples, and avoid deadly traps. Time every flip perfectly to reach the portal and complete increasingly challenging levels.

Explore colorful low-poly worlds filled with forests, castles, and unique environments while unlocking powerful new knives. Easy one-tap controls make the game simple to pick up, but only the most skilled players can master every level and achieve perfect landings.

Whether you're looking for a relaxing casual game or a fast-paced precision challenge, Knife Slice 3D delivers satisfying gameplay that's perfect for both desktop and mobile browsers.

🔪 Addictive one-tap knife flipping gameplay
🍎 Slice objects and collect apples

games.title: The Fill
games.description:
Sharpen your mind with a connect-the-block-style one-line brain training puzzle game.
A simple but addictive one-line puzzle game that’s completely free to play.

Your brain becomes more active the more you play.
During your commute, before you sleep… enjoy downtime with brain training.

The rules are extremely simple.
Just fill in all of the blocks using only one line.

Use hints for puzzles that are too hard to solve.
Hints are also free, of course.

games.title: Starweave: Star Puzzle
games.description:
Starweave is a space-themed puzzle game offers a relaxing yet challenging journey through the cosmos.

The universe has gone dark and it's your goal to reconnect hidden constellations to light up the night sky.

Each level has a unique hidden constellation that you light up by linking stars together.

Space is not empty you have to be careful from stellar, orbits and cosmic friction.

Click and drag to weave a glowing trail between the stars.

As you glide through space, you will need to crush floating obstacles and navigate clever pathways to complete each celestial pattern.

Disconnect from stress of the day, connect stars and reveal ancient constellations in space sky.

If you're looking for satisfying stress relief games to help you unwind, Starweave offers a serene, meditative space.

Starweave is not just another casual puzzle game it’s a calming mental escape.
There are no timers counting down, no lives to lose and no high-score pressure.
Just you, the stars and quiet joy of creating something beautiful in space.


How to Play Starweave
⭐ Connect stars in right order to make constellation
💫 Crush floating obstacles before they block your path
🧩 Plan every move - one wrong connection means rethinking your route
🔓 Unlock new constellations and star patterns as you progress


Why You’ll Love Starweave!

Explore 45+ unique, hand-crafted levels that feel like interactive works of art, progressing naturally without frustrating tutorials.

Enjoy smooth, satisfying controls with tactile feedback designed for an effortless, mindful gaming experience.

Never run out of puzzles wake up every day to a new procedurally generated celestial challenge born from unique cosmic seeds.

Immerse yourself in stars and glow, elegant particle trails and a soothing ambient soundtrack that encourages deep relaxation.

Ideal for winding down before sleep, enjoying with a quiet coffee break or practicing daily mindfulness.

games.title: Rush Run: Need to Pee – Toilet Dash Runner Game
games.description:
Rush Run: Need to Pee is not a typical pee-and-poop game. It’s a fast-paced, addictive runner + drawing puzzle game where timing, creativity, and quick decisions decide everything. 🚀

Your mission is simple—but urgent: help a desperate little dude rush through crazy pee & poop maps and reach the toilet in time. Draw the perfect path, avoid messy obstacles, collect coins, and make it to toilet time before it’s too late!

🚽 Gameplay Overview

Draw & Run Mechanics
Draw smart paths through chaotic pee-and-poop maps to guide the runner safely to the toilet.

Fast-Paced Runner Action
The character auto-runs—your drawn path determines success or total embarrassment.

Coin Collection & Rewards
Collect coins along the way to unlock new characters, each with fun visuals and personality.

Toilet Time = Victory
Winning means reaching the toilet just in time—whether it’s pee or poop, success is success.

💩 Key Features

Addictive casual runner gameplay

Unique draw-to-win mechanics

Funny pee & poop themed levels

Multiple unlockable runner characters

Simple controls, challenging paths

Perfect for quick play sessions

Optimized for instant play on Playgama

🎮 Why You’ll Love It

If you enjoy:

Funny casual games

Toilet rush games

Draw path puzzle games

Hyper-casual runners

Lighthearted humor with real challenge

Then Rush Run: Need to Pee is made for you.

games.description: Prepare for an exciting adventure in the skies, where a single mistake sends you into the clouds. Race through unpredictable obstacles, testing your reflexes and abilities. Unlock and upgrade your vehicles as you take on high-stakes races that demand quick thinking and precision. Enjoy this thrilling experience online for free, on any device!

games.title: Recycle Game
games.description:
Turn trash into order and save the planet!

Recycle Game is a relaxing and oddly satisfying waste-sorting game that combines casual fun with a meaningful eco-friendly mission. If you love cleanup games, and zen-like puzzles, this one's for you!

Why you'll love Recycle Game:
ODDLY SATISFYING GAMEPLAY – Smooth controls and calming sorting mechanics. The perfect way to de-stress after a long day.

games.title: Clash of Cars: Arena
games.description:
Welcome to the arena where the weak don’t survive!

Take the wheel of a legendary, heavily armed Hot Rod and challenge dozens of ruthless opponents.

Here, there are no rules — only speed, firepower, and your reflexes decide who becomes the champion. Blast enemies with precise shots, collect stars, and unlock powerful upgrades for your battle beast.

Swap weapons, reinforce your armor, hit top speed, and leave nothing but smoke and wreckage behind!

Every arena is a new challenge, where only those willing to take risks can claim victory.

Ready to prove you’re the king of the road? Then hit the gas and race toward glory!

games.title: Copy the Drawing
games.description:
An exciting drawing game with hundreds of levels! Look at the example and recreate the drawing on the canvas — the more accurate, the higher your score.

The game features 300 levels across 18 categories: from simple shapes to animals, transport, space, fantasy, and Japanese culture. Every day brings a new drawing of the day — build your streak and compete with yourself!

Three brush sizes, undo last stroke, hints, and a medal system — all designed to make drawing fun and enjoyable. Gold, silver, or bronze — which medal will your drawing earn?

games.title: Balls Animal
games.description: Balls Animal is an addictive brain teaser where players sort colorful balls into matching tubes to solve challenging puzzles. With over 500 increasingly difficult levels, this cute puzzle game will keep you entertained for hours as you strategize the perfect moves to complete each level. The game features adorable animal characters that add charm to your puzzle-solving adventure, making the experience even more delightful. Perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages, Balls Animal combines simple mechanics with strategic thinking, making it easy to learn but satisfyingly challenging to master.

games.title: Paint & Roll
games.description:
Paint & Roll is a fun and satisfying color puzzle game where every move fills the world with vibrant paint 🎨✨

Roll your connected paint rollers across the board, cover every surface, and turn dull paths into colorful masterpieces 🌈🌀
Each level challenges your timing, direction, and planning skills as you glide, rotate, and paint your way to victory 🧠🎯

Simple controls make it easy to play, but mastering every level takes skill and strategy 😄🔥
Enjoy smooth animations, juicy paint effects, and relaxing yet challenging gameplay that feels great every time you roll 🎵💫

Perfect for quick sessions or long playtimes, Paint & Roll delivers a colorful experience that’s easy to learn and hard to put down 🚀🎮

games.title: Merge Guns: Brainrot Battle

Dive into a fast-paced merge arcade where your goal is simple: assemble a deadly arsenal and take down bosses one after another.

Buy mystery boxes, open them, and merge identical weapons to upgrade their power and unlock devastating stack combos. Strategically place guns, bombs, and knives into combat slots around the boss — they’ll attack automatically while you focus on optimizing your setup and tactics.
Face off against bizarre and powerful bosses like Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Sahur, and Cappuccino Assassino—each with unique behavior and escalating difficulty that will push your build to the limit.
Watch out for rage phases, grab limited-time gift events, boost your damage, and activate auto-opening to speed up your progression. Every decision matters as difficulty scales endlessly.
Defeat bosses, earn rewards, and see how far your build can go in an infinite challenge of power and strategy.
Complete the tutorial, master the coin economy, and prove that your loadout can destroy any titan.

Endless fun for racing and arcade game lovers

games.title: Halloween Stickman

games.title: Newbie’s Escape from Blogger Prison

🔓 Escape from Prison is an exciting platforming adventure where you must overcome dangerous challenges and find your way to freedom!

games.title: Geometry Open World

Utilize upgrades and skills to secure triumph. Ready to dominate this geometrical adventure? Enjoy it for free on your devices!

games.title: Move Emoji
games.description:
Move Emoji Match Puzzle

Welcome to Move Emoji Puzzle! In this game, your task is to match emojis by moving them around. You have to think carefully because you only get a certain number of moves to solve each puzzle. 

Be smart about using your moves! If you use up all your moves and haven't cleared the puzzle, you'll lose the level. The goal is to match all the emoji boxes to clear the level and move on to the next fun challenge!

games.title: Push The Box
games.description:
Welcome to Push The Box, a fun and engaging game where you solve puzzles by just pushing buttons and sliding pieces. Complete different stage missions and try out harder levels as you improve!

Game Features:
- Use handy features like reset and undo to make your gameplay smooth.
- Watch replays of your successful stages to see how you solved them.
- Enjoy clean and stylish graphics that make the game a delight to play.
- Earn achievements and compare your scores with others on the leaderboard.
- Perfectly designed for smart pads and tablets for gaming on the go.

So, if you’re looking for a game that’s easy to understand but also challenges your brain, Push Maze Puzzle is perfect for you! Slide into the puzzle fun and start solving today!

games.title: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG
games.description: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG is a casual fantasy role-playing game where you lead a small team of brave adventurers through dangerous monster-filled floors. Hire warriors, archers, mages and other fighters, upgrade their equipment, learn new skills and defeat powerful bosses. Build your party, collect loot, improve your heroes and go deeper into the adventure.

games.title: Bubble Gum
games.description:
Blow it up and rise high! 🎈✨

Welcome to an exciting arcade game where lightness is your secret weapon!
Inflate balloons, dodge obstacles, and climb as high as you can! The bigger your balloon, the more coins you earn - but watch out for spikes!

How big can you grow your balloon?

games.title: Snake Slither.io Italian Brainrot
games.description:
Snake Slither.io Italian Brainrot is a fast, funny, and totally unhinged snake game inspired by classic slither gameplay and viral Italian brainrot memes.

Control your snake and slither across a chaotic arena filled with absurd Italian brainrot characters, strange creatures, and ridiculous surprises. Eat orbs, grow longer, and avoid crashing into other snakes while the screen explodes with nonsense, memes, and pure chaos.

Featuring iconic brainrot-style characters, exaggerated animations, and colorful Italian-themed visuals, this game turns simple snake mechanics into a wild meme-filled experience. The bigger you grow, the harder it gets—one wrong move and it’s game over.

games.title: Love Sheep
games.description:
Love Sheep is a fun, quirky, and relaxing puzzle game you can enjoy anywhere.
Enter a world of bouncy, jelly soft sheep in a physics based adventure full of squish, stretch, and smart puzzles. 
If you like brainy challenges but also want cozy, relaxing vibes, Love Sheep is the perfect game for you.

games.title: Jewel Gem Puzzle
games.description:
Jewel Gem Puzzle & Create with Pixel Art Puzzles
Enter a vibrant world of glowing jewels where creativity and puzzle-solving come together in perfect harmony! Designed for easy, relaxing fun, this one-of-a-kind experience combines color sorting, pixel art creation, and satisfying casual gameplay all in one. With smooth, user-friendly controls and levels that gently grow more engaging, it’s the perfect way to unwind while keeping your mind active.

games.title: Word Chef
games.description: Word Chef is a classic word search puzzle game. This free word game makes learning new words fun. It comes with 6 difficulties ranging from Beginner to Expert and there are more than 500 levels in total. Simply swipe letters from the word scramble to create a word. Connect the letters, find the words, and sharpen your word skills as you go.

games.title: Draw Dot Picture Game
games.description: Welcome to Draw One Miss Part Brain Games, the addictive puzzle game where logic, drawing, and brain games come together! Think you’re good at spotting details? Test your skills by identifying the missing part in each scene, and use your finger to draw it back in. Sounds simple? These brain puzzles are trickier than you think!

games.title: SORTY BOLTY
games.description: SORTY BOLTY revolves around the theme of organization and color coordination. Players are tasked with sorting vibrant nuts onto corresponding bolts, creating a visually satisfying and mentally stimulating experience. The game's appeal lies in its straightforward mechanics that gradually increase in complexity, challenging players to think several moves ahead.

games.title: Tiny Delivery
games.description:
Tiny Delivery is an game, created by combining the ideas of food delivery and hill climbing.
Customize your car and wheels in the store, and complete each level with your favorite vehicle.
Before starting the game, you can activate the truck rack to keep the food from falling out, making it easier to finish the level.

games.title: Arrow Fever
games.description: Arrow Fever is an exciting action game where players use a bow and arrow to defeat foes. It's a trending, free, and no-registration-required title available on iOS, Android, and desktops. Level up your character and enjoy challenging gameplay with rewards for skill and strategy.

games.title: Jelly Color Sort 3D
games.description:
Put your sorting skills to the test in Jelly Sort 3D: Color Puzzle! Move colorful jelly pieces and place jellies of the same color into the correct sections before time runs out.

Think carefully, plan your moves, and complete each puzzle as quickly as possible. When you get stuck or need extra help, use useful power-ups by watching a short rewarded ad. Freeze Time can pause the countdown, Destroy Jelly can remove a troublesome jelly, and Auto Shuffle can rearrange the puzzle to give you a fresh chance.

With simple tap controls, colorful 3D jelly pieces, challenging levels, and helpful power-ups, this color sorting puzzle game is easy to learn but challenging to master.

games.title: Slime Clicker
games.description:
Get ready to click your way to ultimate slime glory in Slime Clicker, the most relaxing and fun idle clicker on the web! ✨

Tap, click, and chill as you rack up points by booping your adorable slime. Every click brings you closer to new levels, shiny upgrades, and delightfully cute skins — from Bat Slime to Rabbit Slime, each evolution is lovelier and more rewarding than the last.

Don’t blink! Every so often, a Mini Slime appears — and catching it in time gives you a juicy bonus to your total points. Combine lucky clicks with powerful passive upgrades like AutoClickers, and watch your slime empire grow even when you’re not playing.

Simple, satisfying, and absurdly cute, Slime Clicker is the perfect game to unwind, laugh, and click your heart out. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, there’s always another slime waiting to make your day brighter.

games.title: Brain Draw Line
games.description:
Put your mind to the test with Brain Draw Line: Link Dots, a simple yet captivating puzzle game that challenges creativity and logic. Draw one continuous line without lifting your finger or going backward to connect the dots and finish complicated designs.

The goal of this game is simple: create a single, continuous line without lifting your finger or overlapping any lines to link all the dots in a specific shape. With each level, the puzzles get more complex.

games.title: The Road Home: Granny Escape
games.description:
The Road Home: Granny Escape is a terrifying 3D horror survival game where your only goal is to escape a haunted house filled with danger, puzzles, and fear. You're not here by accident — Granny and Grandpa brought you here on purpose, and they won’t let you go easily.

🕯 The Story
Your trip home took a dark turn. While riding a bus through a remote forest, a massive tree crashed down onto the road. You stepped out to investigate… and everything went black.

You wake up in a locked, eerie house. The windows are boarded up. The doors are sealed. And something is watching you. You soon realize the terrifying truth: you’ve been kidnapped and trapped by an evil Granny and her mad husband.

This isn’t just a place — it’s a prison designed to break you.

🎯 What You Must Do
-Explore the dark and haunted house
-Solve puzzles and unlock secret passages
-Craft useful items from the resources you find
-Avoid Granny and Grandpa — they can hear your every move
-Survive deadly traps and unpredictable chases
-Make your way to freedom before it’s too late

⚙️ Game Features
-A chilling 3D horror experience with immersive atmosphere
-Evil and intelligent enemies who react to sound and movement
-Multiple escape paths and secret endings
-A full crafting system: collect, combine, survive
-Puzzles, keys, locked rooms, and hidden objects
-A heavy dose of mental horror and psychological tension
-Every sound matters. Every choice counts.

❗️ Not Just a Game — A Nightmare
This isn’t just a scary house — it’s a living nightmare. There’s evil in the walls, and death behind every corner. Will you outsmart your captors, or will fear consume you?

Use your brain, stay quiet, and find your way out… if you still can.

Download The Road Home: Granny Escape — and see if you have what it takes to survive the fear, escape the madness, and get back home.

games.title: Monster Tile Party
games.description: Monster Tile Party is a bright, family-friendly triple-tile puzzle game. Pick tiles from a layered board, collect three matching monster tiles, and clear every level before your tray fills up. Cheerful original characters, satisfying match effects, helpful boosters, daily rewards, and a growing level map make every quick round feel like a tiny party.

games.title: Pongoal
games.description:
PONGOAL is an exciting fusion of classic Pong and high-stakes football action! Experience the timeless paddle gameplay you love, reimagined with the energy and intensity of a penalty shootout. Defend your goal, outsmart your opponent, and score spectacular goals in this fast-paced arcade sports challenge.

Battle against intelligent AI opponents across three difficulty levels, or challenge a friend in local multiplayer mode. Every match is a test of reflexes, strategy, and precision as you race to be the first to reach the winning score. With dynamic physics, responsive touch controls, and thrilling goal celebrations, PONGOAL delivers non-stop competitive fun!

games.title: STORMHAWK
games.description:
STORMHAWK is a vertical arcade shooter — a shmup — built to be played with one hand. Fly 32 hand-built missions over the Pacific, dodge with a barrel roll, and chain kills to multiply your score.

What makes it different from other plane shooters: everything you earn goes somewhere. Land after a mission and spend it in the hangar, unlock twelve planes that each fly differently, and pick roguelite cards mid-run so no two campaigns stack the same way. Six modes, including a Daily mission everyone plays identically and a Boss Rush against all 32 bosses back to back.

games.title: Trial Xtreme
games.description: Trial Xtreme is a thrilling motorcycle racing game that puts your balance, precision, and endurance to the test. Ride through challenging obstacle-filled tracks packed with ramps, pipes, rocks, and tricky barriers where every move can lead to victory or a crash. This is not just a race to the finish — it is a skill-based challenge where speed and control matter equally. Complete tracks, improve your time, and collect stars to unlock new levels.

games.title: Arklet
games.description:
Welcome to Arklet - a cozy and meditative puzzle game where your talent for organizing turns into the art of creating harmony for the most adorable creatures.

In this game, you become the caretaker of a unique ARKlet filled with charming "square" animals, each possessing its own personality, quirks, and little secrets.

🧩 Gameplay: Harmony in Every Block
Your task is simple: distribute the arriving animals into cozy rooms. However, each ward is an individual. To complete a level perfectly, you must do more than just fill the space; you must ensure every animal feels completely safe and comfortable.

🐾 Consider Every Detail:
Fears and Dislikes: A massive elephant might panic if placed in the same room as a tiny mouse. You will need to plan layouts so the giant doesn't even catch a glimpse of its small neighbor.
Friendship and Socializing: Some animals, like meerkats or raccoons, love company, while bears or porcupines might prefer solitude in a far corner. (some of the pets are still WIP)
Special Requests: Some dream of a room with a view of the lighthouse, while others need to be close to food supplies.

🌿 Relaxing Experience and Aesthetics
The game features a detailed style that combines sharp geometric shapes with soft textures. You can expect:

A Meditative Pace: There are no stress-inducing timers. You can rearrange room blocks endlessly until you find the perfect combination.
Visual Delight: Watch fun animations - from a trembling, frightened elephant to a happy mouse munching on cheese.
Progressive Growth: Gradually build up your zoo, unlocking new locations ranging from sunny piers to icy icebergs. (WIP)

🧠 Who is this game for?
I made Arklet for fans of organization games and spatial puzzles. It is a project for those who want to unwind after a long day and immerse themselves in a world where everything can be put in its place, and the only reward that matters is the happy smile of a square animal.

Create a perfect sanctuary where even the most diverse animals can live in peace and harmony!

games.title: Vikings
games.description:
Vikings is a card game, develop your cards, conquer new lands.
There are many adventures waiting for you.

2248: Merge & Slash combines the classic 2248 puzzle mechanics with exciting battles.

Build chains, unleash powerful attacks, defeat monsters, collect coins, and unlock new upgrades. The longer the chain, the stronger your attack. Can you make it to the end and defeat every monster?

games.title: Escape Police for Brainrots
games.description:
Run from the police, collect Brainrots, and gradually improve your speed.

The farther you run, the higher your progress becomes and the better your Brainrots get.
Unlock new possibilities, expand your Brainrot base, and try to run as far as possible!

games.title: Meow Pair Pop

games.title: Santa Stunt Racer Christmas Delivery
games.description:
Get ready for the ultimate festive adventure in Santa Stunt Racer: Christmas Delivery! Ride through thrilling holiday stunt tracks filled with ramps, obstacles, and challenging paths. Each level brings a new snowy track where you must drive carefully, perform stunts, and collect the Christmas gifts placed along the ramps.

Your mission is simple: reach the finish line and deliver the collected gifts to the kids waiting for Santa!
The faster and cleaner you complete the track, the better your delivery score.

Unlock a variety of custom Santa vehicles as you progress—each with unique speed, handling, and style to help you conquer tougher levels. Master the tracks, dodge obstacles, and perform daring jumps to complete Santa’s delivery run before Christmas ends!

Are you ready to race, stunt, and deliver joy?
Christmas needs you! 🎅

games.title: Build a Go-Kart
games.description:
Build your karting empire from scratch — from simple straights to complex tracks with boosts and risky turns.

Design unique tracks using modular blocks: combine elements, optimize your route, and find the perfect balance between speed and profit. Every ride earns money — and your track design determines how much you make.

🏁 Race & Earn
Drive your own tracks, earn income for every segment, and refine your strategy.

🧱 Flexible Building
Straights, turns, boosters, and dangerous sections — build a track that works for you.

💰 Economy & Progression
Earn currencies, unlock new blocks and skins, and expand your building area.

🔁 Prestige System
Reset your progress to grow faster and unlock new opportunities.

🎁 Daily Rewards
Come back every day and claim bonuses to boost your progress.

Build, test, and optimize your tracks — and turn every race into profit.
Can you create the perfect track?

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?

A: It's an arcade game where players need to create their own track by placing various blocks.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? How can it engage players?

A: The game is about Obby. Players can race on their kart on the track, earn money for each segment, and use the earnings to unlock new blocks, expand their territory, and improve the track for even greater profits.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Racing on the track, earning money for each segment, using the money to unlock new blocks for greater profits, expand their territory, and improve the track.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: In the game, there are diamonds and money as currencies. Both currencies can be spent on purchasing new blocks and skins.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. Players can buy diamonds, which are then used to purchase blocks. Donations speed up game progress.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: In the game, there are Obby and skins for Obby.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to return?

A: Yes, the game offers daily rewards and rewards for time spent in the game.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game but is not necessary for gameplay.

games.title: City Pilot Plane Parking Jam
games.description:
✈️ City Pilot Plane Parking Jam – Airport Traffic Puzzle Challenge! 🧩🚦

Welcome to City Pilot Plane Parking Jam, the ultimate airplane parking puzzle game where you manage the chaos of the world’s busiest airport! With planes constantly landing, taxiing, and taking off, the airport ground becomes a maze of aircraft, obstacles, and tight parking spots. Your mission? Clear the parking jam, guide the planes safely, and restore order to the runway!

This challenging airplane parking jam simulator mixes strategic thinking, IQ-boosting puzzles, and airport management gameplay, making it perfect for fans of parking games, traffic jam puzzles, and aircraft simulators.

🛫 Clear the Airport Parking Chaos!

The airport is full of blocked paths, stuck airplanes, cargo jets, and obstacles. To succeed, you must:

games.description: Tidy up an overflowing closet! Simple, satisfying mechanics paired with cute 3D graphics and hundreds of levels, ranging from easy sorts to tricky combo challenges with boosters.

games.title: Blasting Marbles

games.title: Okay
games.description:
Okay? is a minimalist puzzle game that turns simple shapes into clever challenges. Every level is made of blocks, lines, and objects placed on a clean, abstract screen. Your goal is simple: clear all the objects with just one perfect move.

Draw a line with your finger, release it, and watch it bounce around the screen. If your move is right, the line will hit and remove every object until the screen is empty. Sounds easy? As levels go up, the puzzles get smarter, requiring perfect angles, timing, and logic.

games.title: Obby: Brainrot escape from Lava
games.description:
🌋 Obby: Brainrot escape from Lava
Collect it. Run. Survive. Meme classics in action!
🔥 Key Features:
• Lava Run: Dodge obstacles, calculate jump timings and outrun the oncoming lava on increasingly difficult and confusing tracks.

games.title: Noob Slingshot: Monsters
games.description:
Meet Noob, a clumsy hero you load straight into a slingshot. Pull back the band, follow the dotted aiming line, and launch him at the block towers where cartoon monsters hide.

Every level is a small physics puzzle built from glass, wood, stone, and TNT. Glass shatters at a touch, wood needs a solid hit, and stone takes two hits before it falls. Each broken block scores points, so a clean shot and a big collapse both pay off, and your shots are limited.

TNT crates start chain reactions that can fold half a tower in one hit, but blow them at the wrong moment and the last monster stays safe behind cover. Bonus cards hidden in the levels give extra shots when you need another try, turning each stage into a mix of arcade action and light puzzle planning.

Clear levels to earn coins, then spend them back in the main menu to build and grow Noob's house, a steady goal between the tower-smashing stages.

Features:
- Physics slingshot arcade with simple one-finger aiming
- Dotted trajectory preview for planning every shot
- Breakable glass, wood, and stone blocks with different durability
- TNT crates for chain reactions and huge collapses
- Points for broken blocks and efficient shots
- Bonus cards that grant extra shots
- 50 levels with a changing time of day
- Full offline play after install
- Build a house in the main menu with coins you earn

Take aim, manage your shots, and show the monsters what a noob can really do.

games.title: Obby: Mine Crasher
games.description:
🔨  Obby: Mine Crasher
Hit the anvils with a hammer, gain power and smash the stone walls! For each destroyed block, you get cups (trophies). Spend them on pets, which enhance the impact on the anvils: the more powerful the satellite, the faster the walls break down and further you go through the obby levels.
Hitting the anvil → improving strength
🔹 Walls to splinters → Cups to pocket
🔹 Cups → pets → even more power
Are you ready to become the ultimate dungeon destroyer? Come in and start smashing! 🔥

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?

A: Instead of bosses, there are walls that become more challenging with each broken wall.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The key currency is trophies, which can be used to spin a pet box, buy character skins, and unlock new areas. Strength can be used to unlock weapon skins.

games.title: Shikaku Puzzle
games.description:
Shikaku is a logic puzzle with simple rules and challenging solutions.

The rules are simple. You have to divide the grid into rectangular and square pieces such that each piece contains exactly one number, and that number represents the area of the rectangle.

games.title: Panda Go!
games.description:

games.title: LumberJack Simulator 3D
games.description:
Lumberjack Simulator 3D is a relaxing economic game where you build a logging operation from the ground up. Start with nothing but an axe and grow your humble camp into a thriving wooden empire.

Chop trees, collect logs and haul them to the warehouse. Spend your coins on upgrades, unlock a tablet to manage incoming orders, and hire helpers — lumberjacks who chop for you and collectors who gather logs automatically.

Build houses for your workers and expand your base by placing buildings wherever you like. Accept deals from buyers, negotiate with business partners, and keep your warehouse stocked — the more logs you deliver, the more you earn.

A dynamic day-night cycle, a living world and full control over your progress make every session feel fresh. Adjust music, controls and language to your liking and get to work.

games.description: Geek Escape: Run for Survival is an exciting arcade game where players control a nerdy hero racing against bullies. Toxic Arena: Biological Threat is a thrilling action-roguelike "survivors" game where your only goal is to survive in the heart of a global biological catastrophe. You are a fighter trapped on an arena with endless hordes of mutants. Test your nerves and your reaction time!

Plan your route carefully, use cover and darkness to your advantage, and upgrade stealth abilities to gain the upper hand over security forces. Every second matters: one glance freezes you in place, one wrong move triggers a relentless chase.

Spray with the right trigger
Put out every fire
Upgrade your water deposits

• Relaxing casual gameplay

games.title: Emoji Solitaire

Starting with simple piles, the puzzle complexity expands as you unlock new levels, bringing blocker cards, locked cards, and intricate category boards. Perfect for casual gaming sessions, language learners, and puzzle enthusiasts alike, Emoji Solitaire offers a tranquil, deeply satisfying spatial sorting experience.

games.title: Woof Foow
