Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: It is necessary to play with sound.

Q: Is there a system of achievements (achievements)? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Yes, they are obtained as quests and tasks are completed.

games.title: Block Battle - Noob vs Pro
games.description:
Fight and build in the World of Blocks!
Develop your abilities, defeat huge Bosses!
Become a Legend in the player rankings!

Survive the Battle of Blocks! This game in the style of the popular Mine combines sandbox elements and dynamic battles in block arenas, allowing you to show your creativity and dexterity. 🌍✨

• Arena battles ⚔️🏆: Take part in exciting battles in specially created arenas. Fight with rivals. Use your skills and tactics to become a real champion!

• Construction and creativity 🛠️🎨: In sandbox mode, you can create your own unique worlds using a variety of blocks and materials. Your imagination has no limits!

• Bosses and challenges 🐉💪: Test your strength by fighting huge bosses that are waiting for you in different corners of the world.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?

A: The game is in the style of Minecraft. You need to level up by collecting crystals, attacking enemies, and chopping down trees.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: The game features Minecraft-style skins and high-quality graphics.

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has coins as currency, which can be spent on character upgrades (speed, experience, level) and purchasing skins.

Q: Are there any captivating elements of content (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game features a Flappy Bird-style mini-game.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, you need to attack enemies of lower levels, collect crystals, and chop down trees.

Economy & Customization

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers several skins for customization.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: The music complements the game well but is not necessary for progression.

games.title: Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon
games.description: Embark on a journey to build your own empire in Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon, an engaging online economic simulator that combines elements of resource crafting, empire development, and clicker gameplay. As the ruler of a thriving island, your mission is to explore every corner, uncover precious resources, and craft them into valuable goods. By hiring managers and traders, you can automate tasks and maximize profits, ensuring your empire's success both on the phone and on the computer. Upgrade your factories, fulfill production orders, and let your empire shine in this captivating free game.

games.title: Money Factory: Tycoon Idle Game
games.description: Is a fast-paced clicker game with strategic elements where you build and expand your financial empire by optimizing money production lines. Start with a simple setup and gradually grow by upgrading equipment, unlocking new production areas, and enhancing efficiency to skyrocket your profits.

games.title: BBQ Sort
games.description:
Welcome to the sizzling excitement of BBQ Sort Step up to the grill and show off your matching prowess in this delectable puzzle adventure.

Start with chill jazz and a few orders, but as you grow, expect huge, time-limited orders. Special requests will need your careful attention and unique cooking skills. Prepare for dynamic challenges and have fun!

games.title: Obby: Save the Brainrots Online
games.description:
Obby: Save the Brainrots Online is a dynamic reaction arcade game where a huge wave is already on its way, and you only have seconds to make it!
Grab the brainrots, take them away from the advancing elements and deliver them to a safe zone. The faster you act, the more likely you are to find and save the rarest meme characters.
Boost your speed to be able to carry the rescued out of the affected area before the water covers everything around.
Look for Brainrots of varying rarity, from common to legendary. Replenish your collection, unlock new bonuses and feel your progress growing.
And most importantly, the game has online multiplayer: come in with your friends, rescue brainrots with a team, or compete to see who brings the most valuable finds before the wave arrives.
Are you ready to test your reaction and speed? Run, grab and save — the tsunami is not waiting!

games.title: Darling Doll: DIY Paper Doll
games.description:
• Characters: We offer a large selection of famous model characters to choose from (from famous princesses to anime females).
• Experiment with different dress styles, haircuts, expressions, and skin tones.
• A wide range of accessories for your character!
• Customize your dolls with over 1000 pieces, and build your anime character, your avatar.

games.title: 99 Nights In The Forest
games.description:
You find yourself in a dark and mysterious forest where the only goal is to survive for 99 nights. As darkness falls, a monstrous deer emerges from the shadows to hunt you down. Your only chance of survival is to keep the fire burning, since it is the only thing that scares the creature away. During the day, you must gather resources — wood, food, and useful items — to prepare for the night. With every passing night, the challenge becomes harder: temperatures drop, the forest grows darker, and the monster becomes more relentless.

The game combines horror, survival, and rogue-like elements. You need to carefully manage limited resources and constantly watch over the fire to stay alive. Immersive sounds and a tense atmosphere keep you on edge until the very end.

Will you survive and make it through all 99 nights?

games.title: Stickboy Epic Swordsman
games.description: Embrace your warrior spirit in Stickboy Epic Swordsman, an exciting online game where you equip diverse armor, face tough challenges, and defeat powerful bosses. Explore a vibrant world, gather exclusive gear, and find unique swords to enhance your combat tactics. Rise through the ranks and test your skills against others.

games.title: Elements Craft Ultimate
games.description: Combine the four basic elements—Fire, Water, Earth, and Wind—to create the universe! Drag and drop items to discover hundreds of unique recipes in this addictive alchemy puzzle game.

games.title: Makeup Fruits
games.description:
Have you ever imagined giving a watermelon a makeover? How about adding a flutter of eyelashes or a swipe of lipstick to a juicy melon? In Makeup Fruits, your mission is to help these delightful fruits dazzle with beauty. It's all in your hands to adorn them with the perfect makeup and accessories for their stunning transformation!

Click to select the fruit you want to transform into a beauty icon, then proceed to choose and apply a variety of makeup options. Explore a diverse selection of brands, powder colors, eyelashes, lipsticks, stickers, and more!

At the end, you'll be able to take a "selfie" of your fabulous creation to share with your friends.

You'll also earn "gems" as a reward for your work. These gems can be used to unlock exciting new items and keep the fun going!

games.title: Brainrot Courier
games.description:
Brainrot Courier is an exciting skateboard adventure in which your goal is to collect the most legendary Brainrots! Ride on colorful platforms, jump over dangerous chasms, perform risky maneuvers to reach rare characters scattered around the world.



The further you go, the more unique and valuable Brainrots you can find. From popular characters to ultra—rare legends, each find brings you closer to becoming the best Brainroot collector.



Features



* Dynamic platform gameplay on a skateboard

* Collect dozens of unique and fun Brainrots

* Jump over chasms and overcome difficult obstacles

* Smooth and responsive skateboard controls

* Unlock rare and legendary Brainrots

* Collect the greatest collection of Brainrots

* Fast and addictive gaming sessions

* Suitable for players of all ages

games.title: JuicyJong
games.description: Play JuicyJong, the ultimate color puzzle game! A fresh twist on Mahjong that challenges your mind with every move. Test your strategy and focus in this vibrant, brain-teasing online adventure!

games.title: Robby +1 To Jump Power Per Second
games.description:
In the game, you get +1 jump power every second. Score as many points as possible and take the first place on the leaderboard.

Unlock your pets. Jump, run and have fun!

You will find two maps "Day" and "Night" with unique towers and finishing platforms on them.

games.title: Miki Oath
games.description: Miki Oath is a story-driven precision platformer with 106 handcrafted levels across ten magical worlds. Guide Miki through spikes, saws, moving platforms, springs, and teleporters as she keeps her promise to save Luna. Fast restarts, responsive controls, and full localization in nine languages make every attempt easy to jump back into.

games.title: Crystalia
games.description: A vibrant block puzzle game. Place pieces on the board so that 3 or more blocks of the same color line up next to each other — and watch them vanish in a satisfying explosion. Simple rules, endless depth, and a fierce battle for the top spot on the leaderboard.

games.title: Money Ping Pong
games.description: Join the exciting journey of Money Ping Pong, an engaging idle game where you manage money blocks to influence bouncing balls and boost profits. Explore diverse maps, unlock new blocks, and enjoy a mix of strategy and chill gameplay on your device as you create your virtual wealth!

games.title: Passenger City Taxi Game
games.description: Welcome to the city taxi driver simulator game, the ultimate driving experience where you become the most reliable and skilled taxi driver in the city. Navigate busy streets, pick up passengers and drop them off safely at their destinations. Every ride is a new challenge that will test your driving skills and city navigation abilities. Get powerful taxis and complete exciting missions and earn rewards for exceptional service.

games.title: Ragdoll Gun Shooter! Cannon Spinner Playground
games.description:
🎯 Ready for some fun action with ragdoll stickmen? The game "Ragdoll Gun Shooter! Cannon Spinner Playground" will hook you from the first level! Become a sharpshooter, control a rotating gun and destroy funny yellow mobs in a bright casual 3D shooter.

This simple playground shooter is inspired by the popular games "Playground Man! Ragdoll Show!" and "Melon Playground". Here you will find everything you need for a fun action: ragdoll physics, stickmen, different guns and interesting levels. Click "Play" and show your sniper skills!

🔥 Game Features 🔥
Simple one-tap controls: just shoot at the right moment
Bright 3D graphics with funny ragdoll physics and funny jelly stickmen
Exciting gameplay: use items on levels to effectively destroy enemies
Play online from your mobile or PC without downloading.
Various weapons: from a pistol to powerful guns.

games.title: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat
games.description: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat is a fun meme game where you need to break bricks, collect power-ups for more fun breaking bricks, and watch Chipy Chipy Chipa Cat and El Primo Bara Bere dancing. Go through interesting and exciting levels in the fun game about Chippy Chippy Chippy Chappa Chappa Cat and El Primo. Pass levels of different difficulty and set a personal record. Play the Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat game at now and have fun.

games.title: Summer Rider 3D
games.description:
Hit the waves in Summer Rider 3D, a sun-soaked surf adventure inspired by high-speed endless runners. Glide over water on a surfboard or jet-ski, collect shimmering starfish, and push your reflexes to the limit as the speed cranks up. With a colorful summer theme and upbeat tropical soundtracks, the game offers endless fun for both solo and competitive players.

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what are the main objectives?
A: It's an arcade game where you surf and have to overcome various obstacles on your board.

Q: Is there a story or narrative arc?
A: There is no storyline; the objective is to avoid crashing your surfboard while navigating around rocks, waterfalls, and a lot of dangerous obstacles.

Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? What makes it appealing to players?
A: The game stands out because there are few similar surfing games. It features good graphics, enjoyable music, and many surfboard skins.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The very relaxing, summer-themed location.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available, and what are they used for (e.g., common - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The game has one currency, ""Sea Stars,"" which can be used to purchase different surfboards.

Q: Is there any customization in the game? Can the character's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc., be adjusted?
A: Yes, you can buy clothes and different surfboard skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without sound make it difficult to progress?
A: The music is a nice addition for the atmosphere but is not essential for completing the levels

games.title: Flappy Ball
games.description:
Take your basketball hopping skills to the limit in Flappy Ball — an addictive arcade sports runner with tactile, physics-based controls!

🏀 Core Features:

Endless Run & 15 Handcrafted Challenges: Test your reflexes across moving, pulsing, and tilted hoops or master the flap-count budget challenge.
Clean Swish & On-Fire Streaks: Score without touching the rim to ignite flame trails, multipliers, and acoustic swish sound effects.
Rich Customization: Unlock 11 unique ball skins (Classic, Billiards 8-Ball, Tennis, Watermelon, Glazed Donut, Lava Core, Dragon Eye, Cosmic Pulsar) and 7 parallax dynamic themes.
Weekly Tournaments: Compete in 50-player weekly seasons to earn massive star rewards.
Lucky Wheel & Trophies: Spin daily for free rewards and unlock achievements as you beat your high score.

games.title: Jump in Rhythm to the Hit! Cat Disco!
games.description:
🎵 The game "Jump in Rhythm to the Hit! Cat Disco!" offers a unique combination of cute cat meows and exciting pop music rhythms. Play along to a variety of popular tunes, including worldwide hits, and enjoy gorgeous visuals and kawaii design!

⭐ Main Features ⭐
- A large selection of popular hits!
- Remixes of popular tracks with a fun "meow"!
- Easy one-touch screen control!
- Bright colors and fantastic design!
- A variety of kawaii cats ready for adventure!

🎁 Don't miss out on the surprises we have prepared for you! Start the game "Jump in Rhythm to the Hit! Cat Disco!" and plunge into the fun world of musical adventures right now! 🌈🐾🎮

💕Don't forget to support us by leaving a review and comment if you liked the game!
If you have any comments about the game, please describe the problem in as much detail as possible and we will try to fix it quickly!

games.title: Italian Brainrot GT Highway Racing
games.description:
Start your engine and lose your mind in Italian Brainrot GT Highway Racing — the most chaotic racing experience ever! 🇮🇹💥

Drift through endless highways, dodge traffic, and feel the pure brainrot energy of Italian-style chaos. From over-the-top cars to wild memes, it’s not just racing — it’s madness on wheels!

games.title: Liquid Sort
games.description:
Dive into a calming yet addictive puzzle experience where every move matters.

In this trendy liquid sort game, your goal is simple: organize colorful liquids into the right containers. But don’t be fooled—each level brings new challenges that test your logic, planning, and attention to detail.

Watch vibrant colors flow smoothly as you pour, stack, and solve your way through increasingly satisfying puzzles. Whether you’re looking to relax your mind or sharpen your thinking, this game strikes the perfect balance between chill vibes and brain-teasing fun.

Features:
• Smooth and satisfying liquid animations
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels
• Easy to learn, tricky to master
• No time limits—play at your own pace
• Clean, modern visuals with a relaxing atmosphere

Can you master the art of sorting?

games.title: Desert Gunship
games.description:
Desert Gunship puts you in the cockpit of an attack helicopter over a hostile

desert airbase. Fly low between the hangars, pick your weapon, and clear the

camp before it clears you.



Seven operations, each with a different job: wipe out a camp, raid a supply

depot, pull survivors out under fire, hold a line against an assault, run a

bomb to its target, and fight for air superiority against enemy gunships.



Then enter the Tournament. Twelve countries seeded by strength, three

battlefields, three difficulty levels, and one rule: a single loss ends

the run.



Coins and XP from every sortie go into the hangar. Heavier armour, harder

hitting guns, more speed, then back out to the mission that beat you.

games.title: Drakkar Strike
games.description: Sail the seas on your drakkar, launch spears like a furious slingshot, and crush enemy vikings before they sink you!

games.title: Mike and Mia 1st Day School
games.description: Mike and Mia are very excited for their first day of school. Help them to clean their room and make a delicious snack box. Get dressed up with various cute clothes. Enjoy the first day at school with fun and loving playful activities!

games.title: Cosmic Dash
games.description: Cosmic Dash is an endless space runner where you pilot your way across the solar system, dodging space junk, collecting tokens, and smashing asteroids. The core loop is simple—travel as far as you can while managing jumps, shrinks, and speed boosts—but what makes it stand out is its layered mechanics: shrinking lets you slip through debris, boosts let you destroy asteroids, and big tokens chain into massive rewards. The mix of fast reflex gameplay, mission objectives, and planetary backdrops gives it a fresh twist on the classic runner genre.

games.title: Spray Paint - Coloring Games
games.description: Unleash your creativity and bring hidden pictures to life! Choose the right painting tool and carefully color each layer to reveal the final image. 🖌️ Use a spray painter, paint roller, or spray gun depending on the shape and area you need to cover. Complete every layer with precision and watch your artwork gradually appear. ✨ Can you paint the entire picture perfectly?

games.title: Obby Upgrade Your Speed!
games.description:
Want to become super fast? ⚡
In Obby Upgrade Your Speed you power up by tapping: tap → earn Run Points → run faster!

🚀 More points = more speed.
🐾 Unlock pets to boost progress and strengthen taps: you get 2 or 3 points per tap depending on your pet.
🏁 Hit crazy speed, beat your records, and feel the rush!

games.title: Gravity Shift Sky Racers GT
games.description: Gravity Shift: Sky Racers GT redefines the limits of speed and gravity. Take control of next-generation GT machines that defy physics — racing not just on the track, but through the skies. Seamlessly transition between ground drifting and aerial maneuvers as you battle for dominance across futuristic cities, floating highways, and high-altitude circuits.

games.title: Screw Color Puzzle
games.description: Experience the exciting challenge of "Screw Color Puzzle," an engaging online game that puts your skills to the test. Match screws with their corresponding colors in a captivating setting. Enjoy this free game on your computer or phone for hours of enjoyable, brain-stimulating entertainment.

games.title: Cup Quest
games.description:
Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey: A Feline Hero’s Adventure Begins!

Join a brave cat on an epic quest in Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey, a fresh twist on the classic balls-and-cups game. This isn't just about tossing balls into cups—it's a full-blown adventure packed with clever puzzles, physics-based challenges, and one courageous kitty determined to save the day.

Your Cat, the Hero
Meet your furry champion—a quick-thinking, nimble cat with a heart of gold. As danger looms and traps lie in wait, it’s up to this whiskered warrior to take on wild levels filled with spinning platforms, explosives, and tricky obstacles.

Precision Meets Puzzle
Each level is a test of aim and timing. Launch the ball just right, bounce it off the environment, and land it perfectly in the cup. It’s not just about power—success requires strategy, finesse, and a little creative thinking.
 What Awaits You
- Over 200 unique levels, ranging from simple to seriously tricky
- Skill-based gameplay that mixes timing, puzzle-solving, and action
- Hero upgrades: unlock new feline champions and grow stronger as you progress
- Satisfying animations and smooth physics that make every throw feel great
- Enemies and traps: it's not just puzzles—you’ll have to outsmart swarm enemies too

Become a Cup Champion
Explore a magical world where every level brings new challenges. Battle your way through enemy swarms, master the art of the perfect shot, and rise as the legendary hero of the cup realm.

Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey isn’t just a puzzle game—it’s a heartwarming, skill-testing adventure that’ll keep you coming back for more. Grab your paws, line up your shot, and get ready to become a legend.

games.title: Insect Clicker
games.description: Insect Clicker is a clicker game where you multiply the tarantula coin by clicking. You can buy various upgrades to increase the output of insect, and buy new skins to make you the best insect in world.

games.title: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D
games.description:
This is a game that features racing, destruction, and car customization in an open world! Break cars, jump off ramps, and create your own style!
Immerse yourself in an adrenaline-pumping world of destruction and speed!
 This is a game where you control cars that break down with stunning realism. Doors, hoods, and wheels can all fly off with a powerful impact! Explore a vast open world filled with ramps, presses, and other tools for epic destruction.

 Create unique cars by changing the color of the body, details, and adjusting the size and alignment of the wheels. Meet other cars speeding along the roads and compete with them in spectacular crashes. Crazy jumps, collisions, and complete freedom of action await you!
Realistic car destruction
 Tuning: color, wheels, and style
 Huge open world
 Unique crash test sites
 Destroy, build, and race - create your own chaos on the road!

games.title: Obby Football Soccer 3D
games.description:
⚽ Welcome to “Obby Football Soccer 3D”!

An exciting multiplayer where real-time matches with other players await you! 🎮

Features:
⚡ Online football / soccer and real sport — play with friends 👥 or random opponents.
🥅 Penalties and matches — score amazing goals, save shots, and become your team’s hero!
🌀 Obby challenges — train your reaction and speed while passing football obstacles.
🎨 Colorful 3D graphics and the atmosphere of a real stadium 🏟️.

👑 Go from rookie to champion! Prove that you are the best player ⚽ in the world of football and sport! 🚀

Build your team, compete in matches, score penalties, and enjoy dynamic online soccer! 🎉

games.title: Scale the wheels
games.description:
The game where size matters! Your mission is to change the size of the wheels, transitioning from small to large and vice versa, to overcome a variety of obstacles and progress through levels. But that's not all! The size of the wheels also affects the speed of your car, adding excitement to the gameplay.

With over 30 different tracks to conquer, you'll face unique challenges. Additionally, you can upgrading your acceleration, enabling you to jump farther and collect more coins at the end of each level. So, resize your wheels, and embark on the exhilarating journey to earn the highest score and become a true champion!

games.title: Build Obby World
games.description:
🌈 Welcome to Build Obby World!

Jump, build, explore, and create your own magical world full of surprises, pets, and treasures! 🎁🐾✨

Start with a tiny island… gather resources, then build pieces of other islands to reach new places! 🌟

Tap tiny slimes to bring this world to life!

Upgrade and upgrade your character's tools!

Make your island big, colorful, and happy! 🌈✨

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: It's a game where you gather resources, craft, build, explore, and create your own magical world.

Q: What is the game's unique selling point? How can it hook players?
A: High-quality graphics, many skins, an exciting obby adventure, survival gameplay, resource gathering, and cute slimes and pets.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Trendy skins featuring Italian brainrots.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does progression work? What do players need to do to level up faster?
A: The obby opens new ports and locations through building and construction.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (e.g., common - gold, premium - crystals)?
A: The game has two currencies: gold and crystals. They can be spent on necessary in-game materials, such as an axe or an improved pickaxe for resource gathering.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what effect does it have? Does donating accelerate game progress?
A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. You can buy skins and crystals. Crystals can later be exchanged for gold to buy new, improved tools for faster resource gathering.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can players customize the hero's appearance, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can buy different skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties?
A: Music enhances the game but is not necessary for completing the levels or progression.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are the achievements and how are they earned?
A: The game features a collection of slimes and pets.

games.title: Obby Prison Craft Escape
games.description:
Obby Prison: Craft Escape is an exciting survival adventure in which you need to escape from a prison full of dangers. Once behind bars, you find yourself surrounded by vigilant police, other prisoners, and countless traps in the world. 

Use your skills to navigate through the complex layout of the prison. Avoid police guards, disable security systems to plan your ultimate escape.

The block environment provides endless opportunities for research and strategy development, offering new challenges at every turn. Will you be able to outsmart the police and survive, or will you remain a prisoner forever?

Fight your way to freedom in Obby Prison: Craft Escape, the ultimate test of your survival instincts and creativity. Will you be able to escape from the indestructible prison?

games.title: Happy Obby Land
games.description: Happy Obbi Land is a bright and engaging game for the youngest players, created based on beloved children’s adventures. Here, every child can feel like a real hero and conquer the highest peaks!

games.title: Obby Easy Grow!
games.description:
A game in Roblox style with the Obby mode! Complete exciting and varied obstacle courses for a while, using checkpoints to save your progress and not start all over again if you accidentally fall.

Incredible challenges and unique mechanics await you here! The main feature of the game is the ability to change the size of the character to overcome obstacles and find a way to the finish.

The game has a large selection of characters and deep customization: choose the appearance, clothes and accessories to create a unique hero. Each level is a new challenge, where it is important not only to complete the track, but also to do it faster than everyone else. Watch the timer and improve your results to become the best in this game.

Nice graphics with bright colors and detailed levels make the game visually attractive, and smooth animation adds pleasure from the passage. Compete with friends and players from all over the world to take first place in the leaderboard!

games.title: +1 Speed per Step | Obby Mode
games.description:
Welcome to +1 Speed per Step | Obby Mode.

Every step makes you faster!

Complete obstacles to earn wins!

Rebirth to gain bonuses!

Upgrade your steps!

Buy new trails!

Climb to the top of the leaderboard!

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: It's an arcade game focused on obby and speed. You need to run to increase your speed and raise your level.

Q: What is the game's hook? What will keep players engaged?

A: A unique obstacle course, a rebirth system, leaderboards, and high-quality block graphics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the leveling system work? What's the best way to progress quickly?

A: The more you run, the higher your speed becomes, allowing you to travel further and earn more trophies.

Q: Is the total number of levels known? How many are there?

A: There are 5 different levels.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?

A: The game features two currencies: trophies and steps. Trophies are earned by reaching the end of one of the five levels, while steps can be purchased in the shop or earned through training.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game? Does paying speed up progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. You can buy boosters, skins (colored trails for your character), treadmills to increase running speed, and instant experience (steps).

Q: Is customization available? Can you adjust the hero's appearance, use a level editor, tune vehicles, etc.?

A: Yes, you can purchase a colored trail that follows your character while running.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are there?

A: There are two leaderboards: one for the number of trophies collected and another for time spent in prison.

Q: Is it better to play with sound for immersion, or will it be difficult to progress without it?

A: The music complements the game well, but it is not required to complete the levels.

games.title: Boys - Battle for the District
games.description:
Boys - Battle for the District is an addictive idle clicker game where you tap to battle and conquer urban turf against rival gangs. Grow your power through relentless tapping as you defeat foes and expand your district empire.

Core Gameplay

Tap the screen furiously to smash opponents in fast-paced idle battles - no complex controls needed. Watch enemies crumble with each click.

Key Features

1) Idle Tapping: Simple one-tap combat to defeat gangs and claim districts.

2) Upgrades & Prestige: Boost damage and restart stronger each run.

3)Endless Growth: Climb leaderboards through incremental power spikes.

games.title: Car Escape
games.description:
Car Escape - an exhilarating and thrilling traffic escape game that prepares you for every pulse-pounding adventure. Every step counts, and every action can spell the difference between freedom and gridlock. Can you maneuver your car out of the traffic jam and break free?

Start the engine, press the accelerator, and prepare to escape the chaotic and congested streets. But don't be afraid; with your quick reflexes and sharp intellect, you'll soon master the art of navigating through traffic.

games.title: Mini Golf Battle
games.description:
Mini Golf Battle is a fun and casual mini golf challenge where your goal is simple: hit the ball into the hole with as few shots as possible. The game combines easy controls with tricky levels full of slopes, angles, and obstacles that test your timing and precision.
Each level is designed to get a little harder, so you’ll need to aim carefully, control your shot power, and plan the best path to sink the ball. It’s a relaxing yet addictive golf experience made for quick play sessions.

games.title: Adventure Squad
games.description:
Adventure Squad is a tactical RPG where you assemble a party from 60 unique classes and lead it through dangerous campaigns. Recruit heroes of different classes, arrange them on the battlefield, and combine tanks, fighters, archers, and mages. Your heroes battle waves of monsters while you control their active abilities and choose the right moment to turn the fight around.

Earn gold from victories, strengthen your roster, and unlock new class branches. Each path changes a hero’s stats, role, and abilities. Enemies have distinct traits: they can attack the back line, inflict poison, summon reinforcements, heal allies, or rely on heavy armor. Adapt your formation and tactics, defeat powerful bosses, and advance across the adventure map.

games.title: Slap Master
games.description: Slap Master is a light-hearted casual arcade game, where chaos and laughs are the point. You play as a character whose mission is simple: slap pedestrians as you run, build up the frenzy, and try to escape without getting caught.

games.title: Red Hide Ball
games.description:
Passionate about brain teasers? Want to challenge your logical skills? Then take a look at Hide Ball a logic puzzle game in which you should hide good balls from dreadful and harmful monsters.
Red Hide Ball is an amusing logic game that will test your IQ and raise your intellectual abilities to a new level. Plan every step, estimate a possible outcome and build tactical strategies. Solve logical puzzles, pass lots of interesting levels and win the game!

games.title: Arrow Escape 3D
games.description: Arrow Escape 3D is a calm 3D puzzle game played on the surface of a cube. Tap a colorful arrow to send it sliding off the cube — but it can only escape if its path is clear. Rotate the cube to spot every arrow, clear the blockers in the right order, and empty the whole cube. 1000 levels of bite‑sized, satisfying puzzles await.

games.title: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin
games.description: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin is an action-packed arcade game where players take on the role of a skilled ninja on a stealth mission through treacherous bamboo forests. As the Bamboo Assassin, you must navigate through challenging levels filled with enemies, obstacles, and traps. Employ your stealth, agility, and precision to outmaneuver adversaries and eliminate targets silently. The game emphasizes fast-paced combat, strategic planning, and quick reflexes, offering an immersive experience that tests both your skills and timing. With its sleek design and captivating gameplay, Ninja: Bamboo Assassin delivers a thrilling adventure for fans of ninja-themed games.

games.title: Camel Destroyer
games.description:
A camel has appeared in the city and is looking for adventures! In the game, you will have to help the camel find animals, chat with people, and explore the city. 
Look for hidden machines, guns, cannons, and grenades to destroy buildings and create chaos. Drive cars, operate a helicopter, and even saddle a turtle or a cow for unforgettable adventures. 
Ready for crazy antics and unpredictable situations? Then join the camel on its exciting journey around the city!

games.title: Wild Manager
games.description: Build and manage your own colorful 3D zoo in Wild Manager. Walk through the park, build habitats, care for animals, upgrade roads and facilities, and turn a small zoo into a thriving wildlife destination.

games.title: Zombie Derby
games.description: Zombie Derby is a wild mix of racing and zombie mayhem from Brinemedia. Jump behind the wheel and plow through hordes of the undead standing in your way. But be careful - your fuel is limited, and once you stop, you’ll become easy prey. Time your nitro boosts wisely, as they might be the only thing that gets you over a hill or across a deadly gap.

games.title: Obby: Upgrade Your Lucky Machine!
games.description:
Forget boring spin machines! - here you're not just spinning reels, you're building your own luck machine.
Increase the number of slots, speed up spins, add multipliers and bonuses - every spin becomes more powerful!

🔹 Upgrade everything:

Spin speed—from slow to lightning fast

Number of reels—from 1 to 20

Symbol bonuses—+1 to 5 coins

🔹 Battle against the bot—your challenge!
Who will collect more winnings? The winner takes all winnings from both machines—the loser gets nothing.

🔹 Money—your weapon:
Earn coins, buy upgrades, compete in battles—and watch your machine become unstoppable.

Perfect for those who love:

Idle games with progression

System upgrades

Competing against bots!

About: Upgrade the Spin Machine! – a game where you're not just a player, but the creator of a legendary machine.

games.title: Dessert Maker
games.description: Dessert Maker is a fun-filled dessert creation game where you can craft the sweetest treats! Make creamy ice cream, colorful popsicles, fluffy waffles, refreshing bingsu, and even rolled ice cream. Mix flavors, experiment with toppings, and design your perfect masterpiece. Unleash your creativity and become a true dessert artist!

games.title: Box Magician
games.description: Box Magician is a charming Halloween-themed physics puzzle game where you help a young witch collect her magical treasure. Tap to remove crates, shift the structure, and guide the treasure chest safely into her hands. Each object reacts differently — some explode, some roll, and others change the balance — making every level a fun challenge of timing, logic, and strategy. With cute Halloween visuals, smooth animations, and progressively smarter puzzles, Box Magician delivers a delightful and engaging gameplay experience for all puzzle lovers.

games.title: Obby: +1 to spaceflight altitude
games.description: Obby: +1 to Spaceflight Altitude invites you to embark on an exhilarating space adventure. Experience the excitement of customizable characters and rocket journeys online for free. Explore the galaxy and hone your spaceflight skills in this unforgettable game filled with thrills and exploration.

games.title: Sort Master
games.description:
Drag, tap, or move items to organize or sort them.
Each one is a distinct mini-game.
Arrange items by size, color, or another specified order.
Match items in pairs or groups.
Complete a visual task like building an image or aligning pieces.
Once everything is sorted or arranged correctly, the level ends and you can move on.

games.title: Grass Defense
games.description: Grass Defense is a strategic tower defense where you must protect the wilderness from waves of fierce creatures. Build and upgrade powerful towers, manage resources, and adapt your tactics as enemies grow stronger. With dynamic environments, diverse foes, and challenging levels, you’ll test your strategy and skill to survive the untamed wilds and uncover hidden mysteries.

games.title: Run The Electricity
games.description:
Run The Electricity is a unique puzzle game that combines simplicity and benefits for your mind. It is designed to give relaxation, help to cope with stress and improve concentration.

Instead of intense gameplay and a race against time, a calm process awaits you here: you just need to connect lines, lamps and energy sources in a closed circuit to turn on the light.

Minimalistic design, smooth animation and soothing music create an atmosphere of complete tranquility comparable to yoga. This is not just a game, but a means to meditate and combat anxiety. You can play it at home, on the road, or at work to distract yourself and restore your mental balance.

Smart puzzles train logic and imagination, and simple mechanics allow you to have fun from the first seconds. Discover a world of light, harmony and tranquility!

games.title: Moon Chess
games.description: Moon Chess is a cosmic strategy game where you face off against the mysterious Half Moon! Connect the phases of the lunar cycle — from Crescent to Full Moon — to score points and outwit the shifting tides of light and shadow. Inspired by real astronomical phenomena, every move brings you closer to mastering the moon’s rhythm. Are you clever enough to outplay the lunar cycle itself?

games.title: Clash of Tanks
games.description: Clash of Tanks is real time strategy tank game. Objective is to destroy the opponent base by deploying the tanks. Each tank has its own weakness and strength, selecting the right tanks at appropriate time is best way to win the battle. Good Luck

games.title: Monster Truck Stunt Game Racing Games
games.description: Welcome to the world of monster track stunt games. Get ready for thrilling monster truck stunts in one of the most exciting truck games! Drive powerful monster truck racing vehicles, perform insane stunt jumps, and conquer mega ramps in this action-packed car game experience. Master racing car game challenges, speed through impossible tracks, and prove your skills in monster truck stunts! Take control of a powerful stunt truck and experience truck stunt racing like never before! Compete in monster truck stunts, execute high-speed stunt jumps, and master the most extreme stunt tracks. Drive your monster trucks in the stunts and obstacles of the open free car stunts mode!

games.title: Screw Jam
games.description: Welcome to Screw Jam, where the challenge of unscrewing puzzles and sorting colorful screws, pins, and nuts takes center stage! Dive into an immersive world of wood and bolts, where every unscrew brings you closer to solving the ultimate screw pin jam puzzle. With each twist, you'll match colors and sort nuts and bolts to clear your path through tricky levels.

games.title: CubeGate
games.description:
Puzzle-platformer inspired by portal-style test chambers. Move through clean sci-fi rooms, pick up glowing cubes and place them on pressure plates to power doors, bridges, and elevators. Every room is a mini-logic task: sometimes one cube isn’t enough, sometimes the order matters, and sometimes you’ll have to jump first, then power the gate.

Use your movement and your head: combine precise jumps with smart cube placement, watch where the cables go, and follow the energy lines to the exit. Short levels, clear goals, instant restarts — perfect for quick sessions.
Can you activate every gate and escape the chamber?

games.title: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle
games.description: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle offers a fun brain challenge where you strategically unscrew pieces to solve puzzles. Enjoy this free online game without downloads, perfect for fans of strategy and logical thinking, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment.

games.title: Build Your Dream Car
games.description: Build your dream car, upgrade engines and nitro, win intense drag races, and dominate the streets with perfect shifting skills.

games.title: Blob Twist – Color Puzzle
games.description: A fun and colorful puzzle game where you twist, dodge obstacles, and guide your blob to the finish. Test your timing and reflexes across challenging levels!

games.title: Decode the Movie Quote
games.description: Welcome to an exciting game where you guess famous movie quotes one letter at a time! Show your wit and prove you're a true movie buff. Discover iconic lines from your favorite films, enjoy fun challenges, and have hours of entertainment. Play solo or compete with friends to see who knows movies best!

games.title: Racing: Destruction and Chase
games.description:
Dive into a world where every crash is a masterpiece!  

- Realistic Destruction: Flying doors, hoods, wheels, and sparks under your feet.  
- Freedom of Action: Race, evade the police, or explore the open world at your own pace.  
- Unlimited Tuning: Customize paint jobs, wheel sizes, suspension height, and create your unique style.  
- Destruction Tools: Use presses, hammers, ramps to test vehicle durability.  

Key Features:  
- Dynamic police chases with realistic physics.  
- AI-driven bots that populate the game world.  
- Instant car repair for non-stop action.  

Each collision tells a new story. Every ride is your choice!

games.title: Halloween Merge Mania
games.description: Halloween Merge Mania challenges players to merge eerie characters, like pumpkins, to create stronger beings. Inspired by 2048, this game requires strategic thinking. As you advance, new surprises keep the game fresh and engaging, offering a thrilling Halloween-themed merging experience.

games.title: Hot Rods Arena Stars
games.description:
Welcome to the arena where the weak don’t survive!

Take the wheel of a legendary, heavily armed Hot Rod and challenge dozens of ruthless opponents.

Here, there are no rules — only speed, firepower, and your reflexes decide who becomes the champion. Blast enemies with precise shots, collect stars, and unlock powerful upgrades for your battle beast.

Swap weapons, reinforce your armor, hit top speed, and leave nothing but smoke and wreckage behind!

Every arena is a new challenge, where only those willing to take risks can claim victory.

Ready to prove you’re the king of the road? Then hit the gas and race toward glory!

games.title: Tap Hunters
games.description:
Clicker game with colorful and bright graphic.  
Tap to hunt monsters, build your team of heroes and upgrade them. Collect and power up with collection of weapons.  
Travel to new worlds to earn rewards, and grow stronger as you play. With each run you will able to reach higher levels.

games.title: Pickaxe Crusher Idle
games.description:
Dive into the thrilling world of underground mines in Pickaxe Crusher Idle. Play as a daring miner with a bouncing pickaxe, dashing left and right to explore deeper and deeper into the caves.
Collect resources, unlock new tools such as axes, arrows, swords, and more, and upgrade your skills to become a true master of mining.
Use talents and upgrades to accelerate your progress, unlock achievements, and advance through the prestige system. Each descent into the depths brings new opportunities, challenges, and valuable treasures.
Are you ready to venture into the abyss and become a mining legend?

games.title: Hexa Word
games.description: Hexa Word is a cosy word-association puzzle. Each level gives you a few themed groups and a hex board full of word tiles — pick a group, tap the words that belong to it, and watch each cluster light up. The catch: some words look like they could fit two groups, so sorting them out is the real puzzle. Eight themed packs (Everyday, Cosmos, Wild World, Kitchen & Food, Travel & Places, Mystery & Crime, Fantasy & Myth, Sports & Games), endless generated levels, and Hint / Reveal / Shuffle helpers when you're stuck. No timers, gentle music — a relaxing brain-tickler you can play one-handed.

games.title: Heroes of Arena
games.description:
Heroes of the arena” is an exciting game where everyone can become a real hero. Here you can fight with friends, pump up your character, get pets and participate in clan wars.

In the game you are waiting for a lot of exciting adventures and dangers. You will be able to create a unique character, choosing your own way of development and improving his skills and abilities. Together with your friends you will be able to unite in powerful teams and defeat enemies. You will also be able to get yourself loyal pets that will help you in battles and explore the world.

Join “Heroes of the Arena” and start your journey through the exciting world of adventure! The game will give you unforgettable impressions and allow you to plunge into the atmosphere of battles and dangers. Become a real warrior and prove your strength and skill!

games.title: Grass Land
games.description:
Welcome to Grassland, an immersive exploration game set in a lush green land with dense grass.

You embark on an exciting journey to uncover hidden resources beneath the vibrant grasslands. Armed with your trusty grass cutter machine, you must navigate the vast landscape, gather resources, and expand your base to thrive in this unique environment.

Game Features:
-Explore the Verdant Grassland: Discover hidden treasures, and unique locations as you venture further into the unknown.
-Resource Gathering: Use your grass cutter machine to cut through the grass and uncover valuable resources. Collect wood, coal, and other precious items hidden beneath the surface. Each resource will play a crucial role in expanding your base and unlocking new upgrades.
-Base Building: Start with a small base and gradually expand it as you gather more resources. Build structures, markets, workshops, and storage facilities to support your exploration efforts. Customize your base to suit your playstyle and unlock new features to enhance your gameplay.
-Upgrade and Unlock New Features: Enhance your grass cutter machine by upgrading its strength, speed, and fuel capacity. Invest in advanced technology and tools to improve your efficiency in cutting grass and discovering resources.

Key Features:
-Vast and immersive grass-covered landscape to explore
-Satisfying Grass Cutting Effect
-Resource Gathering and Management
-Enjoy the immersive gameplay with a sense of exploration and discovery
-Immerse yourself in stunning visuals of the grassy landscape


Are you ready to wield your grass cutter machine and become the master of the grassy landscape? The journey awaits you in Grassland!

games.title: Delete part in LoveStory
games.description:
In this dop 2 game, you'll witness a glimpse into the character's life and destiny.
Reflect on the missing elements and incorporate them in a single line!
When your brain out expectations are fulfilled, their dissatisfaction will fade, and a smile will grace your face!
Once again, their countenances will beam and they'll rejoice, as if they've received a windfall.

games.title: Arrow Rescue
games.description:
Cute animals are trapped inside dangerous mazes, and only your strategy can save them! 

Pull arrows in the correct order to remove obstacles, unlock hidden paths, and guide every animal to safety. 

Each puzzle introduces new challenges that test your logic and planning. 

With relaxing gameplay, colorful visuals, and hundreds of handcrafted levels, every rescue is both rewarding and satisfying. 

Think carefully, choose wisely, and become the hero every animal is waiting for!

games.title: Road Fury
games.description: Unleash your fury on the highway an shoot down everything that moves! Tip: if you can't shoot it, take it... those are power-ups! Upgrade your car to withstand a longer ride, beat bosses and get as far as you can so you can compare your highscores with others! Become the furious king of the road!

games.title: Capybas
games.description: Capybas is a cozy logic puzzle game that blends the deduction of Minesweeper with the rule-based thinking of Sudoku. Find the hidden capybaras by using clues from colors, rows, columns, and adjacency rules. Complete levels, earn coins, and unlock new capybaras and themes as you progress through Easy, Medium, and Hard modes.

games.title: Locked in Grandma’s Basement 2: Revenge - Horror Escape
games.description:
Locked in Grandma’s Basement 2: Revenge – Horror Escape is the chilling sequel to the cult classic point-and-click horror game.
After managing to escape once, Grandma has found you again — and this time, she’s locked you in an even darker, more twisted place.
Explore eerie rooms, solve cryptic puzzles, and uncover cursed objects and grotesque clues.
Use your logic and courage to find tools, unlock hidden paths, and perform a disturbing ritual to escape.
Every item has a purpose, every detail tells a story — and Grandma is always watching.
Will you manage to escape again, or will you become her next ritual offering?
Perfect for fans of horror, escape rooms, and point-and-click adventures.

games.title: Fruit Madness
games.description:
A delightful fruit puzzle where adorable kawaii fruits merge in the chase for juicy high scores! 🍉

The rules are simple and familiar: when two identical fruits touch, they combine into a new, even tastier one! 🍋🍇

Use unique boosters — level up your fruits, shrink them down, or clear whole clusters from the board!

Don’t save your boosters for later: at the start of each round, you get 4 unique ones, plus another random booster for every 500 points you earn.
The longer you play, the more fun and fruity combos await! 🍊

games.title: Boat Merge
games.description: Boat Merge is a relaxing idle merge game where players combine matching boats to create faster and more valuable vessels. Build your fleet, unlock dozens of unique boats, expand your waterways, earn coins automatically, and use upgrades and boosters to progress further.

games.title: Power ball soccer
games.description: Top down soccer game with special moves, 2 game modes, 16 characters, 32 levels. Unlock new characters. the next opponents are stronger than the previous ones.

games.title: Brainrot Merge: Drop Puzzle
games.description: Brainrot Merge: Drop Puzzle is a wildly absurd merge puzzle game where quirky creatures evolve into chaotic meme-powered icons. Drop and combine animals to unlock hilarious AI-generated characters, each more bizarre than the last. With endless levels, unexpected surprises, and brain-zapping humor, every merge brings you one step closer to the ultimate meme monster.

games.title: Sort Puzzle
Laser Survivor
games.description:
Laser Survivor, a cyberpunk roguelike action-adventure set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse, the last hope for humanity rests in the hands of five heroes fighting hordes of demons pouring through a dimensional rift. Featuring pixel art visuals, randomized weapons, chiptune soundtracks, and relentless survival gameplay, every run is a test of adaptation and skill.

Story
The world has fallen. A dimensional rift has unleashed an unstoppable flood of demons, tearing through what remains of civilization. But from the chaos, five warriors rise. Each wielding unique powers forged for survival in this cyberpunk hellscape. Dropped at random into corrupted maps, they must adapt with whatever weapons and passive abilities they find, carving their path through waves of enemies, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering the truth behind the rift. The fate of Earth depends on them.

Heroes
Blaze: Fires homing bullets that lock onto the nearest enemy, ensuring no demon can escape.
Neon: Projects a protective energy shield that damages anything foolish enough to get close.
Hunter: Drops explosives that create deadly zones, controlling the battlefield with traps.
Slash: Slices enemies apart with razor-sharp horizontal cuts that pierce entire hordes.
Jaxx: A cyber-brute with massive, scaling area damage, crushing everything in his path.


Features
Cyberpunk Roguelike Gameplay: Every run is unique, with randomized spawn points, weapons, and abilities.
5 Maps to Conquer: Battle through the Lab, Forest, Crypt, Factory, and Dungeon, each swarming with demon hordes.
10 Active Weapons & 10 Passive Abilities: Build your arsenal on the fly as you adapt to randomized loadouts.
8 Missions & 11 Upgrades: Progress through challenging missions, earn permanent upgrades, and unlock new survival tactics.
Collectibles & Lore: Discover secrets that reveal the origins of the rift and the story behind the invasion.
Retro Pixel Art: Neon-infused visuals with hand-crafted pixel art and gameplay by the Felicity team.
80s Chiptune Soundtrack: Pulsating tracker music by Drozerix, driving the action with nostalgic energy.

Why Play Laser Survivor?
Fast-paced roguelike survival set in a sci-fi cyberpunk apocalypse.
Play as five unique heroes, each with distinct base abilities and upgrade paths.
Endless replayability with randomized runs and evolving builds.
Perfect for fans of pixel art shooters, bullet-hell roguelikes, and retro-inspired chiptune soundtracks.

Laser Survivor is more than survival. It’s humanity’s last stand in a cyberpunk post-apocalypse. Will you master the chaos, close the rift, and save the world... or be consumed by the demons?

games.title: Find the Vampire
games.description:
Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

In this game, vampires disguise themselves as ordinary people, animals and even objects. Use unique exterminator kits and detectors to expose the hidden enemies. Unlock new areas, complete various levels and defeat the Vampire Lord to save the citizens.

KEY FEATURES:
- Vampire Exterminator Kits: Get new tools to fight the bloodsuckers.
- Search Among Us: Vampires can be anyone - from neighbors to trees.
- Rescue Citizens: Free people from vampire isolation.
- New Locations: Complete levels in different areas of the city.
- Vampire Tactics: Vampires become more cunning with each level.
- Story Levels: Each location reveals a unique story.

games.title: One Man Army: Battle Game
games.description: One Man Army: A casual single player Battle Game that will test your warrior skills and battle reflexes. With challenging levels and intense battles, you must use your tactical skills to survive and defend against arrows, canon, and even dragon flames.

games.title: Nubiks build a defense vs zombies
games.description:
Nubiks build a defense vs zombies - This is a game for two players, or for playing solo and competing against other players. A whole world awaits! 15+ different modes within a single game, dozens of skins and blocks.
Team up with a friend or play alone. There are both co-op and single-player modes. Play in survival mode or sandbox. Do whatever you want in this game!

games.title: Save the Noob
games.description: Save the Noob is an engaging puzzle game that invites players to creatively rescue Noob from threats using a magical line. Accessible online for free across devices, it boasts numerous challenging levels that offer fun and strategic gameplay, perfect for passing the time.

games.title: Amaze!
games.description: Get ready to be amazed! In this game, pop and move the ball to paint your way through challenging maze puzzles. Color every square to unlock new levels, but be strategic—AMAZE gets tougher as you progress. Each level is a canvas, and you must fill every square completely to conquer the maze. Don’t miss a spot, or you’ll be stuck forever! Are you ready for an extraordinary paint puzzle adventure? Let’s pop the maze with color and crossy road challenges!

games.title: Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!
games.description:
Welcome to "Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!" - an exciting action game with a sword, where you fight against an army of monsters! Get ready for an epic battle and test your agility and blade skill. Survive in the monsters' lair and become a real sword master!

🎮 A game inspired by popular projects such as "War of the Knights: Sword Arena Battle 3D", "Sword Master: Slash Enemies!" and "Swing Sword: Slash Enemies into Pieces!" Here you will find a mix of the themes of "poppy playtime", "rainbow friends", "hagi wagi", "repo" and the atmosphere of the "Dendy World"!

⚔️ Game Features:
- Simple and clear controls
- Stylish 3D graphics in retro dandy and repo style
- Exciting gameplay with chopping enemies
- Various levels and enemy characters
- A large selection of sword skins
- A leaderboard where you can compete with friends

⚡ Ready to join the fight? Then take your sword and start the battle with monsters!

games.title: Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter
games.description: Experience wild ragdoll physics and hilarious shooting action in Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter! Unlock weapons, conquer fun challenges, and send ragdolls flying in this addictive, stress-relieving online shooter game.

games.title: Brain Crazy: IQ Challenge Puzzle
games.description: Brain Crazy: IQ Challenge Puzzle is an addictive, mind-bending puzzle game designed to test common sense, logic, and out-of-the-box thinking. Packed with hundreds of quirky riddles, tricky brain teasers, and hilarious scenarios, it challenges conventional logic and pushes players to find unexpected solutions.

games.title: Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle Game
games.description:
Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle
Enter a futuristic world of glowing pathways and strategic challenges in Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle.
Navigate neon arrows, plan your moves carefully, and solve increasingly complex logic puzzles. Every level presents a new challenge that tests your observation, timing, and problem-solving skills.
What looks simple at first quickly becomes a rewarding brain exercise. Analyze the board, identify the correct sequence, and clear the arrows without creating obstacles along the way.
FEATURES
• Challenging arrow-based logic puzzles
 • Futuristic neon and sci-fi visuals
 • Easy to learn, rewarding to master
 • Hundreds of handcrafted levels
 • Increasing difficulty and new puzzle layouts
 • Smooth controls and satisfying gameplay
 • Train your logic and critical thinking skills
 • Play anytime, anywhere at your own pace


Whether you’re looking for a relaxing puzzle experience or a true test of your problem-solving abilities, Cyber Arrows: Brain Puzzle offers satisfying gameplay in a stylish neon cyber world.
Can you master every puzzle and become the ultimate arrow strategist?

games.title: Knock and Run. 100 Doors Escape
games.description:
Become the fastest and most daring stickman in this fun arcade game! Your goal is to race through the corridors of the hotel, ring the doors, knock and slam them, arranging epic pranks. The main thing is not to get caught! Residents' reactions are unpredictable, and danger can lurk around every corner.
- Dynamic gameplay — run, prank and avoid capture!
- Different doors and reactions — someone will get scared, someone will get angry!
- Fun challenges — show agility and speed!
- Bright minimalistic style is a classic stickman action game!
- Simple controls — addictive gameplay in a couple of clicks!

games.title: Sumo Fury
games.description: Dive into the thrilling world of Sumo Fury, where you can acquire powerful wrestlers with superior stats and challenge rivals globally. Show your mastery in combat, earn in-game currency through victories, and unlock stronger fighters to dominate the arena. Achieve glory and wealth with each victory, the excitement of Sumo Fury is sure to captivate you!

games.title: Machine Eater
games.description: Create blocks using the resources you collect, expand your ship, and strategically place structures with different features on the blocks you create before selecting your enemy on the radar. Use your strategy skills to eliminate the enemies you detect on the radar. The structures you collect from enemies will add depth to your strategy.

games.title: Squid Game Tower Defense
games.description:
Squid Game Tower Defense battle against Squid Game characters in the towers. Complete challenges, defeat enemies, and become the victor in this thrilling fight!

Welcome to Squid Game Tower Defense — a unique and thrilling game where you will battle against characters from the famous Squid Game show. Unlike traditional Tower Defense games, your task here is not to defend towers but to attack and fight enemies that reside within them.

Each tower is not just a structure; it's a place where dangerous characters are waiting for battle. You'll engage in a series of exciting fights, defeating enemies at every level and overcoming various challenges. The game features characters well-known to all fans of the show, each with its own unique abilities and characteristics.

Complete levels, improve your combat skills, gather valuable resources, and unlock new opportunities for your battles. Make sure that your strategic abilities help you defeat even the toughest enemies standing in your way. Enjoy fast-paced combat, challenging missions, and an atmosphere that immerses you into the world of Squid Game.

games.title: Farm: Clear the Jam
games.description:
A calm but catchy farm puzzle where every animal wants to escape a crowded pen. One wrong move, and the path is blocked again.

Watch each movement direction, plan the order, and guide cows, sheep, chickens, and piglets to clear the field. The levels are easy to read, but gradually demand sharper logic.

• bright farm atmosphere
• simple one-swipe controls 
• short levels for quick sessions
• order, attention, and logic challenges
• cute animals and clean visuals

games.title: Snake Rush
games.description:
Get ready to dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of Snake Rush! 🐍 Embark on an electrifying journey through this competitive twist on the classic Snake game. Challenge your survival instincts and strive to outmaneuver your opponents in the ultimate Snake Rush showdown!

With Snake Rush, you'll experience the timeless arcade fun with a fresh, modern flair. Engage in thrilling live events online, where the competition never sleeps! Can you climb to the top of the leaderboard and claim victory in this dynamic mobile adaptation of the arcade sensation?

Snake Rush merges cutting-edge visuals with the iconic gameplay mechanics of the original snake game, delivering an unmatched gaming experience that will keep you hooked for hours on end. Get ready to slither, dodge, and dominate your way to glory in Snake Rush! 🎮

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: Snake Rush is a game where you play as a slithering snake, surviving as long as possible by running into and defeating opponents.

Q: What is the game's unique feature? What will hook players?
A: Great graphics and unique, Indian-themed skins.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game features unique Indian-style skins and offers a revive option for watching an ad, which gives the player a chance to recover their progress after a mistake.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does leveling up work? What should players do to level up faster?
A: Cut off as many enemies as possible and complete tasks from the menu.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available, and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The game has one currency, gold, which can be spent on skins for your snake.

Q: Is there character customization? Can the hero's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc., be configured?
A: Yes, you can purchase skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound make it difficult to progress?
A: The music complements the game and makes it more dynamic, but it is not necessary for completing the game.

games.title: Jim's World: Adventure Games
games.description:
Jim's World gives you the chance to step back in time to your childhood with the legendary challenge in the adventure game: Princess Rescue. The World of this Game - a totally new old-school running game, contains well-designed levels, various enemies, super bosses, simple gameplay, excellent graphics, and soothing music and sounds.
Jim's World has been nothing and empty since the Princess got kidnapped into the jungle. But then, the adventure begins!
Your task is to help Jim run through the mysterious jungle, jump over the obstacles and super evil monsters, and save the beautiful Princess at the adventure's final destination

games.title: Mechanic Simulator: Car Repair
games.description:
Mechanic Simulator: Car Repair is the best mechanic simulator! Try to fix all the cars in the service station. In this game you can fix cars and then drift them around the city and destroy everything around! This mechanic simulator game!


Features:
- More than 17+ cars
- Exciting graphics
- Easy operation
- Realistic cars
- Epic Races
- Realistic crashes

games.title: Noob Fuse
games.description:
Join the crazy adventures of Noob.
This time he decided to take bombs, a lighter and blow up all the houses to take the cherished crystals.
You will have to visit many structures from the smallest to the largest and arrange a large-scale explosion! 
Each house has a hidden cache in the form of a chest. Get to it and open it as soon as possible!

Features of the game:
+ Everyone's favorite Minecraft story
+ Epic explosions
+ Cool physics
+ Challenging tasks

games.title: Mix Monsters: Fun Merge
games.description: Mix Monsters: Fun Merge is a captivating puzzle game that lets you combine quirky characters into unique creatures. Accessible on multiple platforms without the need for downloads or registration, it offers an enjoyable and creative experience suitable for all ages, perfect for quick entertainment and skill development.

games.title: Airplane Factory - Tycoon
games.description: Build and expand your own aviation empire in Airplane Factory - Tycoon ! Start small by producing lightweight planes, and gradually scale up to manufacturing giant airliners and advanced fighter jets. Manage production lines, upgrade your factory facilities, enhance your manager’s skills, and unlock new types of aircraft to boost your profits. Strategically grow your business to become the ultimate aircraft manufacturer!

games.title: Combat Guardian: Under Attack
games.description: Combat Guardian: Under Attack is a patriotic arcade shooter where you defend America across all 50 states — that means 50 unique levels. Battle through 8 different enemy types: street thugs, rogue agents, traitor soldiers, biker gangs, smugglers, corrupt cops, mercenaries, and powerful bosses. Each state features its own terrain, color palette, and enemy combinations. Start in Alabama and fight your way to Wyoming, liberating the nation one level at a time. What makes it unique? Enemies grow smarter and more aggressive as you progress. Unlock special attack power-ups and star-spangled finishers. With fast-paced combat, tight controls, and massive replayability, this game delivers classic arcade action. Works perfectly on desktop and mobile browsers. Answer the call — become the Combat Guardian!

games.title: Master of Numbers
games.description: Experience the excitement of mathematics with Master of Numbers, a fast-paced online game. Race to collect beneficial numbers while dodging harmful ones, enhancing your math and strategy skills as you progress through increasingly challenging levels. Play on your phone or computer for an engaging mental workout.

games.title: Break The Car Completely
games.description:
"Break The Car Completely" is a unique crash test simulator that challenges your extreme driving skills. The main task is simple: to reach the finish line, overcoming dangerous obstacles.

However, the key difficulty lies in the fact that the entire track is literally littered with various obstacles. Any collision, even the smallest one, will instantly destroy your car, so the only survival strategy is extremely careful and calculated movement. This is a test for those who value precision and control over the situation.

This driving simulator was created especially for fans of exciting BeamNG walkthroughs, because the game contains tracks styled after similar well-known routes. Now you have the opportunity to go through them on your phone or computer.

The developers have implemented destructible cars and realistic motion physics simulation, which makes every ride unpredictable and exciting. Despite the sophisticated physics and high-quality graphics, the game is not demanding on the resources of your device and gives you an authentic experience of real driving, even on weak or old gadgets.

games.title: Weapons Merge Hero
games.description:
Weapons Merge Hero is a fast-paced 2D merge action game where precision and strategy matter.
Merge weapons of the same level to create stronger knives, power up your hero, and destroy strange planet-like enemies.

During gameplay, the hero fights using knives only.
Throw knives into round, planet-shaped enemies and keep hitting them until they explode. Each successful hit brings you closer to victory, but timing and upgrades are key.

Merge identical weapons to increase knife damage, speed, and power. As enemies get tougher, only the strongest merged weapons will survive.

Simple controls, satisfying explosions, and endless action make Weapons Merge Hero easy to play and hard to put down.

games.title: Toco Teens Halloween Party
games.description:
Step into the spooky fun world of Toca Teens Halloween Party, a fashionable Halloween dress-up game made just for style lovers! 🎃
Join the Toca teens as they get ready for the most glamorous Halloween event of the year. Choose from eerie yet elegant outfits, haunting accessories, and bold makeup looks to create the perfect spooky-chic style.

Mix and match trendy costumes, experiment with hairstyles, and make each teen stand out on the dance floor. Whether you want a gothic witch, a cute pumpkin fairy, or a vampire diva — the possibilities are endless!

games.title: Escape Strange Girl’s House
games.description:
Escape Strange Girl’s House is a dark point-and-click adventure available on both web and Android.

You wake up in a locked, unfamiliar house. The windows are sealed, the doors are bolted, and it doesn’t take long to realize you’re not here by choice — you’ve been kidnapped. The only way forward is to explore, uncover clues, and piece together who lives here… and why they’ve trapped you.

Every object can hide a secret: a sofa may conceal something beneath its cushions, a flowerpot may hold a key, or a book on the shelf may reveal disturbing truths about the strange girl who owns this place. Interacting with the environment unlocks new paths, changes the protagonist’s perception, and pushes the story into darker territory.

As in every classic point-and-click adventure, you’ll collect items and use them in clever ways to solve puzzles, repair devices, and access new rooms. A simple glass of water, a sharp knife, or a roll of tape could be the difference between staying trapped forever and finding your way to freedom.

The narrative unfolds gradually, shifting from calm exploration to mounting dread. What begins as a harmless search of a living room turns into a chilling discovery of obsessions, sinister secrets, and unsettling mannequins that seem far too lifelike.

Your ultimate goal is clear: escape the house before it’s too late. But as you progress, you’ll uncover more about the girl’s twisted hobbies — and the terrifying fate that might await you if you fail.

Will you outsmart her and unlock the final door to freedom, or become just another part of her dark collection?

games.title: PC Cafe Simulator 3D
games.description:
🎮 Welcome to "PC Cafe Simulator 3D" — become the owner of the gaming club of your dreams!

💻 Assemble gaming PCs from components: powerful processors, top-tier graphics cards, and cool accessories for the ultimate gaming experience.

🕹️ Host gamer clients, including popular characters, and earn money from their love of gaming!

🔧 Repair equipment and keep your club running smoothly, ensuring everyone enjoys their favorite games.

📈 Climb the leaderboard of the best club owners, expand your business, and add more gaming stations.

🌅 Day and night cycles bring your club to life: lively during the day, planning and upgrading at night.

🔥 Build a club that becomes legendary among gamers! Play "PC Cafe Simulator 3D" today!

games.title: Run from 67
games.description:
A first-person game of hide-and-seek in a dark school. Find 6 backpacks on each
floor to unlock the seventh door and get out before Sixseven catches you.

He hunts by sound, not by sight. Sprinting carries far, walking half as far,
crouching almost nothing — and if you stand perfectly still, you make no sound
at all. A circle on the minimap shows exactly how far away you can be heard
right now.

Your flashlight both saves and betrays you: you see nothing without it, but
shine it in his face and he charges from across the floor. It runs down fast and
recharges at wall panels. Throw a coin to send the noise somewhere else and slip
past while he investigates.

Seven floors, each with its own light: night blue, emergency green, sodium
orange, ultraviolet, the pool, a fire alarm, and a total blackout.

games.title: Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival
games.description: Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival is a one-tap action adventure where you battle and survive in the wild. Wield your axe to fend off wolves, chop wood, and build shelter as you explore for resources and hidden chests. Level up, choose upgrades, and outlast growing dangers while managing hunger and health in this engaging forest challenge.

games.title: Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks
games.description: Dive into the world of crafting drinks with the exciting **Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks** game. Explore diverse ingredients to create unique cocktails. Enjoy the mixology experience on any device, unwind at your virtual bar, and become a master drink creator.

games.title: Screw Out Jam Puzzle
games.description: Join the exciting adventure of Screw Out: Jam Puzzle, a game filled with engaging nuts and bolts challenges. Explore countless jam mazes across 1000 levels on your phone and computer. Unlock rewards, harness boosters, and keep your winning streak alive in this thrilling free online puzzle experience!

games.title: Pixel hero survivor

Traffic Car Circle is a fast-paced traffic management puzzle game that puts your timing, focus, and decision-making skills to the test. Your mission is simple: guide a continuous stream of cars safely into a busy roundabout without causing collisions. While the controls are easy to learn, mastering the traffic becomes increasingly challenging as more vehicles enter the road.

Every successful move keeps the vehicles moving smoothly, but one mistimed tap can create a chain reaction of crashes. Stay alert, react quickly, and keep the roads clear as the pace continues to increase.

Each level introduces faster traffic and greater challenges that require precise timing and smart planning. Race against the clock, improve your high score, and discover how long you can keep the traffic flowing without an accident. Whether you're looking for a quick casual game or a satisfying skill challenge, Traffic Car Circle delivers addictive gameplay that is easy to pick up and difficult to master.

## Features

* Simple one-touch controls
* Addictive traffic management gameplay
* Challenging roundabout puzzles
* Increasing difficulty with faster traffic
* Race against the clock
* Smooth and colorful visuals
* Quick levels perfect for short play sessions
* Improve your timing and reaction speed
* Fun for players of all ages

Can you stay calm under pressure and become the ultimate traffic controller? Jump into Traffic Car Circle and keep every vehicle moving safely!
