games.title: Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle
games.description:
Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle combines colorful region puzzles with simple but challenging placement rules. Your goal is to place exactly one cat inside every colored territory while making sure no two cats share the same row or column.

Cats also need their personal space. They cannot touch each other diagonally, even at the corners. Every placement affects the entire board, so careful observation and logical thinking are essential.

The puzzles begin gently, allowing you to understand the rules and develop your strategy. As you progress, the boards become more challenging and require deeper planning. Every cat must be placed for a clear reason, because random guesses can quickly lead to mistakes.

Wrong moves cost hearts, so take your time and study the grid before tapping. Eliminate impossible spaces, compare colored regions, and use row and column restrictions to discover the correct solution.

Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle is perfect for players who enjoy Sudoku, logic grids, brain teasers, and relaxing puzzle games. Its simple controls and adorable cat theme make every challenge easy to start but satisfying to master.

How to Play
Place One Cat in Every Region

Each colored territory must contain exactly one cat. Leaving a region empty or placing multiple cats inside it will prevent you from completing the puzzle.

Avoid Matching Rows and Columns

No two cats can appear in the same horizontal row or vertical column. A placed cat blocks every other space along both lines.

Keep Cats Apart

Cats cannot touch diagonally. Even if two cats only meet at their corners, the placement is not allowed.

Protect Your Hearts

Incorrect taps reduce your available hearts. Think carefully, use logic, and avoid guessing whenever possible.

Features
Relaxing cat-themed logic puzzles
One cat required in every colored region
Row and column exclusion rules
Diagonal placement restrictions
Heart-based mistake system
Simple tap controls
Increasing puzzle difficulty
Clean and colorful visuals
Short levels for quick play sessions
Brain training through logical deduction
Easy to understand and challenging to master

Study every region, find the safest spaces, and place all the cats correctly in Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle.

games.title: Escape from the Portal
games.description: Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld. A dark atmosphere and an otherworld filled with secrets and dangers.

games.title: Black Friday Mystery Sale
games.description: Dive into the excitement of Black Friday shopping with a twist! In the Black Friday Mystery Sale dress up game, fashion surprises await, and it's up to you to style the princesses with fabulous outfits hidden inside the mystery boxes. Ready for a shopping spree you’ll never forget? Start playing now!

games.title: Snake Arena
games.description: Snake Arena is a multiplayer game where you navigate vibrant arenas, outsmart rivals, and gather power-ups. Perfect your strategy to enhance your snake’s growth with each collected point. Embrace nostalgic vibes mixed with innovative gameplay as you tailor your snake's appearance.

games.title: Cube Island 3D
games.description:
Welcome to the exciting world of survival and adventure! In the role of brave Steve, you have to start from scratch on a mysterious and uninhabited island. Your goal is to turn this corner of nature into a real paradise for life.

Game Features:

- Survival and Adventure.
- Tasks and Achievements.
- Construction and Development.
- Resources and Crafting.
- Discovery of New Islands.

An exciting journey from survival to prosperity, where your creativity and strategic decisions will be the key to success. Get ready for the adventure of your life on an island of your own making!

games.title: Yummy Shelf
games.description: Yummy Shelf is a relaxing 3D sorting and matching puzzle game. Organize colorful food items, match three identical products, and clear every shelf before time runs out. Use helpful boosters to overcome tricky layouts and complete increasingly challenging levels.

games.title: Draw an Obby
games.description:
🔥 The Awesome Game for True Pros! 🔥

Want to test your obby skills? Then this is the game for you! 🎮

Here’s what awaits you:

💥 30 epic levels with crazy obstacles — stay sharp!

🎨 Unique twist: draw your own shapes to overcome obstacles — you’ve never seen anything like this before! ✨

👉 Perfect for:

fans of Roblox Obby — this one’s even cooler!

games.title: Archer: Trial by Fate
games.description:
Archer: Trial by Fate is a dynamic top-down action game. You control an archer who fights through dozens of rooms filled with monsters and bosses, challenging fate itself.

What awaits you:
* Dozens of unique abilities: ricochet, split arrows, meteors, orbs, ice and fire arrows, ghostly companions, and much more. Every run is a new combination of skills.
* Battles against a wide variety of enemies and bosses, each with its own behavior, attacks, and weaknesses.
* Progression between runs: unlock new heroes, upgrade your gear in the Forge, and invest coins into permanent stat improvements.
* Randomized room and wave order, so no two attempts are ever the same.

Can you clear every stage and defeat the final boss?

games.title: Trash Master
games.description:
You are the director of a waste recycling plant. There is no room for accidents here. Every bottle, every tire, every roll of toilet paper is the result of your control and skill. Trash Master is a recycling simulator for those who enjoy setting up mechanisms, not just money.

Gameplay:
🏭 Full-fledged factory: Conveyors, presses, shredders, sorting lines. It's just like in a real industry.
⚙️ The focus on efficiency: Your task is not just to process, but to do it with maximum speed, minimal losses, and without stopping the conveyor.

games.title: DOP2: Draw Love
games.description: Help a funny couple escape tricky situations in this hilarious puzzle game! Solve levels by drawing missing parts and uncover secrets. Can you keep love alive? Play now for laughs and brain-teasing fun!

games.title: Steal Memerot: Zoo Tycoon
games.description:
Create a bright zoo with rare brainrot animals: buy new creatures, place them on special spots, and earn more money as your collection grows.

Unlock unusual pets, expand your territory, improve income, and turn a small base into a rich zoo where every new creature makes your progress feel bigger.

• rare brainrot animals
• zoo building and growth
• unusual pet collection 
• income and base upgrades

games.title: Click That Button
games.description: One big red button, and an empire that grows every time you hit it. Cash from each tap buys upgrades that make the next tap worth more, then hired hands that tap alongside you and keep earning while you are away. Behind them wait eleven collectable buttons, six tiers of hands to merge, combo chains that pay out crits, golden buttons that rain money, and the guardians standing between you and the next button. Easy to start in one tap, and it keeps opening up for an hour.

games.title: Draw And Save The Stickman
games.description: Draw And Save The Stickman is a fun and addictive puzzle game where your creativity is the key to victory! Draw lines, shapes, and barriers to protect the stickman from dangerous traps, falling rocks, sharp spikes, enemies, and unexpected obstacles. Every level presents a unique challenge that tests your logic, imagination, and problem-solving skills. Think carefully before drawing because every line matters. Use your drawing skills wisely to create the perfect defense and keep the stickman safe. As you progress, puzzles become more challenging, requiring smarter strategies and more creative solutions.

games.title: Miner, Dig It All
games.description:
Your drill has one tank of fuel. See how deep the pit lets you get!

Drag to lay a line of dynamite, fire it, then hold the drill to grind the shattered rock away. Clear the layer and it collapses under you, straight into a richer one. On the surface, sell the ore and buy a harder bit, wider blasts and a robot crew, then dive again. Ten layers down sits the lava core: crack it and the whole pit starts over, permanently richer!

games.title: Tile Match Explorer
games.description: Tile Match Explorer is a blend of traditional tile match games and innovative puzzle mechanics, offering a fresh twist on the beloved match puzzle genre. Here, matching tiles becomes more than a game it's a journey. As you navigate through the myriad puzzles, Tile Explorer evolves, presenting new challenges that require you to think differently about your strategy. The thrill of making a triple tile match and clearing the board is unmatched, offering both satisfaction and the eagerness to tackle the next puzzle challenge.

games.title: Hungry Cats
games.description: Hungry Cats is a casual puzzle game where you guide several cats at the same time to find their food. By rotating the entire level, you must think carefully about how every cat moves together. This unique mechanic turns simple movement into a fun and playful puzzle challenge. 🐾

games.title: Pet Maze Escape
games.description:
✨ Welcome to Pet Maze Escape, the most hilarious and addictive maze puzzle game that combines humor, challenge, and adorable pets
Are you ready to test your wits and reflexes in a maze full of surprises, traps, and funny moments

🐾 Simple gameplay, endless laughter
Pet Me Maze brings the joy of solving puzzles to everyone. Just tap to guide your pet’s head through colorful mazes, dodge dangerous traps, and collect hidden treasures along the way. It sounds easy but each level introduces new twists that keep the challenge fresh and fun every time you play

😂 Funny and trending characters
The characters in Pet Me Maze are not just cute, they are hilarious. Inspired by viral internet figures like Sprunki, every movement, reaction, and animation is designed to make you smile. Whether you fail or succeed, you will find yourself laughing at your pet’s quirky expressions and silly mishaps

🧩 A maze puzzle game for everyone
From kids to adults, from casual players to puzzle masters, Pet Me Maze offers fun for all. Its easy one tap controls make it accessible while the smart level design keeps it engaging. Each maze is crafted to test observation, timing, and logic without ever feeling frustrating

🌈 Vibrant graphics and lively mazes
Enjoy smooth animations, bright visuals, and creative traps that bring every level to life. Each maze feels like a small adventure full of color and excitement. You will travel through forests, playgrounds, and even dreamlike lands with your adorable pet companions

🧠 Train your brain while having fun
Do not be fooled by the cuteness, this maze brain game will challenge your thinking. You will need sharp reflexes and clever strategies to avoid obstacles and complete missions. The more you play, the more your logical thinking and problem solving skills improve

🌍 Global fun, zero language barriers
Pet Me Maze does not require words to be enjoyed. It is pure gameplay fun that anyone can pick up instantly. Perfect for families, friends, or solo play anywhere in the world

games.title: BS Simulator
games.description:
UNLOCK AND UPGRADE BRAWLERS
Unlock and upgrade a variety of Brawlers! Level up your Brawlers and collect unique skins.

TROPHY ROAD
Collect trophies to earn rewards and advance to new leagues!

BRAWL PASS
- More than 140 rewards!
- Complete daily quests and unlock exclusive rewards.

LEADERBOARDS
Compete with real players from all over the world!

DAILY BONUSES
Log in to the game every day and receive exclusive bonuses!

In addition, the game has mini-modes.

games.title: School Escape Obby
games.description:
Dive into the thrilling world of School Escape Obby — a vibrant online game in roblox style with stunning graphics and diverse locations!
Tackle unique challenges in each zone, from school corridors to mysterious dungeons. Customize your character with hundreds of stylish skins and compete with friends in multiplayer mode. Every obstacle tests your agility and wit: jump, dodge, and solve puzzles to escape the school! Perfect for all skill levels, the game combines fast-paced platforming with creative level design. Regular updates, eye-catching visuals, and competitive leaderboards make this game a top choice for fans of obstacle courses. Join millions of players worldwide and prove your skills!

games.title: Robot Police Iron Panther
games.description: When the monster alien come to attack the earth, there's no body can save us except the police robot. Build your own Iron Panther robot and fight the monster in an epic fighting! It's not finished yet...

games.title: Cardivo Adventure
games.description: Cardivo Adventure is a relaxing card-sorting puzzle game where every card belongs to a themed collection. Move cards between stacks, uncover hidden matches, and organize colorful sets before you run out of moves. Thoughtful level layouts, satisfying animations, useful boosters, and steadily increasing challenges make every round a fresh little adventure.

games.title: Color Water Sort 3D
games.description: Color Water Sort 3D is a fun and challenging 3D casual puzzle game. The core concept revolves around sorting chaotic colors into perfect order, offering players an incredibly satisfying and stress-relieving experience. Set in a vibrant 3D environment, your task is to sort the colored water in the tubes until each tube contains only one single color. With levels ranging from simple to brain-teasing, it perfectly balances strategic thinking with a relaxing atmosphere, making it the ultimate brain trainer and time killer. What makes it unique is its realistic 3D visuals, smooth pouring physics, and the deeply addictive sense of accomplishment with every puzzle solved.

games.title: Robby: Escape The Rooms
games.description:
What awaits you:

50 cool rooms with unique tasks 🏰

Exciting puzzles 🧩

Fascinating mini-obby 🏃

Search for hidden objects🔍

Each room is a new adventure with special challenges. Will you be able to solve all the puzzles and get out victorious? 🎯

Hurry up! Time is running out, and the puzzles are getting harder!

Click "Play" and embark on an exciting journey right now! 🚀

games.title: Kind Shelter - Animal Care and Treatment
games.description:
A relaxing ASMR animal-care game where you treat and style adorable pets. 

As a caring vet and stylist, you’ll examine and heal stray cats and other furry friends, bathe and groom them, remove parasites, and perform delicate treatments. 
After care, dress them up with cute outfits, accessories, and hairstyles. 

Enjoy soothing sounds, cozy vibes, and the harmony of every touch!

games.title: Robby The Lava Tsunami
games.description: Robby The Lava Tsunami is an exciting free-to-play online game where you race against a flowing lava wave. Enjoy a colorful setting, unique skills, and endless customization options. Perfect for fans of speed and acrobatics, it’s accessible on iOS, Android, and desktop. Test your skills and strive for victory!

games.title: Nubik in the Monster World
games.description:
Nubik saved the kittens and defeated all the monsters! But just when you thought it was over, the monsters returned!

The evil Huggy has kidnapped all the kittens yet again! But this time, Nubik has armed himself with a whole new arsenal of weapons! In this game, you'll get your hands on an AK-47 assault rifle, an M16 rifle, a grenade launcher, a machine gun, and two incredibly powerful shotguns!

Help Nubik find the kittens to claim a reward of one million coins! Search for and open loot chests, upgrade your character, and blow up TNT blocks! What's more, Nubik's friend keeps getting caught by the monsters and thrown behind bars—help Nubik break him out of prison!

games.title: Blade & Bedlam
games.description: A top-down, physics-based, medieval melee fighter! Block projectiles and melee attack with your weapons and try to hit the enemies! Survive for as long as you can by dodging attacks, quickly killing enemies and buying items form the shop between rounds!

games.title: Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac
games.description:
Train your brain with Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac! 
Match mahjong tiles, solve relaxing puzzles, and enjoy classic gameplay on the go.

Unwind and challenge your mind with Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac, a timeless puzzle game that blends strategy, focus, and relaxation. 
Match beautifully designed tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a calming gameplay experience anytime, anywhere.
Perfect for both beginners and seasoned players, Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac offers intuitive controls, elegant visuals, and satisfying puzzles that keep you coming back for more.

games.title: Voxel Playground: Ragdoll Noob
games.description:
Voxel Playground: Ragdoll Noob is your arena of chaos!

In the game, you can:

💥 Arrange epic explosions.

🤸‍♂️ Experiment with funny character physics: throw him, hurl him from a height, launch him into flight and watch him comically deform.

🧱 Destroy buildings and experiment with the environment.

🤲 Interactive objects — saws cut, dynamite explodes, and everything around affects each other, creating chain reactions.

🖼 Colorful voxel graphics make destruction spectacular, and detailed physics turn every action into a fun experiment. This is a game where destruction is an art, and every scene becomes your personal laboratory of fun.

games.title: Stack Sort
games.description:
Dive into the colorful and satisfying world of Stack Sort! Welcome to Stack Sort: Build Color Stacks, the ultimate brain-teasing puzzle game designed to relax your mind and test your logic. Your mission is simple but highly addictive: bring order to the colorful chaos! You will start with a grid of mixed-up blocks, and it is up to you to carefully shift and sort them until every single color has its own dedicated stack.

With vibrant 3D graphics, smooth animations, and incredibly satisfying gameplay, Stack Sort is the perfect way to unwind after a long day or give your brain a quick workout. As you progress, the puzzles get trickier, requiring clever strategies and sharp spatial awareness. Can you master the art of the perfect sort?

games.title: Railroad Magnate
games.description: Become the owner of a growing railroad network and build it from the ground up. Run trains, unlock new stations, earn money from passengers, and upgrade every part of your route. The bigger your railroad becomes, the more platforms, buildings, and trains appear on the map. Simple controls, colorful low-poly visuals, and constant progression make the game easy to start and satisfying to keep playing.

games.title: Heroes vs Monsters: Idle RPG
games.description: Heroes vs Monsters: Idle RPG is a clicker where you assemble a team of heroes and send them into an endless battle against monsters. Level up your heroes, unlock artifacts, use powerful skills and push through hundreds of zones. Progress continues even while you're away - come back and collect your rewards!

games.title: Hide from School
games.description:
🏫"Hide from School ": A free online game combining popular genres such as: hide and seek, escape and quests. Help a young schoolboy escape from his teachers!

🕵️Hiding and Disguise: Blend in with the walls, disguise yourself as various objects to avoid teachers' attention. Solve puzzles, open doors, find your way out of rooms - your goal is to escape! Become a real school assassin!

🎮Play Hide and Seek Online: Feel yourself among the school walls and corridors, and test your skills in disguise. This free game allows you to compete with players from all over the world!

🧩Interactive rooms and traps: Explore different rooms, go into the shadows, and use items to create the perfect trap. Only those who can disguise themselves and escape cleverly will reach freedom!

games.title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
games.description:
Block Puzzle Tropical Story is a vibrant puzzle game that blends relaxing gameplay with a sense of island adventure. You’ll connect blocks, solve clever challenges, and unlock stunning tropical locations. As you explore lush jungles and serene beaches, each level rewards you with stars and new areas, turning every puzzle into a step deeper into paradise.

The booster system will help you in difficult situations, and the well-thought-out mechanics allow both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the game.

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a tropical paradise with beautiful graphics, relaxing music, and fascinating gameplay! Each successfully completed challenge brings you closer to discovering new horizons, and accumulated stars become the key to the next chapters of this exciting journey.

A relaxing puzzle game where you connect blocks while traveling through picturesque tropical islands. Collect stars, unlock new locations, and immerse yourself in the resort atmosphere!

games.title: OrbaDrone - Robot Escape
games.description:
ℹ️About
You’re an Orb-shaped drone with the ability to repel and attract objects, awakened in a strange cave-like structure in a post-apocalypse scenario. Discover strange materials with unusual properties and use them to navigate in this dangerous and mysterious place.

🌟Features
● 50 levels to complete
● 3 types of difficulties
● 4 mini-games
● Customize the drone with skins that have different abilities
● 2D physics mechanics
● 2D light effects and environments
● Control customization to choose your preference

games.title: Hexa Block Puzzle
games.description:
Try our highly addictive unique hexagonal pieces puzzle game!
Use your puzzle skill and put blocks into board.
Hexa BlockPuzzle will improve your logical skills and mind power.
Difficulty level will be increase as much as you play.

games.title: +1 Pickaxe: Break Blocks 3D
games.description:
+1 Pickaxe: Break Blocks 3D — Ready to turn an ordinary pickaxe into a true weapon of destruction? Embark on an exciting 3D adventure where sturdy blocks, valuable rewards, and plenty of upgrade opportunities await you!

Explore diverse zones, mine resources, collect rewards, and unlock new types of pickaxes. The higher your level, the more powerful your gear becomes, and the faster you can take down even the toughest blocks.

Purchase upgrades, unlock new workbenches, and gradually make your way into uncharted territories.

Boost your pickaxe’s power, destroy massive block deposits, and aim to conquer all available zones!

games.title: Kinder Garden
games.description:
Imagine yourself as a kindergarten teacher. Change diapers, feed and put the little ones to bed.
Only you can create an atmosphere of warmth, care and love that will make the kindergarten an ideal place for the growth and development of children.
Are you ready to become a teacher?

games.title: Fishing: Catch the Secret Brainrot
games.description:
Explore a large sea world where fishing is the core of the adventure 🌊🎣
Sail across the sea, travel between islands, and fish in many different locations. This online fishing game lets you catch fish, brainrots, and mysterious creatures while exploring a living ocean world filled with secrets 🏝️
Use your boat to move between islands and search for the best fishing spots 🚤

Each island offers different fish, sea creatures, and brainrots. Some fish are common, while others are rare and hidden in specific areas. Exploration plays a key role, encouraging players to travel, sail, and fish across the sea 🌊

Charge your cast, then click as fast as you can to reel in your fish ⚡
Your fishing rod, bait, and timing directly affect the result. Stronger creatures require faster reactions and better fishing equipment.
Progression is focused on fishing upgrades. Buy new fishing rods, unlock better bait, and purchase faster boats to reach new islands 🎣

games.title: Paint Pop 3D
games.description:
Paint Pop 3D is an one-tap hyper casual shooting game that will keep you hooked for hours!

Tap to paint. Hold for more fun!
Stay away from obstacles and paint all slices on the ring.

Features:
- More than 1000+ levels to experience game play.
- A lot challenging missions.
- Various characters & themes.
- Beautiful graphic.

games.title: K-Pop Halloween Dress Up
games.description: Get spooky and stylish with K-Pop Halloween Dress Up! Dress the Huntrix girls in hauntingly chic outfits like Witch, Pumpkin Queen, Vampire Idol, and more. Mix costumes, accessories, and spooky face paint to create bold Halloween looks for your favorite idols. Show off your fashion skills and celebrate Halloween K-pop style in this fun dress up game!

games.title: Sworded io - Spin and Rub
games.description:
Sworded io - Spin and Rub is a fast-paced arcade sword-fighting game where you’ll test your reflexes, tactics, and timing against waves of fierce opponents. Upgrade your fighter, unleash spells, and conquer battle arenas through pure skill and clever strategy.
Features
Massive weapon variety: swords, axes, knives, and more
Impactful power-ups to shift the tide of combat
Two thrilling modes, Domination and Battle Royal
Spin-powered action with dynamic, fast-paced gameplay
Compete and rise as the ultimate warrior

games.title: Swimming Pool Romance
games.description: Lucas is looking for a girl, obviously, at the swimming pool. And he find one, Natasha. She's so cute, he can't resist. Help him attract her with his mojo so they can spend a romantic evening together!

games.title: Craftsman Land
games.description:
Craftsman Land – build your own farm and help the town recover!

Craftsman Land is a farming and crafting game where your goal is to rebuild the inherited land, expand your farm, and support the local community.

After a devastating flood, the town is in ruins. As the heir to the land, it’s up to you to restore your farm, help the townsfolk, and bring life back to the surrounding villages. Grow crops like corn and onions, go fishing, and construct new buildings such as a house, chicken coop, and cowshed. Inside your home, you can decorate and design the interior to your liking.

Take care of your animals – feed chickens and cows, collect fresh eggs and milk, and use them for crafting or trading. Complete quests for local people, trade with merchants, and produce a wide variety of items thanks to the crafting system. Improve your skills, specialize in your favorite activities, and become a true master craftsman.

The world of Craftsman Land is constantly growing with new places, tasks, and adventures waiting to be discovered

games.title: Smash and Break
games.description:
Smash and Break — a juicy voxel destruction sandbox where you can blow anything to pieces!

100 objects are waiting their turn: a mouth-watering burger, a birthday cake, a gaming PC, a helicopter, a piano, a fish tank, and even a capybara. Every object is built from thousands of voxel cubes and breaks apart for real: chunks chip off and tumble down, liquid pours out through the holes, fire spreads across anything flammable, and glass bursts into a spray of shards.

No timers, no penalties, no game overs. Just you, a pile of objects, and total freedom to destroy. The perfect stress reliever!

games.title: Trap Craft
games.description:
The Hacker is ready to fulfill any desire of a Princess, Noob, Pro, Herobrine and the rest.
He offers them to play a game: if you protect the portal from zombies, then the wish will come true!
Each character has its own funny ending! Find out all of them!

Features of the game Trap craft. Herobrine and Noob vs Hacker

- 6 adventures: Herobrine, Princess, Noob, Pro, Foxy, Imp!
- 12 pets - tame all!
- This is a walkthrough game, not just a mod.
- The main characters have inventory for items
- Unique abilities of weapons
- Different types of monsters: from zombies to Dragons!
- At the levels you will meet Entity 303
- Play together with friendly pets, set traps and fight against the hostile zombies of the cube world.
- Watch video exhibitions - learn the history of Herobrine, Princess, Nubik.
- The best Trap Crafting adventure game - defeat zombies, survive, craft traps, tame pets in a cube world.

And also try our other monster school games!

games.title: Climb Up!
games.description: In this challenging adventure, you''ll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

games.title: Solitaire Tile Match
games.description:
Solitaire Tile Match is a cozy, endlessly satisfying tile-matching puzzle. Tap tiles from the board to send them to your dock — line up three identical tiles and they vanish. Simple to pick up, but every level adds new layouts and tighter dock space, so one careless tap can fill your dock and end the run. Think fast, plan your taps, and keep your dock clear.

Featuring:

Hundreds of hand-crafted levels across multiple chapters, each with its own tile layouts and challenge curve
A limited-slot dock that keeps every level tense — fill it up and it's game over
Power-ups to bail you out of a tight spot: Undo a bad move, Shuffle the board, get a Hint, or add an Extra Slot
Coins and Gems to collect, spend, and grow your stash with
Daily login rewards to claim every day you play
Clean, colorful, polished visuals designed for both quick sessions and long play
Whether you've got two minutes or twenty, Solitaire Tile Match is easy to jump into and hard to put down. Clear your dock, beat the level, and see how far your streak can go.

games.title: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy
games.description:
Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is a fast-paced, casual action game where you let out your frustration on a few dummies in all sorts of scenarios. You will need quick reflexes and punches to unleash the blows it will take to knock your opponent out. Stay sharp, keep punching, and enjoy every moment of cathartic stress relief.
How to Play Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy
Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is simple on the surface and fairly easy to play, but that is exactly what makes it so addictive. You control a floating arm wearing a boxing glove, and your only mission is to punch every dummy you see, along with other objects. Move the glove, line up your swings, and knock the targets out of the scene. Once they are all knocked out, you can move to the next level.
Each level presents a new setup of dummies. Sometimes there is a single dummy sitting quietly on a bench. Other times, groups are standing together, chatting, dancing with a rat, posing like the Creation of Adam, typing at a computer, balancing on unicycles, or even a bunch of dummies carrying a casket. The variety keeps things surprising and funny as you move from one level to the next.

games.title: Kaku: Shikaku Logic Puzzle
games.description: Kaku is a relaxing logic puzzle based on the classic Shikaku (rectangle division). Split the grid into rectangles so that each rectangle contains exactly one number — and that number equals its size. 2,000 handcrafted levels across 4 difficulties, daily challenges with monthly trophies, and an IQ score that grows with every puzzle you solve. Easy to learn, but Expert 13×13 boards will truly test your logic.

games.title: Animal Royal
games.description:
"The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals."
You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
Animal Royal is a game that features a wide variety of animals and birds, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
Your goal is to protect your meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much meat as possible to win the battle.
- Unique animal and bird with different abilities and strengths
- Engaging and colorful graphics with intuitive controls
- Intense player vs player battles on a battlefield
- You can merge two animals to level up and create a more powerful animal card
- Win the battle and collect more cups
- Compete for glory and rewards!
- Daily challenges and rewards for players

Animal Battle Royale is an exciting game that offers a new twist on the popular player-versus-player genre.
So if you're ready to take on the ultimate animal battle and emerge as the king of the jungle, join the Animal Royal game today!

games.title: Yatzy
games.description: Yatzy is the ultimate classic dice game that brings endless fun and excitement! Experience the thrill of rolling five dice to score the best combinations and outsmart your opponents. Whether you're a casual player or a Yatzy master, this game is perfect for you! Similar to games like Yacht and Yahtzee, Yatzy combines elements of strategy and luck, making it both challenging and entertaining. Whether aiming for a 🎲 Full House, a 📏 Straight, or the elusive 🏆 Yatzy (five of a kind), each roll offers a new opportunity to outscore your opponents.

games.title: Epic Battle Simulator 2
games.description:
Epic Battle Simulator 2  — Strategies, Armies, and Tactics in a New Format!
Develop unique strategies, choose your troops, and place them wisely on the battlefield to defeat any opponent. Fight campaigns against levels or create your own battles in custom mode.   

Now you can fully upgrade your army and witness realistic physics and ragdoll effects. Thanks to advanced graphics and enhanced AI bots, you’ll dive into thrilling large-scale battle simulations! Are you ready to take on the challenge and lead your army to victory? 
   
Features: 
- Realistic physics and ragdoll effects!  
- Improved army placement system for precise tactics!  
- Army upgrades up to three levels with powerful gear and enhanced stats!  
- Refined graphics that make every battle more spectacular than ever!  
- Smart troops for the most realistic combat simulation possible!

games.title: Hill Climber
games.description: Hill Climber is a simple yet challenging physics-based casual driving game where the goal is to drive as far as possible without having an accident or running out of fuel! Controls are minimal, but finding the right balance between braking and accelerating is crucial, especially when navigating hills. Buckle up and get ready for the (hopefully not) bumpy ride.

games.title: Stack Ball 3D
games.description: Break through countless platforms with the ball, but avoid hitting black spots or you'll lose. Try to hit as many platforms as you can to gain speedboost and become unstoppable

games.title: Block Blast
games.description: Dive into this popular and free puzzle game designed to stretch your brain and entertain you during your free time. Your mission is simple yet thrilling: match and remove as many blocks as possible from the board.

games.title: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls
games.description: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls is an Android game developed by Bravestars Games. This free game allows users to create stunning photos and fabulous videos featuring their own personalized dolls.

games.title: Modern Sniper Gun Game Sniper 3D
games.description: Get ready for action in Sniper Shooting Game, the most exciting sniper game full of missions, challenges, and headshots! Become a real sniper shooter who takes position on top of buildings and targets enemies below. Feel the thrill of sniper shooting and prove you are the best fps shooter in the city. Each level in this gun shooting game is full of danger and fun. Aim carefully, use your sniper rifle, and complete your sniper missions with perfect shots. Enjoy smooth controls, easy gameplay, and realistic effects that make this 3D sniper game feel real.

games.title: Idle Supermarket Tycoon
games.description: Embark on a journey to become a retail mogul with Idle Supermarket Tycoon. This engaging online simulation game lets you transform a modest shopping mall into a bustling retail empire. Strategically develop new shops, enhance their interiors, and beautify the mall's exterior. Your mission: serve customers, boost your reputation, and watch your profits soar. Play for free on your phone or computer and experience the thrill of managing your own supermarket kingdom

games.title: Twisted Rope 3D
games.description:
Rope Tangle Puzzle is a captivating mobile game for Android that challenges players to untangle ropes arranged in intricate configurations. This free-to-play puzzle game requires strategic thinking as players manipulate ropes without creating new knots. Using simple touch controls, players can select and move ropes to solve increasingly complex puzzles, all set against vibrant visuals and a user-friendly interface.

Each level offers a fresh challenge, demanding critical thinking and quick problem-solving to untie the knots. Success relies on careful planning and precise rope arrangement, making the game a delightful mix of fun and mental exercise. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, Rope Tangle Puzzle delivers an engaging experience that puts your skills to the test.

games.title: Geometry Vibes X-Ball
games.description:
Geometry Vibes X-Ball is ready to give you a completely different gaming experience! After the first game of the series, interactive new levels, challenge section and completely new store are waiting for you in X-Ball mode. Start your new adventure now in Geometry Vibes X-Ball game where you will find yourself avoiding obstacles, traps and gears in each level!

What are Geometry Vibes X-Ball Game Modes?
Classic Mode: Try to reach the portals at the end of a total of 10 levels that get harder as the levels pass. The last 3 levels are quite challenging!
Endless Mode: Try to go as far as you can without hitting obstacles and traps.
Challenge Mode: Challenging stages designed for master players are located in this section. Prove how good a Geometry Vibe X-Ball player you are with 5 different challenge levels.
Race Mode: You can compete with your friends locally by playing levels with 2-3-4 player.

Is Geometry Vibes X-Ball a Difficult Game?
Geometry Vibes X-Ball is definitely not a difficult game and you can complete 10 levels in the classic section if you practice enough.


Can Geometry Vibes X-Ball be played on mobile devices?
Yes, you can play the game smoothly on your mobile devices such as tablets and phones. The game has simple touch controls and you only need to touch the screen to play.

games.title: Cannon Basket
games.description: Cannon Basket is a fun and challenging physics-based puzzle game where your goal is to shoot colorful balls into the basket by adjusting moving platforms. Use your brain and quick reflexes to set the right trajectory and get every ball in! With simple one-touch controls and 45 unique levels, the game offers the perfect mix of logic, precision, and arcade-style fun. As the difficulty increases, you’ll need sharp timing and smart strategy to succeed. Can you complete every stage and become the master of ball cannons?

games.title: Robby Mini Games
games.description:
In this game you can spend time in different fun modes. We have a cool lobby where you can play soccer, go through a light round and have fun on the swing.

There are more than 20 different mini-games in the game, in which you have to play with rivals or by yourself.

Earn coins, collect game gifts and buy accessories for your character.

games.title: Slime Planet Eater
games.description:
You are a translucent slime the size of a small animal, and the planet under you is covered in things bigger than you are. Roll over the grass and swallow it. Then the flowers, then the fence, then the sheep that was ignoring you a minute ago. Every bite makes you heavier, and every kilogram of mass moves the edge of what you can eat a little further out.

There is nothing to fail. No timers, no enemies, no currency to manage. A building too large to swallow simply pushes back and bends you around it, until it does not. The pleasure is watching the scale of the world turn over: the tree that filled your screen becomes a snack, the car becomes a crumb, the skyscraper becomes the next goal.

Clear one planet and the galaxy map opens the next, each with its own look, its own skyline and its own ladder of things to devour. Hats, trails and skins are yours to collect along the way, purely so your slime looks the way you want while it eats a world.

games.title: Stick Box - Ragdoll Slowmo
games.description:
Immerse yourself in a frantic action game starring a flexible blue ragdoll! Pull his body, help him overcome obstacles, and engage in dynamic battles against hordes of red stickmen. Each level is a new challenge, where not only dexterity but also strategy are essential.

Unlock new weapons: boxing gloves, knives, bats, pistols, and even unexpected objects that transform into powerful weapons.

⚔️ Key Features:
💥 Realistic ragdoll physics – funny and spectacular!
🔫 Huge arsenal: from gloves to firearms.
👊 Levels with enemies and powerful bosses.
🎮 Simple controls: pull, hit, win!

games.title: Be like a Lucky Block
games.description:
Enter the chaotic world of Life of a Happy Block, where you become a fast-moving Lucky Block trying to survive an endless chase. Bosses are always behind you, but not all of them bring the same outcome. Your goal is to avoid weaker bosses while staying in the run long enough to meet stronger ones.
You control a rapidly moving Happy Block, making quick decisions to dodge danger and extend your run. Getting caught too early ends everything, but being caught by the right boss can transform your Lucky Block into a rare and powerful secret form.
Each run is a balance between risk and timing. The longer your Happy Block survives, the better your chances of unlocking unique transformations. Simple controls make it easy to start, but mastering the flow takes skill and focus.
How far can your Lucky Block go, and what will it become?

games.title: Flippee Ball
games.description:
A HYBRID ARCADE GAME OF PINBALL & BASKETBALL

-Flip the flippers and try to hit the ball into the basket.  
-Play against the CPU or another player on the same device.  
-Perfect your technique in the Academy - 100 increasingly challenging "assists" for you to try to score from.

games.title: Mandala Meadow
games.description:
Mandala Meadow is a relaxing mandala coloring game where you paint intricate designs, unwind, and create stunning art one tap at a time. Choose a mandala, fill each section with soft, calming colors, and watch detailed patterns bloom to life. With dozens of hand-crafted mandalas — from simple flowers to elaborate lotus, peacock, and animal designs — there's a soothing coloring puzzle for every mood.

Perfect for mindfulness, stress relief, and creative relaxation. No timers, no pressure — just you, gentle music, and beautiful art

games.title: Stickman Adventure
games.description: This is an adventure that will take you through time and space! Along the way, you'll encounter various traps and monsters; you'll need to defeat them and rescue your friends. Come on, Hero, a whole new world awaits!

games.title: Tile Pair Jam: Mahjong Master
games.description: Tile Pair Jam is a sliding mahjong puzzle. Shift tiles horizontally or vertically to create matching pairs. Plan each move, clear every tile, and solve increasingly challenging boards!

games.title: Patch Garden
games.description:
Patch Garden is a cozy rectangle logic puzzle where every seed clue grows into one perfect garden patch. Drag across the grid to draw rectangles, match each clue's area, and fill the whole board without gaps or overlaps.

Start with simple tutorial gardens, then progress through hundreds of increasingly clever levels with mystery seeds, exact-size clues, larger boards, and tougher deduction challenges.

games.title: Paws And Pals Diner
games.description:
Welcome to Paws & Pals Diner!

Step into the paws of a diner manager and embark on a delightful 2D adventure where every customer and staff member is an adorable animal! In this charming and whimsical world, you'll manage a bustling diner filled with furry friends, unlock delicious foods, and attract a variety of cute customers.

games.title: Cow Rescue
games.description: A cute cow is trapped behind a pile of wooden boards, and only you can rescue her! Match screws of the same color to remove them and carefully clear the wooden boards blocking the way. Plan your moves, solve tricky puzzles, and create a path for the cow to escape. With colorful screws, challenging board layouts, helpful tools, and a funny bird companion, Cow Rescue offers a fun and relaxing puzzle experience for players of all ages. Can you solve every puzzle and rescue the cow?

games.title: Toy Soccer Cup
games.description: Toy Soccer Cup is a fast, pick-up-and-play table football game where you flick toy players to smash the ball into the net. Battle through tournaments and world leagues, customize your team with kits, balls and pitches, and challenge real players in 1v1 online matches. Easy to learn, hard to put down!

games.title: Savage Defenders
games.description:
A tower defense strategy action game where you become the last hope of a tribe living at the foot of an ancient volcano. When an asteroid with an alien threat falls to the planet, you must combine magic, tactics and the strength of warriors to stop the invader who is devouring all life.

The village is a place where magic and nature merge. Its inhabitants, divided into four factions (archers, spearmen, stone throwers and shamans), have been defending their home from the dangers of the jungle for centuries. But everything changes when an alien organism falls from the sky - capable of taking over the minds of creatures. Now the tribe must prepare for war, enchant the jungle, build defensive towers and fight back the invader before it is too late.

games.title: Knife Tower
games.description: Race up a colorful tower, throw knives into every block, and reach the top before your rival. Time each shot around the bouncing ball, build combos with precise hits, collect coins, unlock new knives, and upgrade your speed, combo range, and income.

games.title: Crazy Flying Car
games.description:
Control a car with wings, make dangerous flights over the abyss and overtake your rivals!
You need to get to the finish line first. To do this, you can simply drive along the track, pushing your opponents, or take a risk and fly off the track, going into flight in the hope of shortening the path by air. To take a risk or to rely on maneuvers - it's up to you!
Play and fly right now!

games.title: Magic Circus - Match 3
games.description:
Magic Circus Three in a Row is an exciting game with many levels and different attachments!
Immerse yourself in the mystical atmosphere of the circus and overcome many obstacles and thugs. Complete the levels and collect treasures and crystals 3 in a row!
Game Features:
Large beautiful crystals - Three in a row the game is great for adult players!
There are a huge number of levels and several different sets of levels - to complete, to master animals, and a new set with unique obstacles!
Get bonuses and gold for completing levels!
Lots of crystals, power-ups and obstacles!
No time limits, lives, or attempts - play as much as you want!
A special mysterious world awaits you, which everyone dreams of looking through the doors. The atmosphere of the game will capture you from the first minute!
The magic has already begun!

games.title: Kinetic Puzzle
games.description:
Kinetic Puzzle is a block and grid puzzle brain teaser. Blocks slide with momentum until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. Drag them out through edge portals — but only if the order, direction, and dependencies line up.

Master four block types:
- Red simple — slides any direction, exits any portal.
- Yellow constrained — only moves and exits in its arrow direction.
- Blue dependent — locked until its prerequisite block leaves the board.
- Gray obstacle — fixed walls that block momentum.

Features:
- 50++ hand-crafted levels, ramping from gentle slides to multi-step dependency chains
- Slide momentum mechanics — every push counts
- Neo-brutalism art style with chunky tiles and tactile feedback
- No timers, no ads mid-puzzle
- Auto-save progress, undo, and hint support
- Plays great on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Perfect for puzzle fans who like to think before they move.

games.title: Color by Numbers. Anti-stress Drawings.
games.description:
Color by numbers is creativity and relaxation for the whole family. Our app helps you escape from worries and immerse yourself in the world of colors. This is art therapy available online and on Android.

The collection features anti-stress drawings that relieve tension. Each illustration is divided into numbered fragments — just pick the right color. The drawing process is captivating: you assemble a puzzle, but instead of pieces, you use colors.

The app is suitable for both children and adults. For kids, it's a way to learn colors and numbers, develop motor skills. For adults — an opportunity to relax and engage in creativity. No skills required.

The collection includes various genres: from pixel art to complex compositions. Color animals, flowers, mandalas, landscapes. Drawing by numbers develops attentiveness and sense of color.

The app works on Android and in a web browser. Save your works, share with friends. Coloring brings joy and harmony. Try it: choose a picture and create

games.title: HexaSort
games.description:
Отличная головоломка с сортировкой
Сортируй гексы по цветам
Выкладывай их так, чтобы плитки одного цвета оказались рядом. 
Тогда стопка исчезнет!

games.title: K-Pop Puzzle Hunters
games.description: In this free puzzle game, K-Pop fans and enthusiasts can piece together stunning images of Huntrix, Saja Boys, and Derpy Tiger from the beloved K-Pop Demon Hunters universe. With puzzles ranging from 16 to 100 pieces, players can choose their challenge and utilize hints when needed. This game perfectly blends strategy, logic, and fandom fun, making it a great fit for anime lovers, fans of K-Pop, and puzzle enthusiasts. Start solving today to become the ultimate Puzzle Hunter.

games.title: Geometry: Black Ball
games.description:
Geometry: Black Ball is an exciting arcade game based on the legendary Geometry Dash. In this game, you have to control the ball and overcome various obstacles using the unique mechanics of gravity change.

The game includes 10 levels of varying difficulty, each of which is an exciting challenge and requires the player to have quick reactions and precise movements. The further you advance, the more difficult the obstacles become, adding an additional challenge to the game.

In addition, Geometry: Black Ball has a shop where the player can purchase various skins for his ball. You can choose from a variety of stylish and creative skins to give your ball a unique look and enhance the feel of the game.

Get ready for an exciting adventure that will test your dexterity and reaction!

games.title: Sell Lemons Idle
games.description:
Start with a single lemon and turn it into a massive lemonade empire.

Grow lemons, harvest them, open new farms, purchase powerful upgrades, and watch your in-game lemon economy grow faster and faster.

Automate production, discover new development methods, and expand your empire to incredible scale.

Each upgrade makes your farm even more efficient. Fill the world with huge piles of lemons, boost production with multipliers, collect rewards, and unlock secret upgrades.

🍋 Grow Lemons
🏗️ Expand your lemonade empire
🚀 Purchase powerful upgrades
🎁 Earn rare rewards and bonuses

Can you create the biggest lemonade empire? 🍋👑

games.title: Hidden Paint 3D
games.description: Coloring 3D is an exciting game where you can animate objects with the help of color. Just click on various objects and they will instantly turn into bright and beautiful shades. The game is suitable for all ages, offering a simple and relaxing way to show your creativity.

games.title: Mr Shooter
games.description:
Mr Shooter, a Balloon popping desert plant on a mission... A mission to pop all the Balloons in the world!
The objective is simple: Pop all the Balloons to win!
Unlock and select new powerful cards as you progress through the game. With hundreds of creative and varied levels, this game will keep you entertained for hours.

games.title: Sorting Nuts and Bolts by Color: Home Repair
games.description:
Ready for some fun sorting? 🧩 The free puzzle game "Nut Sorter" invites you to relax and exercise your mind! Your task is to sort colorful nuts into bolts, creating perfect color chains. Over 15,000 levels with no time limit await you!

🎨 Soothing gameplay mechanics with tactile feedback and pleasant sounds.
⚡ Use bonuses: extra bolts, undo, and restart.
❓ Uncover the secret colors of the nuts under the question marks.
🏡 Build your dream home, earning rewards for completing levels.
😌 Comfortable Effects
Soothing ASMR-inspired sounds combined with haptic feedback provide an exceptional nut sorting experience!

Simply tap the bolts to move the nuts. Sort colors, plan your moves, and enjoy endless puzzles! Perfect for relaxing and developing your attention span. Download and immerse yourself in the world of color logic! 😍

🔩 FREE • 15,000 levels • No timers • For all ages

games.title: Christmas Girls Dress Up
games.description: Celebrate the holidays in Christmas Girls Dress Up, a festive fashion game where you style four friends for a magical Christmas celebration! Each girl has a unique theme: gingerbread cutie, Nutcracker elegance, Santa sweetheart, and Grinch-inspired glam. Mix and match tops, dresses, hairstyles, shoes, and accessories to create cozy, cheerful outfits. Create unique Christmas outfits for our girls, express your creativity, and enjoy the ultimate Christmas dress-up fun filled with sparkle, style, and holiday vibes!

games.title: Super Car Soccer Arena
games.description:
Super Car Soccer Arena unleashes high-speed action where powerful sports cars replace traditional soccer players! Jump into the arena, boost across the field, and smash the giant ball into your opponent’s goal. Master drifting, aerial flips, and explosive turbo moves to outplay rivals in this thrilling car-soccer showdown. With fast matches, smooth controls, and dynamic arenas, every game feels intense and unpredictable. Score goals, unlock new cars, and become the ultimate champion in this extreme fusion of racing and football. Start your engines and dominate the arena!

Race into the arena, smash the ball toward the goal, and outscore the enemy team before time is up. Use nitro, drift, and dominate the match!

games.title: Petdoku: Cozy Puzzle Games
games.description:
Get ready for an exciting challenge with a thrilling twist on two classic games! Dive into a captivating puzzle that merges the strategic thinking of Minesweeper with the number-crunching fun of Sudoku, all while uncovering the hidden map of your dog's favorite territory.
Can you solve it and reveal where your furry friend's adventures lie?

games.title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
games.description: Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel is an exciting free-to-play strategy game set in the 17th century. Command a team of diverse soldiers, issuing orders and making vital choices during intense battles. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it’s ideal for fans of historical tactics.

games.title: Long Drive to Horizons Sim
games.description:
Long Drive to Horizons Sim throws you into an epic desert survival adventure! This open-world simulator blends the freedom of a sandbox with high-octane racing and intense shooter action. Strap in as you pilot a lone vehicle across endless, unforgiving dunes.

🚗 Build & Customize
Gather parts and resources to assemble your dream ride. Mix and match bodies, engines, and wheels to craft a unique off-roader. Deep repair mechanics mean every bolt and circuit counts.

🔧 Maintenance & Upgrades
Keep your car battle-ready: refuel, swap out worn components, and unlock performance boosts. Hone your mechanic skills to tackle each rugged challenge.

🔍 Scavenge & Loot
Roam abandoned camps, crashed caravans, and derelict garages for vital supplies. Scavenge weapon parts, ammunition, and crafting materials in a richly detailed sandbox.

🏁 Dune Racing
Race across dozens of kilometers of treacherous desert tracks. Balance fuel, speed, and durability as you outpace rivals in blistering competitions.

games.title: Fun fishing
games.description:
Welcome to Fun Fishing — a fun and addictive fishing game about catching fish, upgrading your gear, and selling your catch! Catch rare fish, sell your haul, upgrade your fishing rods, and explore different locations.
🌊 What awaits you:
🎣 Simple and enjoyable fishing
🐟 Many types of fish — from common to rare
💵 Sell fish and earn money
🚤 Boats and new areas to explore
⬆️ Gear upgrades and progression
😄 Relaxing yet addictive atmosphere

games.title: Cake Ready
games.description: Cake Ready is a cozy merge-and-renovate puzzle game. Combine matching ingredients and kitchen tools to fulfill customer orders, earn rewards, and restore a lively cake cafe. Its satisfying item chains, story-driven renovation, and two connected play spaces make every merge part of building your dream bakery.

games.title: Crash Skill Racing
games.description:
Crash Skill Racing is a high-speed street racing game that throws you onto the busy highways of Japan. Weave through dense traffic, perform daring stunts, and push your car to its limits as you chase speed, style, and mastery behind the wheel.

Feel the adrenaline of threading through traffic at incredible speeds, where every second demands precision. Upgrade your vehicle, unlock new cars, and take on challenging skill-based events as you progress through an action-packed stunt journey.

With intense highway driving, deep vehicle progression, and a thrilling racing atmosphere, Crash Skill Racing delivers nonstop excitement from your first run to your fastest record.

Features:
High-speed racing on Japanese highways
Dense traffic that rewards skillful driving
Challenging stunt skill test mode.
Vehicle upgrades and performance tuning
Multiple unlockable cars
Fast-paced gameplay focused on precision and speed

games.title: Garage Boss
games.description: Garage Boss is an idle tycoon where you grow a single repair bay into a full garage, supermarket, and gas station in one connected world. Hire workers, upgrade everything, and watch your mini empire run itself while you tap, walk, and expand for more.

games.title: Animals Battle
games.description:
Are you attracted to adorable animals, and do you have the talent of a great commander? The new game combines these two passions, giving you the chance to build an empire in a world of endless battles!

 Here, you'll lead armies of cute yet formidable animal warriors. Command your troops, employ clever tactics, and devise effective strategies to conquer various adversaries.

 Explore new lands, conquer islands, and discover unique biomes inhabited by fascinating animals. Summon new fighters to your army, level them up, and turn them into the most powerful and charming armada.

 Remember: with each island you conquer, your enemies become stronger. To fight back, collect powerful artifact cards that will enhance your pets and strengthen your growing empire.

 This exciting strategy game offers hours of deep gameplay for anyone who loves animals and wants to test their tactical skills, regardless of age or gaming experience.

games.title: Obby Prison Barry Escape
games.description:
Welcome to the most guarded prison of Obby Prison Barry Escape

Barry is on duty today, and he is far from the most attentive guard. You can take advantage of this and get a chance to escape.

You are locked in the most secure prison in the world. Overcome many exciting challenges and reach the helicopter to escape.

 In addition, you can upgrade your character: unlock new costumes and accessories, creating your own unique style!

games.title: Slide the Blocks: Build the Pictures!
games.description:
«Slide the Block: Build the Pictures!» —  an exciting logic puzzle that will test your spatial thinking and ingenuity!

Move the shapes across the game board to assemble a complete picture. But be careful: blocks cannot pass through each other! Plan each move, find the correct sequence of movements, and unlock new images with cute animals and other characters.

Perfect for brain training, developing logic, and simply a pleasant way to pass the time. Can you complete all the pictures?

games.title: Nail Salon
games.description: Nail Salon is a creative and fun nail beauty art experience where you transform clients’ nails into dazzling works of beauty. Step into a vibrant salon, welcome your customers, and unleash your artistic skills to create stunning makeovers. Express your creativity with endless designs and colors, making each client’s nails truly shine. 💅✨

games.title: Rainbow's Doctor
games.description: 🦷 Become a Super Dentist! Step into your very own dental clinic and help patients get their perfect smile back! 😁 Examine dirty and damaged teeth, remove cavities, clean plaque, and fix dental problems using a variety of fun dentist tools. 🪥 Each patient brings a new challenge, so use the right tool at the right time and carefully treat every tooth. Complete your dental treatment and leave every patient with a bright, healthy smile! ✨

games.title: Knock Down
games.description:
The most fun and simple Knock Down - Bottle Hit in the market!

Knock Down game - Bottle Hit is to knock down all bottles using slingshot and ball.
It has many unique and interesting gameplay levels.

Where you have to knock down slingshot all the bottles using your logical and aiming skills to complete a level.
If you throw all ball without fall down bottles will level failed.

games.title: CrossTile
games.description:
CrossTile is a relaxing word puzzle where crossword solving meets jigsaw-style gameplay.

Each level gives you a theme and a set of scattered letter fragments. Drag the pieces around the board and connect fragments that belong together. Correct pieces snap into place and become one larger group. Keep linking words and intersections until the entire crossword is complete.

With simple controls, clean visuals, and no timers or lives, CrossTile is easy to learn and satisfying to master.

games.title: Maths Puzzle
games.description: Maths Puzzle is a fun and engaging logic-based game that challenges your mathematical skills and problem-solving abilities. With a variety of puzzles that range in difficulty, this game is perfect for anyone looking to improve their mental agility and enjoy a fun, educational experience. Your task is to solve mathematical equations by figuring out the missing numbers, symbols, or operations in order to make both sides of the equation equal. The puzzles come with increasing complexity, so you’ll need both strategy and quick thinking to succeed.

games.title: Noob saves a girl: A Story
games.description: Join an exciting rescue adventure in "Noob Saves a Girl," a free online game. Take on the role of a passionate hero trying to save his love from a cunning villain. Enjoy thrilling battles and strategic challenges on your phone or computer in captivating settings.

games.title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
games.description: Dive into the relaxing world of Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle! Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into the flasks until each flask contains only one color. With over 1000 levels and unique modes like Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, this puzzle game will test your logic and patience. Unlock new themes and achievements as you play!

games.title: Desolate Isle: Survival
games.description: Survive and escape from a mysterious island in this open-world survival adventure game. Gather resources, craft tools, build your base, and explore new areas with unique materials and challenges. Complete quests to unlock new territories and uncover the secrets of the island. Perfect for fans of survival, exploration, and crafting games.

games.title: Car Parking Order
games.description:
Car parking order game to test your brainpower and skills in this remarkable puzzle game. Unlock new levels of traffic jam game by strategically guiding the cars in the correct way and prepare for an exhilarating journey ahead. With each parking challenge, you'll find yourself fully immersed in this delightful and engaged game.

Navigate through unique parking lots by avoiding obstacles and overcoming various traffic jam hurdles in your way. From parking jam situations to unexpected roadblocks, every parking order level presents a new and exciting test of your parking abilities. Take on the role of a skilled driver and masterfully park your cars to their designated spots without a hitch. But be aware, as even the slightest miscalculation can lead to failure.

games.title: Tap Gallery
games.description: Tap Gallery is the ultimate puzzle game where you test your brain and tap away blocks to uncover hidden images. This iq game challenges your logical thinking and provides satisfying puzzle-solving experiences that relieve anxiety. Each tap puzzle is a unique brain teaser designed to engage and entertain, making it one of the most addicting games in the puzzle genre.

games.title: Dream Home
games.description:
A cozy 3D builder where you design and furnish your very own house from scratch. Raise walls and floors, paint them any color, hang wallpaper, lay flooring, arrange furniture, and decorate the yard: from flower beds and a campfire to a pool and a fountain.

Finished a room? Step inside! First-person walk mode lets you stroll through your house, climb the stairs, and see the result with your own eyes, by day and by night.

Want more than a sandbox? Fill client orders: build to the brief, get graded on your work, earn experience, and level up. A special challenge order is available every day. As you level up, new plots unlock — so you can work on several houses at once.

games.title: SKATE: +1 Speed
games.description:
🛹 This is a world of insane speed and skate parkour! Get a +1 speed boost while skateboarding, navigate challenging obstacle courses, and become the fastest player!

Gain speed with every passing second, jump over traps, avoid dangers, and complete thrilling parkour levels. The further you go, the faster you get! Unlock new skateboards with unique boosts and upgrade your character to set incredible records.

The game features vibrant tracks, challenging trials, fast-paced gameplay, and a constant sense of progress. Can you clear all the obstacles at top speed?

Game Features:

🛹 Skateboards with different speeds and boosts
⚡ Constantly increasing speed
🏁 Parkour with traps and obstacles
🔥 Simple and engaging controls
💨 Fast-paced and dynamic levels
🎁 Rewards and new upgrades
🌈 Vibrant style and a fun atmosphere
🏆 Set speed records

Jump, accelerate, and become a true skate park master!
Come on in!

games.title: IT LURKS
games.description:
You are alone in your house. Something is outside. A strange virus has spread through animals, turning them into terrifying creatures. Now you must survive 8 nights, from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM, while keeping watch over your home. 

Use your flashlight to check the windows and look under your bed. If something is outside, turn off the lights so it cannot see you. Stay alert. 
You never know what might be watching. 

-----Upgrade shop--------
You can also upgrade your skills by purchasing with your points, you get points by completing a game nor you lose or u can get starter Points by obtaining from ads

games.title: The Flowers Merge and Sell Bouquets
games.description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

games.title: Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!
games.description:
⚔️ Welcome to "Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!" - a fun 3D physics arena where ragdoll opponents fight in funny fights! Push, throw and knock enemies off the platform to be the only one left standing. This battle royale is a real epic action with falls, collisions and pushes!

🔥 Inspired by the popular hits "Epic Sword Fight! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena!" and "Balance Duel: Physics Action", this game combines simple mechanics, playground dynamics, and a lot of fun!

♥️ Don't forget to leave a review and share your impressions to help us improve the game!

Game features:
- Beautiful and pleasant 3D graphics
- Simple one-finger control
- Fun short levels in the style of shorts and reels
- Funny ragdoll physics
- Online leaderboard
- The game is available online for free on PC and mobile devices

🎯 Become a legend of the ragdoll arena - throw off all enemies and become a winner!

games.title: The Biggest Number
games.description:
🔢 The Biggest Number is a fast-paced 3D number runner and casual math game where every choice can make you stronger—or end your run!

Collect numbers equal to or smaller than yours and grow as large as possible. Dodge bigger red numbers, spinning saws, gaps, and traps. Choose the best math gates: add and multiply to boost your value, but watch out for subtraction and division! ➕ ✖️ ➖ ➗

✨ What awaits you:
• Fast arcade runner gameplay
• Shield and magnet boosters
• Starting-number and income upgrades
• Colorful levels, achievements, and leaderboards
• A satisfying finish where you smash through walls

games.title: Quizmasters

games.title: Block Puzzle: Jewel Block

Plan every move, build satisfying combos, chase a new high score, and use helpful boosters when the board gets crowded. games.title: Fortress Clash
games.description:
Fixed the reported issue: progress was not restored after a reload.

Root cause: bridge.storage.get() returns the saved value already parsed as an object, while the game expected a JSON string and parsed it again, which threw and silently discarded the save.

Changes:
- storage.get() now accepts both shapes (object and string).
- The save is loaded BEFORE gameplay is shown: a loading screen is displayed and input is ignored until storage.get() resolves, so a fresh default save can no longer overwrite real progress during startup.
- Saves carry a revision counter, so after "finish a level, then buy an upgrade" the newest copy always wins instead of an older one at the same level.
- Any pending write is flushed on page hide / unload, so the last action before a reload is never lost.

Verified in the QA tool: state written before Reload game is fully restored after it.

games.title: Wood Color Block

games.title: Papa Cherry Saga

-Complete fun and challenging prank missions.
-Hide and escape before Mom catches you.

Merge the same fruits to keep making it bigger and finally match melon.

In the game, you enter the exciting world of fitness and bodybuilding! Start your journey to muscular glory from scratch by clicking to perform exercises and build up your muscles. Use your skills and strategies to become the strongest bodybuilder in the game!

games.title: Collect Brainrot Egg

Play in 1 Player or 2 Player mode, buy mystery eggs from the center conveyor, carry them back to your base, and wait for them to hatch into random Brainrot characters! The better your lineup, the faster you generate coins, and the sooner you can afford the rarest eggs.

Basic, Rare, Super Rare, Void, Prismatic, SlyFox, Angel, Bonedragon, Hypertech, Firestorm, Diamond!
High-tier eggs appear much less often, but they can hatch into much more valuable Brainrots.

Core Gameplay:
Eggs spawn randomly on the conveyor. If you have enough money, buy an egg and bring it to your base. After the egg’s hatch timer finishes, your Brainrot appears and starts producing coins. Build your income step by step, then jump into higher tiers to chase the best pulls.

Of course, it’s not just farming. Defend your base from thieves by keeping it closed, or catch the rival mid-steal and hit them to save your Eggs and Brainrots. Feeling bold? You can also raid other bases and steal their loot.

Become the ultimate hunter and build a growing hunting business in Capitalist Hunter!

Explore the wilderness, hunt animals, collect meat, and bring your haul back to town. Cook food for villagers, earn cash, upgrade your equipment, and unlock new areas as your business grows.

Hunt, collect, cook, sell, and upgrade in a satisfying arcade idle adventure.

This one runs a real solver in the background and deals from verified hands, so the deal you get has a proven way through — and the table tells you when it's guaranteed. Lose anyway? Surrender and watch the winning line play itself out.

And it keeps the deepest record of your play in the genre: win rate with real confidence intervals, your first 50 games against your last 50, a six-month calendar of every session, best times, longest streaks, and your efficiency measured against the computer's own solution.

No ads in the middle of a game. Ever. Unlimited undo, hints that explain why, a daily challenge with streaks and a weekly one across all eight. Card backs and table themes unlocked by playing — never sold. Your progress follows you between devices.
